const ACHIEVEMENT_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(ACHIEVEMENTS.map(a => [a.id, a]));

/* Initialize a team's achievement state if missing. */
function _ensureTeamAchievementState(teamId) {
  if (!LEAGUE.achievements) LEAGUE.achievements = { teams: {}, global: {} };
  if (!LEAGUE.achievements.teams) LEAGUE.achievements.teams = {};
  if (!LEAGUE.achievements.teams[teamId]) {
    LEAGUE.achievements.teams[teamId] = { unlocked: {}, progress: {} };
  }
  return LEAGUE.achievements.teams[teamId];
}

/* Mark an achievement as unlocked for a team. Idempotent: re-calling
   for an already-unlocked ach is a no-op. Surfaces a toast + feed line
   on first unlock. Also handles the "world first" case if the achievement
   is global. */
function _unlockAchievement(achId, teamId, ctx) {
  const ach = ACHIEVEMENT_BY_ID[achId];
  if (!ach) return false;
  ctx = ctx || {};

  // Global "world first" achievements: only the FIRST team to trigger gets it.
  if (ach.scope === "global") {
    if (!LEAGUE.achievements) LEAGUE.achievements = { teams: {}, global: {} };
    if (!LEAGUE.achievements.global) LEAGUE.achievements.global = {};
    if (LEAGUE.achievements.global[achId]) return false; // already claimed
    LEAGUE.achievements.global[achId] = {
      season: LEAGUE.season,
      ts: Date.now(),
      byTeamId: teamId,
      byKnightId: ctx.knightId || null,
    };
    const team = TEAM_BY_ID[teamId];
    feed("season", `🌟 <b>WORLD FIRST</b> — ${team ? team.emoji + " " + team.short + ": " : ""}${ach.name} (${ach.points} pts)`);
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
      window.toast(
        `🌟 <b>WORLD FIRST</b><br>${escapeHTML(ach.name)} — ${team ? team.short : "?"}<br><span style="opacity:0.85;">${escapeHTML(ach.desc)}</span>`,
        "info",
        { ico: "🌟", ttl: 9000 }
      );
    }
    if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
    return true;
  }

  // Team-scoped: track per-team progress
  const state = _ensureTeamAchievementState(teamId);
  if (state.unlocked[achId]) return false;
  state.unlocked[achId] = { season: LEAGUE.season, ts: Date.now(), ctx };

  const team = TEAM_BY_ID[teamId];
  feed("season", `🏅 ${team ? team.emoji + " " + team.short + ": " : ""}<b>${escapeHTML(ach.name)}</b> unlocked. (+${ach.points} pts)`);
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
    window.toast(
      `🏅 ${team ? team.short : "?"}: <b>${escapeHTML(ach.name)}</b><br><span style="opacity:0.85;">${escapeHTML(ach.desc)}</span>`,
      "info",
      { ico: ach.icon || "🏅", ttl: 6000 }
    );
  }
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
  return true;
}

/* Increment a team's tracker progress for a given achievement. If the
   goal is reached, automatically unlocks. */
function _incrementTracker(achId, teamId, amount, ctx) {
  const ach = ACHIEVEMENT_BY_ID[achId];
  if (!ach || ach.type !== "tracker") return;
  const state = _ensureTeamAchievementState(teamId);
  if (state.unlocked[achId]) return;
  state.progress[achId] = (state.progress[achId] || 0) + (amount || 1);
  if (state.progress[achId] >= ach.goal) {
    _unlockAchievement(achId, teamId, ctx);
  }
}

/* Public entry point: record an event, dispatch to all matching
   achievements. Type-driven dispatch keeps the call sites clean —
   they just describe what happened, not which achievements care. */
function recordAchievementEvent(eventType, ctx) {
  if (!eventType) return;
  ctx = ctx || {};
  for (const ach of ACHIEVEMENTS) {
    if (ach.event !== eventType) continue;
    if (ach.type === "event_first") {
      // For team-scoped: needs ctx.teamId. For global: also needs ctx.teamId
      // (the team that triggered it).
      if (ctx.teamId) _unlockAchievement(ach.id, ctx.teamId, ctx);
    } else if (ach.type === "tracker") {
      if (ctx.teamId) _incrementTracker(ach.id, ctx.teamId, ctx.amount || 1, ctx);
    }
  }
}
window.recordAchievementEvent = recordAchievementEvent;

/* Compute total achievement points for a team. */
function teamAchievementPoints(teamId) {
  let pts = 0;
  const state = LEAGUE.achievements && LEAGUE.achievements.teams && LEAGUE.achievements.teams[teamId];
  if (!state) return 0;
  for (const achId of Object.keys(state.unlocked || {})) {
    const ach = ACHIEVEMENT_BY_ID[achId];
    if (ach) pts += ach.points || 0;
  }
  // Add global ones the team has earned
  if (LEAGUE.achievements && LEAGUE.achievements.global) {
    for (const achId of Object.keys(LEAGUE.achievements.global)) {
      if (LEAGUE.achievements.global[achId].byTeamId === teamId) {
        const ach = ACHIEVEMENT_BY_ID[achId];
        if (ach) pts += ach.points || 0;
      }
    }
  }
  return pts;
}
window.teamAchievementPoints = teamAchievementPoints;

/* ============================================================
   ACHIEVEMENTS MODAL — v37.23
   WoW-style sidebar + grid. Sidebar lists categories; main pane
   shows achievements in selected category for selected team
   (or "World First" tab for global achievements).
   ============================================================ */
let _achActiveCategory = "combat";
let _achActiveTeamId = null;

function showAchievements() {
  // Default team selection: first team alphabetically (stable)
  if (!_achActiveTeamId) {
    _achActiveTeamId = TEAMS.length > 0 ? TEAMS[0].id : null;
  }
  _renderAchievementsModal();
}
window.showAchievements = showAchievements;

function _renderAchievementsModal() {
  const teamId = _achActiveTeamId;
  const team = teamId ? TEAM_BY_ID[teamId] : null;
  const cat = _achActiveCategory;

  // Build sidebar — category list with per-team unlock counts
  const teamState = teamId ? (LEAGUE.achievements && LEAGUE.achievements.teams && LEAGUE.achievements.teams[teamId]) : null;
  const teamUnlocked = teamState ? teamState.unlocked : {};

  let sidebarHTML = `<div class="ach-team-picker">`;
  for (const t of TEAMS) {
    const cls = t.id === teamId ? "active" : "";
    sidebarHTML += `<button class="ach-team-pick ${cls}" onclick="_achSelectTeam('${t.id}')" title="${escapeHTML(t.name)}">${t.emoji} ${t.short}</button>`;
  }
  sidebarHTML += `</div>`;

  for (const c of ACHIEVEMENT_CATEGORIES) {
    const all = ACHIEVEMENTS.filter(a => a.category === c.id);
    let unlocked = 0;
    if (c.id === "world") {
      // For "World First", count globally (across all teams); also count if teamId earned them
      const globalAch = (LEAGUE.achievements && LEAGUE.achievements.global) || {};
      unlocked = all.filter(a => globalAch[a.id]).length;
    } else {
      unlocked = all.filter(a => teamUnlocked[a.id]).length;
    }
    const cls = c.id === cat ? "active" : "";
    sidebarHTML += `<button class="ach-tab-btn ${cls}" onclick="_achSelectCategory('${c.id}')">
      ${c.icon} ${escapeHTML(c.label)}
      <div class="ach-tab-meta">${unlocked} / ${all.length}</div>
    </button>`;
  }

  // Build main content
  const catAchs = ACHIEVEMENTS.filter(a => a.category === cat);
  const isWorldCat = cat === "world";

  // Summary cards (top of content area)
  let totalUnlocked = 0, totalAchs = 0, totalPts = 0;
  if (isWorldCat) {
    const globalAch = (LEAGUE.achievements && LEAGUE.achievements.global) || {};
    totalAchs = ACHIEVEMENTS.filter(a => a.category === "world").length;
    totalUnlocked = Object.keys(globalAch).filter(id => ACHIEVEMENT_BY_ID[id] && ACHIEVEMENT_BY_ID[id].category === "world").length;
    for (const id of Object.keys(globalAch)) {
      const ach = ACHIEVEMENT_BY_ID[id];
      if (ach && ach.category === "world") totalPts += ach.points || 0;
    }
  } else {
    totalAchs = ACHIEVEMENTS.filter(a => a.scope === "team").length;
    totalUnlocked = teamState ? Object.keys(teamUnlocked).length : 0;
    totalPts = teamId && typeof teamAchievementPoints === "function" ? teamAchievementPoints(teamId) : 0;
  }
  const allTeamPts = TEAMS.map(t => ({
    t,
    pts: typeof teamAchievementPoints === "function" ? teamAchievementPoints(t.id) : 0,
  })).sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts);
  const teamRank = teamId ? allTeamPts.findIndex(x => x.t.id === teamId) + 1 : 0;

  let summaryHTML = "";
  if (isWorldCat) {
    summaryHTML = `<div class="ach-header">
      <div>
        <div class="ach-header-title">🌟 WORLD FIRSTS</div>
        <div class="ach-header-meta">League-wide milestones — first team to claim each.</div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align:right;">
        <div class="ach-header-pts">${totalUnlocked} / ${totalAchs}</div>
        <div class="ach-header-meta">${totalPts} pts claimed</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  } else {
    summaryHTML = `<div class="ach-header">
      <div>
        <div class="ach-header-title">${team ? team.emoji + " " + team.name : "—"}</div>
        <div class="ach-header-meta">League rank: #${teamRank} of ${TEAMS.length} by achievement points</div>
      </div>
      <div style="text-align:right;">
        <div class="ach-header-pts">${totalPts} pts</div>
        <div class="ach-header-meta">${totalUnlocked} / ${totalAchs} unlocked</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }

  // Achievement rows
  let rowsHTML = `<div class="ach-list">`;
  for (const ach of catAchs) {
    let unlockedRecord = null;
    let progress = 0, goal = 0;
    let isUnlocked = false;
    let unlockedByTeam = null;
    if (ach.scope === "global") {
      const g = (LEAGUE.achievements && LEAGUE.achievements.global) || {};
      unlockedRecord = g[ach.id] || null;
      isUnlocked = !!unlockedRecord;
      if (unlockedRecord) {
        unlockedByTeam = TEAM_BY_ID[unlockedRecord.byTeamId];
      }
    } else {
      unlockedRecord = teamUnlocked[ach.id] || null;
      isUnlocked = !!unlockedRecord;
      if (ach.type === "tracker") {
        progress = teamState && teamState.progress ? (teamState.progress[ach.id] || 0) : 0;
        goal = ach.goal;
      }
    }

    const cls = isUnlocked
      ? (ach.scope === "global" ? "world-first" : "unlocked")
      : "locked";
    const dateStr = unlockedRecord && unlockedRecord.season
      ? `S${unlockedRecord.season}` + (unlockedByTeam ? ` · ${unlockedByTeam.short}` : "")
      : "—";

    let progressHTML = "";
    if (ach.type === "tracker" && !isUnlocked && goal > 0) {
      const pct = Math.min(100, Math.floor((progress / goal) * 100));
      progressHTML = `
        <div class="ach-progress"><div class="ach-progress-fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div>
        <div class="ach-progress-text">${progress} / ${goal}</div>`;
    }

    rowsHTML += `<div class="ach-row ${cls}">
      <div class="ach-icon">${ach.icon}</div>
      <div class="ach-body">
        <div class="ach-name">${escapeHTML(ach.name)}</div>
        <div class="ach-desc">${escapeHTML(ach.desc)}</div>
        ${progressHTML}
      </div>
      <div class="ach-meta-col">
        <div class="ach-pts">${ach.points}</div>
        <div class="ach-unlock-date">${dateStr}</div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }
  rowsHTML += `</div>`;

  const body = `<div class="ach-modal-wrap">
    <div class="ach-sidebar">${sidebarHTML}</div>
    <div class="ach-content">${summaryHTML}${rowsHTML}</div>
  </div>`;

  openModal("🏅 Achievements", body, `<button onclick="closeModal()" class="secondary">Close</button>`, null, { width: "fullscreen" });
}

function _achSelectCategory(catId) {
  _achActiveCategory = catId;
  _renderAchievementsModal();
}
window._achSelectCategory = _achSelectCategory;

function _achSelectTeam(teamId) {
  _achActiveTeamId = teamId;
  _renderAchievementsModal();
}
window._achSelectTeam = _achSelectTeam;




function getCoachFor(teamId) {
  return COACHES[teamId] || null;
}
window.getCoachFor = getCoachFor;

/* ============================================================
   LEAGUE STATE — top-level game state
   ============================================================ */
const LEAGUE = {
  season: 1,
  bits: 0,
  // Roster: { fox: [5 players], bvr: [5 players], owl: [5 players], shk: [5 players] }
  rosters: {},
  // Permanent graveyard: array of deceased players (never reaped)
  graveyard: [],
  // Team records: { teamId: { wins, losses, championships } }
  records: {},
  // Bracket for current season:
  // { semi1: {teamA, teamB, winner|null, kills}, semi2: {...}, final: {...} }
  bracket: null,
  // Match in progress (live state during a fight)
  match: null,
  // Active match index in bracket order: "semi1" | "semi2" | "final" | null
  currentSlot: null,
  // History of past seasons: [{season, champion, runnerup, casualties}]
  history: [],
  // Active bets (cleared after each match resolves)
  bets: [],
  // Shop boosts pending: { teamId: { dmg, def, spd, ... } } — applied next match
  pendingBoosts: {},
  // === v28.1: per-knight targeted boosts (Personal Sandbag etc.) ===
  // { teamId: { knightId: { spd, dmg, ... } } } — applied next match, per-knight.
  pendingTargetedBoosts: {},
  // === v28.16: per-team AI pathing style assignments ===
  // { teamId: styleId } — rolled fresh each season. Style choices live in
  // AI_PATHING_STYLES (declared in _part2_sim_b.html).
  aiStyles: {},
  // === v37.23: Knight rivalries ===
  // Pairwise kill counts. Key format: "{killerKnightId}::{victimKnightId}".
  // When both directions reach 3+ kills against each other, the pair is
  // detected as a "mutual rivalry" — surfaced pre-match, on profile, and
  // in feed lines whenever they cross paths.
  // Knight IDs are integers from _idCounter; survive serialization.
  rivalries: {},
  // === v37.23.3: Cumulative janitor tips ===
  // Counter for "Tip the Janitors" shop purchases. Drives the cleanup
  // crew's visual upgrade tier (better hats at 5+, hi-vis green vests at
  // 20+, fifth janitor + thank-you text at 50+). Cumulative across the
  // whole league's lifetime — the crew has, on the matter, a long memory.
  janitorTips: 0,
  // === v37.23: Achievements ===
  // { teams: { [teamId]: { unlocked: { [achId]: {season, ts, ctx} }, progress: { [achId]: int } } },
  //   global: { [achId]: { season, ts, byTeamId, byKnightId } } }
  achievements: { teams: {}, global: {} },
  // === v37.16: Followed knights (idol system) ===
  // Array of knight IDs the user has starred to track. The Following panel
  // surfaces their match appearances and KOs. When a followed knight
  // perma-dies, we promote a prominent toast and offer to follow their
  // lineage successor. Persists in localStorage save.
  followedKnights: [],
  // === v37.16: Lineage chains (newgen system) ===
  // { surnameKey: { surname, ordinal, latestKnightId, predecessors: [...] } }
  // When a knight perma-dies, the next rookie to take that team's same
  // position slot has ~50% chance to inherit the lineage with an
  // incremented ordinal ("the Second", "the Third" — or "Sr."→"Jr." for
  // certain surnames). The chain ends when reapDeceased fills the slot
  // without inheritance. Surname lookup uses a normalized key so
  // "Bristlebeard" and "Bristlebeard the Second" share the chain.
  lineages: {},
  // === v37.16: Caucus Vote system ===
  // pendingVote = the vote presented at the current season-end transition
  // (null if not yet drawn). activeRuleTweak = the tweak the user voted
  // in at the last season transition (null = none active). Each vote
  // persists for one season; when the next season ends, the previous
  // tweak clears and a fresh vote is presented.
  pendingVote: null,
  activeRuleTweak: null,
  // History of past votes: [{ season, voteId, optionChosen, options }]
  voteHistory: [],
  // === v37.17: Lore bookmarks ===
  // { articleId: { section, title, savedAt, snippet } }
  // Populated by the bookmark button (🔖) on each lore article. Keys
  // are stable slugs derived from the article's h3 text + section so
  // the same article on a re-render gets the same key. Persists in
  // localStorage save (so bookmarks survive export/import).
  loreBookmarks: {},
  // === v37.19: Promoted League Legends ===
  // Knights from the player's own league who reached "legend" status
  // during their career (15+ kills, 10+ longest streak, 5+ seasons,
  // or 3+ matches won) get promoted into this register on perma-death.
  // Surfaces in the League Legends section alongside LEGACY_HEROES
  // (the pre-seeded canon). This is the natural answer to the
  // "memorialized in League Legends" expectation — significant
  // casualties get the recognition the standard Hall of Fallen
  // doesn't single out.
  promotedLegends: [],
};

function initLeague(opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  // Genesis seed: stable across this league's lifetime. If supplied (e.g. for
  // tests / replay), use that. Otherwise generate a random one — the only
  // place real Math.random affects sim outcomes. Once set, persists in saves.
  LEAGUE.genesisSeed = opts.genesisSeed || ((Math.random() * 0xFFFFFFFF) >>> 0);
  // Reseed the sim RNG NOW so all setup randomness (rosters, names, etc.)
  // is derived from genesisSeed deterministically.
  SIM_RNG.reseed(LEAGUE.genesisSeed);

  // === v37.4: merge custom teams + custom formation at reset ===
  // Custom teams from LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams are normalized and merged
  // into TEAMS for this league instance. (We mutate TEAMS directly because
  // many downstream lookups reference TEAMS by index/iteration; the
  // alternative — keeping a parallel ACTIVE_TEAMS array — would require
  // touching dozens of call sites. Instead, we snapshot the canonical
  // TEAMS once into TEAMS_CANON the first time initLeague runs, and
  // rebuild TEAMS from that canon + customs on every subsequent reset.)
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && !window._TEAMS_CANON) {
    window._TEAMS_CANON = TEAMS.slice();
  }
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window._TEAMS_CANON) {
    // Rebuild TEAMS from the canonical snapshot so old custom teams
    // don't accumulate across resets.
    TEAMS.length = 0;
    for (const t of window._TEAMS_CANON) TEAMS.push(t);
    // Append custom teams (validated)
    const customTeams = (LEAGUE_CONFIG && Array.isArray(LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams)) ? LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams : [];
    for (const ct of customTeams) {
      if (!ct || !ct.id || !ct.name) continue;
      // Skip if id collides with a canon team
      if (TEAMS.some(t => t.id === ct.id)) continue;
      TEAMS.push(_normalizeCustomTeam(ct));
    }
    // Refresh TEAM_BY_ID lookup
    if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
      window.TEAM_BY_ID = Object.fromEntries(TEAMS.map(t => [t.id, t]));
    }
  }

  // Custom formation: if defined, use it instead of the default POSITIONS
  // array when minting rosters. Each entry in customFormation.leftIds (or
  // .left for the human-readable list) maps to a POSITIONS entry by id.
  // Mirror=true uses left for both teams; mirror=false uses left/right per team.
  const formation = (LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.customFormation) ? LEAGUE_CONFIG.customFormation : null;
  const formationLeft  = (formation && Array.isArray(formation.leftIds)  && formation.leftIds.length)  ? formation.leftIds  : null;
  const formationRight = (formation && !formation.mirror && Array.isArray(formation.rightIds) && formation.rightIds.length) ? formation.rightIds : formationLeft;

  for (const team of TEAMS) {
    const ids = formationLeft || POSITIONS.map(p => p.id);
    LEAGUE.rosters[team.id] = ids.map(id => {
      const pos = POSITIONS.find(p => p.id === id) || POSITIONS[0];
      return makePlayer(team.id, pos);
    });
    LEAGUE.records[team.id] = { wins: 0, losses: 0, draws: 0, championships: 0 };
  }
  // Note: formationRight currently unused at init (rosters are minted per
  // team, not per side). It's wired here so future per-team-side overrides
  // (e.g. a tournament where one bracket plays one formation and another
  // plays a different one) have the data path. The mirror=false case
  // matters mostly during live matches via the bench/draft pipeline.
  void formationRight;

  LEAGUE.season = 1;
  LEAGUE.bits = 0;
  LEAGUE.graveyard = [];
  LEAGUE.history = [];
  LEAGUE.matchHistory = [];
  LEAGUE.lostItems = [];
  LEAGUE.bets = [];
  LEAGUE.pendingBoosts = {};
  LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts = {};
  // v37.16: reset idol/lineage/vote state on fresh league
  LEAGUE.followedKnights = [];
  LEAGUE.lineages = {};
  LEAGUE.pendingVote = null;
  LEAGUE.activeRuleTweak = null;
  LEAGUE.voteHistory = [];
  // v37.17: reset lore bookmarks on fresh league
  LEAGUE.loreBookmarks = {};
  // v37.19: reset promoted legends on fresh league
  LEAGUE.promotedLegends = [];
  LEAGUE.startedAt = Date.now();   // when this league was first booted (immutable)
  LEAGUE.lastTickAt = Date.now();  // wall-clock of most recent sim activity (updated each frame)
  // === v28.16: roll initial AI-style assignments for season 1 ===
  if (typeof rollSeasonAiStyles === "function") rollSeasonAiStyles();
  buildBracket();
}

/* ============================================================
   v37.16: KNIGHT LOOKUP / IDOL / LINEAGE HELPERS
   These helpers support three new features:
     1. The Idol/Follow system (UI lets the user "star" a knight to track)
     2. The Newgen/Lineage system (perma-deaths spawn named successors)
     3. The Caucus Vote system (season-end rule tweaks)
   All three persist via the existing LEAGUE save schema.
   ============================================================ */

/* Look up a knight by ID across active rosters. Returns null if the knight
   has been reaped to graveyard or doesn't exist (e.g. stale follow ID
   pointing at a perma-dead knight whose roster slot was already filled). */
function findKnightById(id) {
  if (id == null) return null;
  for (const teamId of Object.keys(LEAGUE.rosters || {})) {
    const r = LEAGUE.rosters[teamId];
    for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) {
      if (r[i].id === id) return r[i];
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* Returns true if the user has starred this knight ID. */
function isKnightFollowed(id) {
  if (!LEAGUE.followedKnights) return false;
  return LEAGUE.followedKnights.indexOf(id) !== -1;
}

/* Toggle follow status; persists immediately via saveLocal.
   Emits a small toast confirming the action. Returns the new follow state. */
function toggleKnightFollow(id) {
  if (!LEAGUE.followedKnights) LEAGUE.followedKnights = [];
  const idx = LEAGUE.followedKnights.indexOf(id);
  let nowFollowing;
  if (idx === -1) {
    LEAGUE.followedKnights.push(id);
    nowFollowing = true;
  } else {
    LEAGUE.followedKnights.splice(idx, 1);
    nowFollowing = false;
  }
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
    const k = findKnightById(id);
    const nm = k ? k.name : "Knight";
    window.toast(
      nowFollowing ? `⭐ Following <b>${nm}</b>` : `☆ Unfollowed <b>${nm}</b>`,
      "info",
      { ico: nowFollowing ? "⭐" : "☆", ttl: 3000 }
    );
  }
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
  // Refresh the Following panel if it's currently rendered
  if (typeof renderFollowingPanel === "function") {
    try { renderFollowingPanel(); } catch {}
  }
  return nowFollowing;
}

/* Returns array of currently-followed knights (resolved to current
   roster entries). Stale follow-IDs (pointing at reaped knights) are
   left in LEAGUE.followedKnights so the user's intent persists if the
   knight is still in the graveyard but visible in lore — but they don't
   appear in this resolved list. */
function getFollowedKnights() {
  const ids = LEAGUE.followedKnights || [];
  const out = [];
  for (const id of ids) {
    const k = findKnightById(id);
    if (k) out.push(k);
  }
  return out;
}

/* === Lineage system ===
   Surnames carry across knight generations. When a knight perma-dies,
   their surname is registered as a "lineage chain" on their roster slot.
   When the next rookie fills that slot via reapDeceased or backfill,
   there's ~50% chance to inherit the lineage with an incremented ordinal.

   The chain is keyed by `${teamId}:${position}:${normalizedSurname}` so
   parallel chains on different teams (e.g. Bristlebeard the Beaver vs
   a hypothetical Bristlebeard the Wolf) don't collide. */

const LINEAGE_ORDINALS = [
  "the Second", "the Third", "the Fourth", "the Fifth", "the Sixth",
  "the Seventh", "the Eighth", "the Ninth", "the Tenth", "the Eleventh",
  "the Twelfth", "the Thirteenth", "the Fourteenth", "the Fifteenth",
];

/* Strip lineage suffixes from a name to get the base surname. So
   "Crash Bristlebeard the Third" → "Bristlebeard"; "Stormpaw Sr." →
   "Stormpaw"; "Vela Hootington" → "Hootington". Returns the trailing
   word stripped of suffix decorations. Used as the lineage chain key. */
function _baseSurnameFor(fullName) {
  if (!fullName) return null;
  // Remove trailing ordinal/suffix decorations
  let stripped = fullName
    .replace(/ the (Second|Third|Fourth|Fifth|Sixth|Seventh|Eighth|Ninth|Tenth|Eleventh|Twelfth|Thirteenth|Fourteenth|Fifteenth|First|Bold|Ferocious|Cute)$/i, "")
    .replace(/ (Sr\.|Jr\.|II|III|IV|V|VI)$/i, "")
    .trim();
  const parts = stripped.split(/\s+/);
  if (parts.length < 2) return null;
  return parts[parts.length - 1];
}

/* Register a lineage chain when a knight perma-dies. Called from the
   handleKO permadeath path. Returns the lineage key or null if no
   lineage was established (e.g. malformed name). */
function registerLineageOnDeath(deceasedKnight) {
  if (!deceasedKnight || !deceasedKnight.name) return null;
  const surname = _baseSurnameFor(deceasedKnight.name);
  if (!surname) return null;
  const key = `${deceasedKnight.teamId}:${deceasedKnight.position}:${surname}`;
  if (!LEAGUE.lineages) LEAGUE.lineages = {};
  let chain = LEAGUE.lineages[key];
  if (!chain) {
    chain = {
      surname,
      teamId: deceasedKnight.teamId,
      position: deceasedKnight.position,
      // ordinal index: 0 = "the Second" is next, 1 = "the Third" is next, …
      // The deceased knight was either the original (surname only, no
      // ordinal) or already had an ordinal we should detect and continue.
      nextOrdinalIndex: 0,
      predecessors: [],
    };
    LEAGUE.lineages[key] = chain;
  }
  // If the deceased knight already had an ordinal in their name, advance
  // past it so the successor gets the correct next number.
  const ordMatch = (deceasedKnight.name || "").match(/the (Second|Third|Fourth|Fifth|Sixth|Seventh|Eighth|Ninth|Tenth|Eleventh|Twelfth|Thirteenth|Fourteenth|Fifteenth)$/i);
  if (ordMatch) {
    const idx = LINEAGE_ORDINALS.findIndex(o => o.toLowerCase() === ordMatch[0].toLowerCase());
    if (idx !== -1 && idx >= chain.nextOrdinalIndex) {
      chain.nextOrdinalIndex = idx + 1;
    }
  }
  chain.predecessors.push({
    knightId: deceasedKnight.id,
    name: deceasedKnight.name,
    deceasedSeason: LEAGUE.season,
    deceasedBy: deceasedKnight.deceasedBy || null,
  });
  // === v37.23: lineage achievement hooks ===
  // Trigger achievements based on the new chain length (post-push).
  // length 2 means this knight is the SECOND in the chain (one predecessor
  // before them was already there; we just pushed knight #1's record so
  // the next rookie minted will be the Second).
  if (typeof recordAchievementEvent === "function") {
    const len = chain.predecessors.length;
    if (len === 1) recordAchievementEvent("lineage_2", { teamId: deceasedKnight.teamId });
    else if (len === 2) recordAchievementEvent("lineage_3", { teamId: deceasedKnight.teamId });
    else if (len === 4) {
      recordAchievementEvent("lineage_5", { teamId: deceasedKnight.teamId });
      recordAchievementEvent("league_first_5_chain", { teamId: deceasedKnight.teamId });
    }
  }
  return key;
}

/* When a fresh rookie is being minted in a slot that has a lineage
   chain, this returns either:
     - a lineage-inheriting full name (e.g. "Crash Bristlebeard the Third")
     - null, if the chain ends or random roll says fresh start
   Inheritance probability: 55% if there's any chain. The chain advances
   regardless when inherited; a non-inherited slot doesn't break the
   chain (so a future rookie at that slot can still pick it up).
   Caps out at LINEAGE_ORDINALS.length to prevent absurd ordinals. */
function _drawLineageNameFor(teamId, position) {
  if (!LEAGUE.lineages) return null;
  // Find the most-recently-extended chain for this team+position pair
  // (there can be multiple parallel chains if e.g. two distinct surnames
  // both held the slot at different times).
  const candidates = [];
  for (const key of Object.keys(LEAGUE.lineages)) {
    const c = LEAGUE.lineages[key];
    if (c.teamId === teamId && c.position === position && c.nextOrdinalIndex < LINEAGE_ORDINALS.length) {
      candidates.push(c);
    }
  }
  if (candidates.length === 0) return null;
  // Sort by most-recent predecessor death (proxy for chain liveness)
  candidates.sort((a, b) => {
    const aSeason = a.predecessors[a.predecessors.length - 1]?.deceasedSeason || 0;
    const bSeason = b.predecessors[b.predecessors.length - 1]?.deceasedSeason || 0;
    return bSeason - aSeason;
  });
  const chain = candidates[0];
  // Roll for inheritance — 55%
  if (Math.random() > 0.55) return null;
  // Generate a fresh first name + the chain's surname + the next ordinal
  const firstName = (typeof genFirstName === "function") ? genFirstName() : "Knight";
  const ordinal = LINEAGE_ORDINALS[chain.nextOrdinalIndex];
  chain.nextOrdinalIndex++;
  return `${firstName} ${chain.surname} ${ordinal}`;
}

/* v37.4: Normalize a user-supplied custom team into the shape the rest
   of the engine expects. Fills in sensible defaults for any optional
   fields the user omitted, so a minimal { id, name, short, emoji, color }
   spec produces a fully working team. */
function _normalizeCustomTeam(ct) {
  return {
    id: String(ct.id).slice(0, 4).toUpperCase(),
    name: ct.name,
    short: ct.short || ct.name,
    emoji: ct.emoji || "🏳️",
    color: ct.color || "#888888",
    secondaryColor: ct.secondaryColor || ct.color || "#888888",
    city: ct.city || "Custom",
    venue: ct.venue || "Custom Field",
    style: ct.style || "balanced",
    lore: ct.lore || "A custom team added by the trainer.",
    founded: ct.founded || 36,
    isCustom: true,  // flag for UI to mark with a USER badge
  };
}

/* ============================================================
   BRACKET SCHEDULER — random seeding each season.
   Supports three formats (set via LEAGUE_CONFIG.bracketSize):
     4  → semi1, semi2, final
     8  → qf1..qf4, sf1, sf2, final
     12 → ql1..ql4 (qualifier round, 8 teams), then qf1..qf4, sf1, sf2, final
          (Top 4 ranked teams get byes; bottom 8 play qualifiers.)
   The bracket is stored as an ordered list of slots so advanceBracket()
   can step through them generically.
   ============================================================ */
function buildBracket() {
  const size = (LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.bracketSize) || 4;
  const teams = shuffle(TEAMS.map(t => t.id));
  LEAGUE.bracket = { _order: [] };

  if (size === 4) {
    // Pick 4 random teams from the league
    const chosen = teams.slice(0, 4);
    LEAGUE.bracket.semi1 = { teamA: chosen[0], teamB: chosen[1], winner: null, casualties: [], depends: null };
    LEAGUE.bracket.semi2 = { teamA: chosen[2], teamB: chosen[3], winner: null, casualties: [], depends: null };
    LEAGUE.bracket.final = { teamA: null, teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["semi1","semi2"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket._order = ["semi1", "semi2", "final"];
  } else if (size === 8) {
    const chosen = teams.slice(0, 8);
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      LEAGUE.bracket["qf" + (i+1)] = { teamA: chosen[i*2], teamB: chosen[i*2+1], winner: null, casualties: [], depends: null };
    }
    LEAGUE.bracket.sf1 = { teamA: null, teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["qf1","qf2"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket.sf2 = { teamA: null, teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["qf3","qf4"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket.final = { teamA: null, teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["sf1","sf2"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket._order = ["qf1","qf2","qf3","qf4","sf1","sf2","final"];
  } else if (size === 12) {
    // Top 4 by championships (then by wins) get byes; bottom 8 play qualifiers
    const ranked = TEAMS.slice().sort((a, b) => {
      const ra = LEAGUE.records[a.id] || { championships: 0, wins: 0 };
      const rb = LEAGUE.records[b.id] || { championships: 0, wins: 0 };
      return (rb.championships - ra.championships) || (rb.wins - ra.wins);
    }).map(t => t.id);
    const byeTeams = ranked.slice(0, 4);
    const qualifierTeams = shuffle(ranked.slice(4));
    // 4 qualifier matches → 4 winners join the 4 byes for the 8-team ladder
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      LEAGUE.bracket["ql" + (i+1)] = { teamA: qualifierTeams[i*2], teamB: qualifierTeams[i*2+1], winner: null, casualties: [], depends: null, isQualifier: true };
    }
    // Quarterfinals: each bye-team paired with one qualifier winner
    LEAGUE.bracket.qf1 = { teamA: byeTeams[0], teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["ql1"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket.qf2 = { teamA: byeTeams[1], teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["ql2"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket.qf3 = { teamA: byeTeams[2], teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["ql3"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket.qf4 = { teamA: byeTeams[3], teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["ql4"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket.sf1 = { teamA: null, teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["qf1","qf2"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket.sf2 = { teamA: null, teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["qf3","qf4"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket.final = { teamA: null, teamB: null, winner: null, casualties: [], depends: ["sf1","sf2"] };
    LEAGUE.bracket._order = ["ql1","ql2","ql3","ql4","qf1","qf2","qf3","qf4","sf1","sf2","final"];
  }

  LEAGUE.currentSlot = LEAGUE.bracket._order[0];
}

function advanceBracket() {
  // Step through the bracket order, populating teams from dependencies.
  const order = LEAGUE.bracket._order || ["semi1", "semi2", "final"];
  const idx = order.indexOf(LEAGUE.currentSlot);
  if (idx === -1 || idx + 1 >= order.length) {
    LEAGUE.currentSlot = null;
    return;
  }
  LEAGUE.currentSlot = order[idx + 1];
  // Resolve dependencies: pull team IDs from earlier slots' winners
  const slot = LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot];
  if (slot.depends) {
    if (slot.teamA == null && slot.depends[0]) slot.teamA = LEAGUE.bracket[slot.depends[0]].winner;
    if (slot.teamB == null && slot.depends[1]) slot.teamB = LEAGUE.bracket[slot.depends[1]].winner;
    // 12-team qf slots have only one dependency (the qualifier winner fills slot B)
    else if (slot.teamB == null && slot.depends[0] && slot.teamA) {
      slot.teamB = LEAGUE.bracket[slot.depends[0]].winner;
    }
  }
}

function activeMatchTeams() {
  if (!LEAGUE.currentSlot) return null;
  const m = LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot];
  return { slot: LEAGUE.currentSlot, teamA: m.teamA, teamB: m.teamB, match: m };
}

/* ============================================================
   ROSTER MAINTENANCE — replacement of deceased between matches
   Mortality is permanent; rookies replace dead at the SAME position
   so each team always has one of each archetype.
   ============================================================ */
function reapDeceased() {
  // Move dead players from active rosters to graveyard, then call up rookies.
  const callups = [];
  for (const team of TEAMS) {
    const roster = LEAGUE.rosters[team.id];
    for (let i = 0; i < roster.length; i++) {
      const p = roster[i];
      if (p.deceased) {
        // Already dead — make sure they're in graveyard, then replace
        const pos = POS_BY_ID[p.position];
        const rookie = makePlayer(team.id, pos);
        rookie.debutSeason = LEAGUE.season;
        // === v37.16: lineage name override ===
        // If a lineage chain exists for this team+position pair, draw
        // a successor name with the incremented ordinal. Otherwise the
        // makePlayer-generated random name stands.
        if (typeof _drawLineageNameFor === "function") {
          const lineageName = _drawLineageNameFor(team.id, pos.id);
          if (lineageName) {
            rookie.name = lineageName;
            rookie.lineageOf = p.id; // back-reference for lore-style display
          }
        }
        roster[i] = rookie;
        callups.push({ team: team.id, rookie, replaced: p });
      }
    }
  }
  return callups;
}

/* ============================================================
   v28.16: backfillRosters — guarantee every team has full roster
   integrity before a match starts.

   Where reapDeceased only walks the existing roster array slot-by-slot
   and replaces deceased players in their slot, this function performs
   structural integrity checks:

     1. Every team in TEAMS has a roster entry (creates if missing)
     2. Every POSITION is represented by a NON-DECEASED knight on each
        team (mints a fresh rookie if the slot is missing or all the
        knights at that position are deceased).
     3. No duplicate positions on a team — if a roster has two snipers
        and zero healers, the extra sniper is reaped and a healer rookie
        is minted.
     4. Roster size never exceeds POSITIONS.length (prunes extras into
        the graveyard).

   Edge cases this fixes that reapDeceased did not:
   - Save corruption that drops a position
   - Forward-pool drift after a new archetype is added in a future patch
   - Hand-edited saves with malformed rosters
   - Mid-match crashes that left the roster in an odd state
   - The position-shuffle bug where a roster could end up with two of
     one position and zero of another after edge-case casualty cascades

   Called from:
     - startMatch (defensive — runs before every match)
     - advanceSeason (already called there)
     - deserializeLeague (after restoring from save)
     - initLeague is unaffected (rosters are minted fresh)
   ============================================================ */
function backfillRosters() {
  const callups = [];
  const reaped  = [];
  for (const team of TEAMS) {
    if (!LEAGUE.rosters[team.id]) {
      // Whole team missing — build from scratch
      LEAGUE.rosters[team.id] = POSITIONS.map(pos => {
        const knight = makePlayer(team.id, pos);
        knight.debutSeason = LEAGUE.season;
        callups.push({ team: team.id, rookie: knight, reason: "team_missing" });
        return knight;
      });
      continue;
    }
    const roster = LEAGUE.rosters[team.id];

    // Step 1: Bucket existing knights by position. Each position should
    // have exactly one ALIVE (non-deceased) knight on the active roster.
    // Multiple non-deceased at the same position is a bug from upstream
    // — we preserve the first and demote the rest to the graveyard so
    // their gear isn't lost.
    const byPosition = {};
    for (const pos of POSITIONS) byPosition[pos.id] = [];
    for (const p of roster) {
      if (byPosition[p.position]) byPosition[p.position].push(p);
    }

    // Step 2: For each position, ensure exactly one non-deceased knight.
    const newRoster = [];
    for (const pos of POSITIONS) {
      const candidates = byPosition[pos.id] || [];
      // Pick the first non-deceased knight as the active one
      const alive = candidates.find(p => !p.deceased);
      if (alive) {
        newRoster.push(alive);
        // Any other non-deceased knights at this position → graveyard
        // (this is a bug recovery path; in normal play no team will
        // ever have two non-deceased knights at the same position).
        for (const other of candidates) {
          if (other !== alive && !other.deceased) {
            other.deceased = true;
            other.deceasedSeason = LEAGUE.season;
            other.deceasedBy = "Roster reorganization";
            // === v37.23.8: explicit-field push to avoid circular refs ===
            // Pushing the raw player object captured _patient (Healer AI's
            // reference to a teammate), which made the graveyard array
            // non-serializable. The explicit-field pattern keeps only what
            // the memorial UI needs.
            LEAGUE.graveyard.push({
              name: other.name, teamId: other.teamId, position: other.position,
              season: LEAGUE.season, killer: null, killerTeam: null,
              slot: null, round: null,
              finalKills: (other.career && other.career.kills) || 0,
              finalLongestStreak: (other.career && other.career.longestStreak) || 0,
              finalSeasonsPlayed: (other.career && other.career.seasonsPlayed) || 0,
              finalMatchesWon: (other.career && other.career.matchesWon) || 0,
              cause: "Roster reorganization",
            });
            reaped.push({ team: team.id, knight: other, reason: "duplicate_position" });
          }
        }
      } else {
        // No living knight at this position — mint a rookie.
        const rookie = makePlayer(team.id, pos);
        rookie.debutSeason = LEAGUE.season;
        // === v37.16: lineage name override ===
        // Same as reapDeceased — if a chain exists, draw the next name.
        if (typeof _drawLineageNameFor === "function") {
          const lineageName = _drawLineageNameFor(team.id, pos.id);
          if (lineageName) rookie.name = lineageName;
        }
        newRoster.push(rookie);
        const reason = candidates.length === 0 ? "missing_position" : "all_deceased_at_position";
        callups.push({ team: team.id, rookie, reason });
        // Move any deceased knights at this position into the graveyard
        // if they weren't already there (defensive — they should be).
        for (const dead of candidates) {
          // === v37.23.8: explicit-field push (see note above) ===
          // Was pushing the raw player object, capturing _patient and
          // making the graveyard non-serializable. Now match by id+season
          // for dedup instead of object identity.
          const alreadyInGraveyard = LEAGUE.graveyard.some(g =>
            g.name === dead.name && g.teamId === dead.teamId && g.season === dead.deceasedSeason
          );
          if (!alreadyInGraveyard) {
            LEAGUE.graveyard.push({
              name: dead.name, teamId: dead.teamId, position: dead.position,
              season: dead.deceasedSeason || LEAGUE.season,
              killer: null, killerTeam: null,
              slot: null, round: null,
              finalKills: (dead.career && dead.career.kills) || 0,
              finalLongestStreak: (dead.career && dead.career.longestStreak) || 0,
              finalSeasonsPlayed: (dead.career && dead.career.seasonsPlayed) || 0,
              finalMatchesWon: (dead.career && dead.career.matchesWon) || 0,
              cause: dead.deceasedBy || "Unknown",
            });
          }
        }
      }
    }
    LEAGUE.rosters[team.id] = newRoster;
  }
  return { callups, reaped };
}
window.backfillRosters = backfillRosters;

/* ============================================================
   ITEM SYSTEM (shop boosts)
   Carried over from v2 — purchased between matches, applied once.
   ============================================================ */
// Shop items have a rarity tier that gates pricing + visual treatment.

function applyBoosts(teamId, players) {
  // Apply pending team-wide boost (if any) to a team's players for this match.
  const boost = LEAGUE.pendingBoosts[teamId];
  if (boost) {
    for (const p of players) {
      if (boost.hp)   p.hp = Math.min(CAPS.hp, p.hp + boost.hp);
      if (boost.dmg)  p.stats = { ...p.stats, dmg:  clamp(p.stats.dmg + boost.dmg,  1, CAPS.dmg) };
      if (boost.def)  p.stats = { ...p.stats, def:  clamp(p.stats.def + boost.def,  0, CAPS.def) };
      if (boost.spd)  p.stats = { ...p.stats, spd:  clamp(+(p.stats.spd + boost.spd).toFixed(2), 0.6, CAPS.spd) };
      if (boost.crit) p.stats = { ...p.stats, crit: clamp(p.stats.crit + boost.crit, 0.02, 0.50) };
    }
    delete LEAGUE.pendingBoosts[teamId];
  }
  // === v28.1: Apply per-knight targeted boosts (Personal Sandbag etc.) ===
  // pendingTargetedBoosts: { teamId: { knightId: { spd, dmg, ... } } }
  if (LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts && LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts[teamId]) {
    const targeted = LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts[teamId];
    for (const p of players) {
      const tb = targeted[p.id];
      if (!tb) continue;
      if (tb.hp)   p.hp = Math.min(CAPS.hp, p.hp + tb.hp);
      if (tb.dmg)  p.stats = { ...p.stats, dmg:  clamp(p.stats.dmg + tb.dmg,  1, CAPS.dmg) };
      if (tb.def)  p.stats = { ...p.stats, def:  clamp(p.stats.def + tb.def,  0, CAPS.def) };
      if (tb.spd)  p.stats = { ...p.stats, spd:  clamp(+(p.stats.spd + tb.spd).toFixed(2), 0.6, CAPS.spd) };
      if (tb.crit) p.stats = { ...p.stats, crit: clamp(p.stats.crit + tb.crit, 0.02, 0.50) };
    }
    delete LEAGUE.pendingTargetedBoosts[teamId];
  }
}

</script>

<script>
'use strict';

/* ============================================================
   COMMENTARY FEED (in-memory, capped)
   ============================================================ */
const FEED = [];
const FEED_MAX = 60;

function feed(kind, msg) {
  const ts = LEAGUE.match
    ? `${String(Math.floor(LEAGUE.match.frame / 20)).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(LEAGUE.match.frame % 20 * 5).padStart(2,"0")}`
    : "--:--";
  FEED.unshift({ kind, msg, ts });
  if (FEED.length > FEED_MAX) FEED.length = FEED_MAX;
  if (typeof renderFeed === "function") renderFeed();
}

/* ============================================================
   SPORTSCASTER COMMENTARY — separate channel from the kill feed.
   Pulls from large tonally-categorized pools and pushes lines as
   they happen. Optional AI enhancement via ai-text-plugin (hook
   at the bottom): if the plugin is present and responds, it can
   replace the static line with a fresher take. Static pool
   ALWAYS fires first so there's no latency hole.

   Channels: "play-by-play" (raw event description) and "color"
   (analyst-style observation about the meta of the moment).
   ============================================================ */
const COMMENTARY = [];      // most-recent first
const COMMENTARY_MAX = 40;

function commentate(kind, line, opts) {
  if (!line) return;
  opts = opts || {};
  const ts = LEAGUE.match
    ? `${String(Math.floor(LEAGUE.match.frame / 20)).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(LEAGUE.match.frame % 20 * 5).padStart(2,"0")}`
    : "--:--";
  const entry = {
    kind,                                 // "play"|"color"|"chant"|"opener"
    line,
    ts,
    flavor: opts.flavor || null,          // "hype"|"deadpan"|"sad"|"chaotic"
    isAi: !!opts.isAi,
    id: COMMENTARY_MAX_ID++,
  };
  COMMENTARY.unshift(entry);
  if (COMMENTARY.length > COMMENTARY_MAX) COMMENTARY.length = COMMENTARY_MAX;
  if (typeof renderCommentary === "function") renderCommentary();
  // Async AI enhancement — does NOT block the sim. If the plugin returns
  // a different/better line, it updates the entry in place.
  if (opts.aiContext && typeof requestAiCommentaryEnhancement === "function") {
    requestAiCommentaryEnhancement(entry, opts.aiContext);
  }
  return entry;
}
let COMMENTARY_MAX_ID = 1;

function deathCryFor(defender, attacker, ctx) {
  // ctx: { isCrit, isPermadeath, wasOnStreak, wasStunned, isSelfDestruct }
  ctx = ctx || {};
  let pool;
  if (ctx.isSelfDestruct) pool = DEATH_CRIES_SELFDESTRUCT;
  else if (ctx.isPermadeath) pool = DEATH_CRIES_LASTLIFE;
  else if (ctx.wasOnStreak) pool = DEATH_CRIES_STREAKBROKEN;
  else if (ctx.wasStunned) pool = DEATH_CRIES_STUNNED;
  else if (ctx.isCrit) pool = DEATH_CRIES_CRIT;
  else pool = DEATH_CRIES_GENERIC;
  return pick(pool);
}
