function taunt(phrase, p, m) {
  if (!phrase || !p || !m) return;
  m.floats.push({
    x: p.x, y: p.y - 22,
    text: phrase,
    life: 50,
    color: "#f7c948",
  });
  feed("kill", `📣 ${p.name}: "${phrase}"`);
}
function phrasePick(pool, vars) {
  let s = pick(pool);
  for (const k of Object.keys(vars)) {
    s = s.replaceAll("{" + k + "}", vars[k]);
  }
  return s;
}

/* ============================================================
   MATCH INITIALIZATION (best-of-N rounds)
   - startMatch() sets up match-level state, resets lives, then
     immediately starts round 1.
   - startRound() fields all eligible players (lives > 0, !deceased),
     positions them, fires "start" items on round 1, sets phase = "round".
   ============================================================ */
function startMatch() {
  if (!LEAGUE.currentSlot) return;
  const b = LEAGUE.bracket[LEAGUE.currentSlot];
  if (!b.teamA || !b.teamB) return;

  // SAFETY NET — ensure both teams have full living rosters BEFORE we filter.
  // v28.16: replaced reapDeceased with backfillRosters for full structural
  // integrity. Catches not just "deceased in slot" but also missing positions,
  // duplicates, oversized rosters from corrupted saves, etc.
  const { callups, reaped } = backfillRosters();
  for (const c of callups) {
    const team = TEAM_BY_ID[c.team];
    const posLabel = POS_BY_ID[c.rookie.position]?.label || c.rookie.position;
    if (c.reason === "missing_position" || c.reason === "team_missing") {
      feed("spawn", `🆕 ${team.name} field a fresh rookie: ${c.rookie.name} (${posLabel}).`);
    } else if (c.reason === "all_deceased_at_position") {
      feed("spawn", `📣 Emergency call-up: ${c.rookie.name} (${posLabel}) takes the empty ${team.name} ${posLabel} slot.`);
    } else {
      feed("spawn", `📣 ${team.name} call-up: ${c.rookie.name} (${posLabel}).`);
    }
  }
  for (const r of reaped) {
    if (r.reason === "duplicate_position") {
      const team = TEAM_BY_ID[r.team];
      const posLabel = POS_BY_ID[r.knight.position]?.label || r.knight.position;
      feed("spawn", `📋 ${team.name}: ${r.knight.name} reassigned (duplicate ${posLabel} slot).`);
    }
  }

  // DETERMINISTIC SEED — same season + slot ALWAYS produces the same match.
  // This is the foundation for shared live matches: two clients running with
  // the same league state will see identical kill orders, dodges, drops, and
  // outcomes. Each match's seed is a hash of (season, slot, season-genesis).
  const matchSeed = computeMatchSeed(LEAGUE.season, LEAGUE.currentSlot);
  SIM_RNG.reseed(matchSeed);
  BIOME_RNG.reseed(matchSeed);

  // === v37.23: process injury counters and exclude injured knights ===
  // Decrement matchesRemaining on all injured knights NOT in the match
  // (they sit out this one). Active-line filter excludes any knight
  // currently injured.
  if (typeof _processInjuryStatuses === "function") {
    _processInjuryStatuses(b.teamA);
    _processInjuryStatuses(b.teamB);
  }

  const teamA = LEAGUE.rosters[b.teamA].filter(p => !p.deceased && !p.injury);
  const teamB = LEAGUE.rosters[b.teamB].filter(p => !p.deceased && !p.injury);

  // === v37.23: emergency call-up if injuries opened a position ===
  // If a position is empty in either team's active line because of
  // injuries, mint a rookie to fill it. The roster already has the
  // injured knight; this rookie is a temporary cover and joins the
  // pool permanently (will compete for the slot when the injured
  // returns; backfillRosters next match will reconcile).
  for (const teamId of [b.teamA, b.teamB]) {
    const teamRoster = LEAGUE.rosters[teamId];
    const lineup = teamId === b.teamA ? teamA : teamB;
    const filledPositions = new Set(lineup.map(p => p.position));
    for (const pos of POSITIONS) {
      if (!filledPositions.has(pos.id)) {
        const rookie = makePlayer(teamId, pos);
        rookie.debutSeason = LEAGUE.season;
        if (typeof _drawLineageNameFor === "function") {
          const lineageName = _drawLineageNameFor(teamId, pos.id);
          if (lineageName) rookie.name = lineageName;
        }
        teamRoster.push(rookie);
        lineup.push(rookie);
        feed("spawn", `🪖 ${TEAM_BY_ID[teamId]?.short}: ${escapeHTML(rookie.name)} called up to cover injured ${pos.label}.`);
      }
    }
  }

  // Reset match-level state on every player going into this match
  for (const p of [...teamA, ...teamB]) {
    p.lives = MATCH.startingLives;
    p.itemUsed = false;
    p.boostMods = null;
    p.balloonsPopped = 0;
    // === v37.23: clear any stale stat penalty cache from prior injury ===
    // (Re-applied below if applicable.)
    if (p._origStats) {
      p.stats = p._origStats;
      delete p._origStats;
    }
  }

  // Apply pending shop boosts (consumed once per match)
  applyBoosts(b.teamA, teamA);
  applyBoosts(b.teamB, teamB);

  LEAGUE.match = {
    slot: LEAGUE.currentSlot,
    teamAId: b.teamA, teamBId: b.teamB,
    teamAplayers: teamA, teamBplayers: teamB,
    bestOf: MATCH.bestOf,
    roundsToWin: MATCH.roundsToWin,
    roundsWonA: 0, roundsWonB: 0,
    rounds: [],
    currentRoundIndex: 0,
    phase: "preRound",
    frame: 0,
    roundFrame: 0,
    killsByTeam: { [b.teamA]: 0, [b.teamB]: 0 },
    firstKillTeam: null,
    blood: [],
    corpses: [],
    floats: [],
    drops: [],
    projectiles: [],
    terrain: generateTerrain(),  // randomized obstacles for this match
    biome: pickBiomeForMatch(),  // visual variety per match
    scatter: [],                 // populated below
    clouds: generateCloudShadows(),
    ambient: [],                 // populated below
    winnerId: null,
    // === v28: game mode ===
    // Captured at match-start so changing LEAGUE_CONFIG.gameMode mid-match
    // doesn't fight in-flight state. The corresponding mode entities
    // (crown / flag / bases) are initialized below.
    gameMode: LEAGUE_CONFIG.gameMode || "deathmatch",
    modeScoreA: 0,
    modeScoreB: 0,
    modeWinner: null,
  };
  _initModeEntities(LEAGUE.match);
  // Scatter + ambient have to be generated AFTER biome is set
  LEAGUE.match.scatter = generateBiomeScatter(LEAGUE.match.biome);
  LEAGUE.match.ambient = generateAmbientParticles(LEAGUE.match.biome);

  feed("match", phrasePick(PHRASE_MATCH_START, {
    a: TEAM_BY_ID[b.teamA].emoji + " " + TEAM_BY_ID[b.teamA].short,
    b: TEAM_BY_ID[b.teamB].emoji + " " + TEAM_BY_ID[b.teamB].short,
  }));

  // === Sportscaster opener + pre-match chants ===
  const tA = TEAM_BY_ID[b.teamA], tB = TEAM_BY_ID[b.teamB];
  commentate("opener", ccPick(COMM_MATCH_OPEN, {
    a: tA.emoji + " " + tA.short,
    b: tB.emoji + " " + tB.short,
  }), { flavor: "hype", aiContext: { type: "matchOpen", teamA: tA, teamB: tB } });

  // Each team shouts a chant — pulled from per-team chants array
  if (tA.chants && tA.chants.length) {
    commentate("chant", `${tA.emoji} ${tA.short}: "${pick(tA.chants)}"`, { flavor: "hype" });
  }
  if (tB.chants && tB.chants.length) {
    commentate("chant", `${tB.emoji} ${tB.short}: "${pick(tB.chants)}"`, { flavor: "hype" });
  }

  // === v37.23: surface mutual rivalries on the field ===
  // If two knights with a 3+/3+ history are facing off, drop a feed line
  // (and a small toast) so the user knows to watch the duel.
  if (typeof detectActiveRivalries === "function") {
    const rivalries = detectActiveRivalries(LEAGUE.match);
    for (const r of rivalries) {
      const taShort = TEAM_BY_ID[r.aKnight.teamId]?.short || "?";
      const tbShort = TEAM_BY_ID[r.bKnight.teamId]?.short || "?";
      feed("season", `⚔️ Active rivalry on the field: ${escapeHTML(r.aKnight.name)} (${taShort}) vs ${escapeHTML(r.bKnight.name)} (${tbShort}) — ${r.aKilledB}–${r.bKilledA}.`);
    }
    if (rivalries.length > 0 && typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
      const r = rivalries[0]; // surface only the first as a toast
      window.toast(
        `⚔️ Rivalry on the field: <b>${escapeHTML(r.aKnight.name)}</b> vs <b>${escapeHTML(r.bKnight.name)}</b>`,
        "info",
        { ico: "⚔️", ttl: 5000 }
      );
    }
  }

  // === v37.16: surface followed knights in this match ===
  // If any of the user's starred knights are on the field, drop a
  // distinctive toast naming them and a feed line so the user notices.
  // Cross-checking across both teams; tA & tB rosters are in m.teamAplayers
  // / m.teamBplayers when available, otherwise in LEAGUE.rosters.
  if (LEAGUE.followedKnights && LEAGUE.followedKnights.length > 0) {
    const m = LEAGUE.match;
    const fielded = [];
    const checkRoster = (roster) => {
      if (!roster) return;
      for (const p of roster) {
        if (LEAGUE.followedKnights.indexOf(p.id) !== -1 && !p.deceased) {
          fielded.push(p);
        }
      }
    };
    if (m && m.teamAplayers) checkRoster(m.teamAplayers);
    if (m && m.teamBplayers) checkRoster(m.teamBplayers);
    // Fallback: scan team rosters if match-state players aren't ready yet
    if (fielded.length === 0) {
      checkRoster(LEAGUE.rosters[b.teamA]);
      checkRoster(LEAGUE.rosters[b.teamB]);
    }
    if (fielded.length > 0) {
      const names = fielded.map(p => p.name).join(", ");
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
        window.toast(
          `⭐ Your followed knight${fielded.length === 1 ? " is" : "s are"} on the field: <b>${escapeHTML(names)}</b>`,
          "info",
          { ico: "⭐", ttl: 6000 }
        );
      }
      if (typeof feed === "function") {
        feed("season", `⭐ Followed: ${names} (this match).`);
      }
    }
  }

  // Begin round 1 immediately
  startRound();
}

function startRound() {
  const m = LEAGUE.match;
  if (!m) return;
  // v28.16: defensive structural-integrity check on the league pool. Within
  // an active match this is almost always a no-op (deceased flag doesn't
  // flip until match end), but it's safe to run and protects against any
  // edge-case path that left the pool malformed. New rookies don't join
  // THIS match — they're available in their team's pool for the next.
  if (typeof backfillRosters === "function") {
    const { callups: roundCallups } = backfillRosters();
    for (const c of roundCallups) {
      const team = TEAM_BY_ID[c.team];
      const posLabel = POS_BY_ID[c.rookie.position]?.label || c.rookie.position;
      feed("spawn", `🆕 ${team.name} pool: ${c.rookie.name} (${posLabel}) added between rounds.`);
    }
    // === v37.22: mid-match rookie infusion ===
    // Earlier, new rookies sat in the league pool until next match — so
    // a team that lost their Sniper to permadeath in round 2 played the
    // rest of the match short-handed (5 vs 7, etc). The user (correctly)
    // flagged this as imbalance. Now: any new rookie minted by the
    // between-rounds backfill ALSO gets injected into the current match's
    // active line, with full lives. They dress for the next round.
    const matchTeamArrays = {
      [m.teamAId]: m.teamAplayers,
      [m.teamBId]: m.teamBplayers,
    };
    for (const c of roundCallups) {
      const teamArr = matchTeamArrays[c.team];
      if (!teamArr) continue; // rookie's team isn't in the current match
      // Avoid double-add if this knight is somehow already there
      if (teamArr.some(p => p.id === c.rookie.id)) continue;
      // Init match-state on the rookie so they're round-ready
      c.rookie.lives = MATCH.startingLives;
      c.rookie.itemUsed = false;
      c.rookie.boostMods = null;
      c.rookie.balloonsPopped = 0;
      c.rookie.alive = true;
      c.rookie.hp = c.rookie.stats.hp;
      teamArr.push(c.rookie);
      const team = TEAM_BY_ID[c.team];
      const posLabel = POS_BY_ID[c.rookie.position]?.label || c.rookie.position;
      feed("spawn", `🪂 ${team.emoji} ${team.short}: ${c.rookie.name} drops in to fill the empty ${posLabel} slot.`);
      // === v37.23: rookie scouting report on debut feed ===
      if (typeof getScoutingReport === "function") {
        const report = getScoutingReport(c.rookie);
        if (report) feed("spawn", `📋 Scouting (${c.rookie.name}): ${report.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, "")}`);
      }
    }
    // === v37.22: invalidate the per-frame flat-players cache ===
    // tickMatch builds m._allPlayersFlat from teamAplayers+teamBplayers.
    // We just mutated those arrays, so the cache is stale. Clear it so
    // the next tickMatch rebuilds it with the new rookies included.
    m._allPlayersFlat = null;
  }
  m.currentRoundIndex++;
  m.phase = "round";
  m.roundFrame = 0;
  m.projectiles = m.projectiles || []; // ensure projectile array exists

  // Eligible players: not deceased AND have lives remaining
  const eligibleA = m.teamAplayers.filter(p => !p.deceased && p.lives > 0);
  const eligibleB = m.teamBplayers.filter(p => !p.deceased && p.lives > 0);

  if (!eligibleA.length || !eligibleB.length) {
    finalizeRound(/*forfeit*/ true);
    return;
  }

  // === v37.19: return-from-KO surface ===
  // Knights who came back from a KO last round (alive===false going
  // into this round but lives>0 so they're eligible) get a feed line
  // calling out their return — important player feedback so the user
  // sees the lives mechanic working. Limit to one feed line per team
  // per round to avoid spam in big-team-wipe rounds.
  if (m.currentRoundIndex > 1) {
    for (const team of [
      { players: eligibleA, id: m.teamAId },
      { players: eligibleB, id: m.teamBId },
    ]) {
      const returners = team.players.filter(p => p.alive === false && p.lives > 0);
      if (returners.length > 0) {
        const t = TEAM_BY_ID[team.id];
        if (returners.length === 1) {
          feed("spawn", `🔁 ${t.emoji} ${t.short}: ${returners[0].name} returns for round ${m.currentRoundIndex} (${returners[0].lives} ${returners[0].lives === 1 ? "life" : "lives"} left).`);
        } else {
          feed("spawn", `🔁 ${t.emoji} ${t.short}: ${returners.length} knights return for round ${m.currentRoundIndex}.`);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // === v37.19: defensive sanity-reset ===
  // layoutTeam below ALSO resets alive=true and hp=full, but we
  // explicitly do it here as defense-in-depth. If any code path
  // ever leaves a knight with lives>0 but stuck at alive=false
  // outside layoutTeam's scope, this catches it.
  for (const p of [...eligibleA, ...eligibleB]) {
    p.alive = true;
    p.hp = p.stats.hp;
    p.balloonsPopped = 0;
    p._pendingRespawn = false;
  }

  layoutTeam(eligibleA, "left");
  layoutTeam(eligibleB, "right");

  // Spawn neutral items on the field. Round 1 gets the full set (3 Health
  // Packs + 2 Armor + 3 random); later rounds refresh if the field is
  // sparse (re-stock so survivors don't fight over scraps).
  if (m.currentRoundIndex === 1) {
    spawnNeutralItems(m, 8);
  } else {
    if (m.drops.length < 4) spawnNeutralItems(m, 4);
  }

  if (m.currentRoundIndex === 1) {
    for (const p of [...eligibleA, ...eligibleB]) {
      if (p.item && p.item.trigger === "start" && !p.itemUsed) {
        applyItemTrigger(p);
      }
    }
  }

  feed("match", `🔔 Round ${m.currentRoundIndex} of ${m.bestOf} — fight!`);
}

/* ============================================================
   POWER CORE — center-of-arena objective.
   Spawns ~10sec into the round and pulses with golden light.
   Walking into it grants your TEAM a damage buff for 8 sec.
   After capture, respawns 30 sec later. Gives AI a strong
   reason to push the center.
   ============================================================ */
function tickPowerCore(m) {
  if (!m.powerCore) {
    m.powerCore = { state: "spawning", spawnAtFrame: 200, x: COMBAT.arenaW / 2, y: COMBAT.arenaH / 2 };
  }
  const pc = m.powerCore;
  const frame = m.roundFrame;

  if (pc.state === "spawning" && frame >= pc.spawnAtFrame) {
    pc.state = "active";
    pc.spawnedFrame = frame;
    feed("item", `⚡ POWER CORE has spawned at the center of the arena!`);
  }

  if (pc.state === "active") {
    // Check if any alive knight is touching it
    // === v37.21: use cached flat array instead of allocating ===
    const all = m._allPlayersFlat || m.teamAplayers.concat(m.teamBplayers);
    for (const p of all) {
      if (!p.alive) continue;
      const dx = p.x - pc.x, dy = p.y - pc.y;
      if (dx*dx + dy*dy < 14*14) {
        // Captured!
        const team = TEAM_BY_ID[p.teamId];
        feed("item", `⚡ ${p.name} captures the POWER CORE — ${team.short} gets +25% DMG!`);
        m.floats.push({ x: pc.x, y: pc.y - 16, text: "CAPTURED", life: 40, color: team.color });
        // Apply team buff
        const teammates = (p.teamId === m.teamAId ? m.teamAplayers : m.teamBplayers);
        for (const t of teammates) {
          if (!t.alive) continue;
          if (!t.boostMods) t.boostMods = {};
          t.boostMods.dmgMult = 1.25;
          t.boostMods.life = 160; // 8 sec at 20fps
        }
        if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
          window.toast(`⚡ <b>${team.short}</b> captures POWER CORE — +25% damage for 8s`, "info", { ico: "⚡", ttl: 5000 });
        }
        // Sportscaster
        if (typeof commentate === "function") {
          commentate("play", ccPick(COMM_CORE_CAPTURE, { tm: team.emoji + " " + team.short }), { flavor: "hype" });
        }
        pc.state = "respawn";
        pc.respawnAtFrame = frame + 600; // 30 sec
        pc.lastCapturedTeam = p.teamId;
        pc.lastCapturedFrame = frame;
        break;
      }
    }
  } else if (pc.state === "respawn" && frame >= pc.respawnAtFrame) {
    pc.state = "active";
    pc.spawnedFrame = frame;
    feed("item", `⚡ POWER CORE respawns at the center.`);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   GAME MODES (v28) — KOTH, CTF, Melee Tag

   Three new modes layered over the standard match runtime. Each
   mode hooks the match through three points:

     1. _initModeEntities(m) — called once at startMatch to set
        up crown / flag / bases / "It" assignment.
     2. tickGameMode(m) — called every tick from tickMatch to
        run mode-specific scoring + entity updates.
     3. checkModeWinCondition(m) — called every tick to detect
        the score threshold; sets m.modeWinner when done.

   Deathmatch is unaffected (the round-elimination flow keeps
   running). The new modes set m.gameMode to their id and use
   m.modeScoreA / m.modeScoreB for scoring instead of the
   round-win counts.
   ============================================================ */

function _initModeEntities(m) {
  const mode = m.gameMode || "deathmatch";
  const modeCfg = (LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig || {})[mode] || {};
  const W = COMBAT.arenaW, H = COMBAT.arenaH;
  const cx = W / 2, cy = H / 2;

  if (mode === "koth") {
    // Crown spawns at center, no current carrier.
    m.crown = {
      x: cx, y: cy,
      carrierId: null,
      carrierTeamId: null,
      // Sub-frame accumulator so tick-points-per-second translates cleanly
      // at 20fps sim rate (frameMs = 50ms).
      pointsAccum: 0,
    };
  } else if (mode === "ctf") {
    // Flag spawns at center; bases spawn at each team's spawn area.
    m.flag = {
      x: cx, y: cy,
      homeX: cx, homeY: cy,
      carrierId: null,
      carrierTeamId: null,
      droppedAtFrame: -1,  // -1 = at home, >=0 = dropped (will return after timeout)
      returnAfterFrames: Math.round((modeCfg.flagReturnSec || 8) * 1000 / COMBAT.frameMs),
    };
    m.basesById = {
      [m.teamAId]: { x: 80, y: cy, teamId: m.teamAId },
      [m.teamBId]: { x: W - 80, y: cy, teamId: m.teamBId },
    };
  } else if (mode === "tag") {
    // Pick a random "It" from team A's roster (deterministic via SIM_RNG).
    const all = [...m.teamAplayers, ...m.teamBplayers].filter(p => !p.deceased);
    if (all.length > 0) {
      const itIdx = Math.floor(SIM_RNG.next() * all.length);
      const it = all[itIdx];
      m.tag = {
        itId: it.id,
        // tagFreezes maps frozenPlayerId → frame the freeze ends.
        tagFreezes: Object.create(null),
      };
      // Mark the It bot so AI can branch on it (we read m.tag.itId in AI dispatch).
    }
  }
}

/* Master mode tick — dispatches to per-mode logic. Called from tickMatch
   after all per-player ticks have run, so player positions for this frame
   are already finalized. */
function tickGameMode(m) {
  const mode = m.gameMode || "deathmatch";
  if (mode === "koth") tickKOTH(m);
  else if (mode === "ctf") tickCTF(m);
  else if (mode === "tag") tickTag(m);
  // deathmatch needs no extra tick — round logic handles everything
  if (mode !== "deathmatch") {
    // v28.18: respawn KO'd knights with lives remaining (continuous modes)
    if (typeof tickRespawns === "function") tickRespawns(m);
    checkModeWinCondition(m);
  }
}

/* ----- KOTH ----- */
function tickKOTH(m) {
  const c = m.crown;
  if (!c) return;
  const cfg = LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig.koth;
  const all = (m._allPlayersFlat || m.teamAplayers.concat(m.teamBplayers)).filter(p => p.alive);

  // If carrier is dead/null, find a new pickup (any bot within 16px)
  const carrier = c.carrierId ? all.find(p => p.id === c.carrierId) : null;
  if (!carrier) {
    c.carrierId = null;
    c.carrierTeamId = null;
    for (const p of all) {
      const dx = p.x - c.x, dy = p.y - c.y;
      if (dx*dx + dy*dy < 16*16) {
        c.carrierId = p.id;
        c.carrierTeamId = p.teamId;
        feed("match", `👑 ${p.name} grabs the crown for ${TEAM_BY_ID[p.teamId].short}!`);
        break;
      }
    }
  } else {
    // Crown follows the carrier
    c.x = carrier.x;
    c.y = carrier.y - 20; // floats above their head
  }

  // Carrier scores points over time (frame-rate-agnostic via accumulator)
  if (c.carrierTeamId) {
    c.pointsAccum += (cfg.tickPointsPerSec || 1) / (1000 / COMBAT.frameMs);
    while (c.pointsAccum >= 1) {
      c.pointsAccum -= 1;
      if (c.carrierTeamId === m.teamAId) m.modeScoreA = (m.modeScoreA || 0) + 1;
      else m.modeScoreB = (m.modeScoreB || 0) + 1;
    }
  }
}

/* ----- CTF ----- */
function tickCTF(m) {
  const f = m.flag;
  if (!f) return;
  const all = (m._allPlayersFlat || m.teamAplayers.concat(m.teamBplayers)).filter(p => p.alive);

  // Respawn grace — after a capture, the flag is briefly uncapturable
  // so the same carrier doesn't immediately re-grab and re-cap.
  if (f.respawnGraceUntil && m.roundFrame < f.respawnGraceUntil) {
    return;
  }

  // If carrier dead/null, check for pickup
  const carrier = f.carrierId ? all.find(p => p.id === f.carrierId) : null;
  if (!carrier) {
    f.carrierId = null;
    f.carrierTeamId = null;
    for (const p of all) {
      const dx = p.x - f.x, dy = p.y - f.y;
      if (dx*dx + dy*dy < 16*16) {
        f.carrierId = p.id;
        f.carrierTeamId = p.teamId;
        f.droppedAtFrame = -1;
        feed("match", `🚩 ${p.name} grabs the flag for ${TEAM_BY_ID[p.teamId].short}!`);
        break;
      }
    }
    // Return-to-base timer if dropped (carrier was killed)
    if (f.droppedAtFrame >= 0 && (m.roundFrame - f.droppedAtFrame) >= f.returnAfterFrames) {
      f.x = f.homeX; f.y = f.homeY; f.droppedAtFrame = -1;
      feed("match", `🚩 The flag returns to center.`);
    }
  } else {
    // Flag follows carrier
    f.x = carrier.x;
    f.y = carrier.y - 20;
    // Capture check: carrier touches their own base
    const myBase = m.basesById[carrier.teamId];
    if (myBase) {
      const dbx = carrier.x - myBase.x, dby = carrier.y - myBase.y;
      if (dbx*dbx + dby*dby < 24*24) {
        // Capture!
        if (carrier.teamId === m.teamAId) m.modeScoreA = (m.modeScoreA || 0) + 1;
        else m.modeScoreB = (m.modeScoreB || 0) + 1;
        feed("match", `🏆 ${carrier.name} captures the flag! ${TEAM_BY_ID[carrier.teamId].short} +1`);
        // Reset flag — and apply 60-frame grace so this carrier doesn't
        // immediately re-grab and re-cap on the next tick.
        f.x = f.homeX; f.y = f.homeY;
        f.carrierId = null;
        f.carrierTeamId = null;
        f.droppedAtFrame = -1;
        f.respawnGraceUntil = m.roundFrame + 60;
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ----- TAG ----- */
function tickTag(m) {
  if (!m.tag) return;
  const all = m._allPlayersFlat || m.teamAplayers.concat(m.teamBplayers);
  const it = all.find(p => p.id === m.tag.itId);

  // If "It" bot died, pick a new one (highest-HP survivor)
  if (!it || !it.alive) {
    const survivors = all.filter(p => p.alive);
    if (survivors.length > 1) {
      const newIt = survivors.reduce((a, b) => (a.hp > b.hp ? a : b));
      m.tag.itId = newIt.id;
      feed("match", `🏷 ${newIt.name} is now IT!`);
    } else {
      // Only one survivor — they've won
    }
  }

  // Bleed damage on frozen bots — high enough that a single tag is often fatal
  const cfg = LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig.tag;
  const dpsTick = (cfg.tagDpsWhileFrozen || 50) / (1000 / COMBAT.frameMs);
  // Find current "It" bot to credit as the bleed-damage attacker
  const itBot = (m._allPlayersFlat || m.teamAplayers.concat(m.teamBplayers)).find(p => p.id === m.tag.itId && p.alive);
  for (const id in m.tag.tagFreezes) {
    const target = all.find(p => p.id === Number(id));
    const expireFrame = m.tag.tagFreezes[id];
    if (!target || !target.alive) {
      delete m.tag.tagFreezes[id];
      continue;
    }
    if (m.roundFrame >= expireFrame) {
      // Freeze expired
      target.stunned = 0;
      delete m.tag.tagFreezes[id];
      continue;
    }
    // Apply bleed via applyDamage so death detection (handleKO) fires
    // properly — otherwise frozen bots accumulate negative HP but stay
    // marked alive=true, breaking the win condition.
    if (itBot && typeof applyDamage === "function") {
      applyDamage(itBot, target, Math.max(1, Math.round(dpsTick)), false, m);
    } else {
      target.hp = Math.max(0, Math.round(target.hp - dpsTick));
    }
    target.stunned = Math.max(target.stunned || 0, 4);
    if (target.hp <= 0) {
      delete m.tag.tagFreezes[id];
    }
  }
}

/* Apply a tag — called from melee resolveAttack when in tag mode and
   the attacker is "It". Per spec: tagger stays "It". Target freezes for
   3 seconds (during which they take heavy bleed damage), then unfreezes
   and resumes fleeing. Bots die from cumulative tag damage; the cycle
   continues until bots fall one by one. Last bot alive = winner.
   "It" gets reassigned only if the current "It" dies. */
function applyTagHit(attacker, defender, m) {
  if (!m.tag || attacker.id !== m.tag.itId) return false;
  const cfg = LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig.tag;
  m.tag.tagFreezes[defender.id] = m.roundFrame + (cfg.tagFreezeFrames || 60);
  defender.stunned = (cfg.tagFreezeFrames || 60);
  feed("match", `⚡ ${attacker.name} TAGS ${defender.name}!`);
  // Route damage through applyDamage so handleKO fires properly on death.
  if (typeof applyDamage === "function") {
    applyDamage(attacker, defender, (cfg.tagDamagePerHit || 30), false, m);
  } else {
    defender.hp -= (cfg.tagDamagePerHit || 30);
  }
  // It does NOT pass on tag — the tagger keeps chasing.
  return true;
}

/* ============================================================
   v28.18: tickRespawns — TEAM-WAVE respawn for continuous modes
   In KOTH/CTF/Tag (single-round, continuous modes), KO'd knights
   with lives remaining are flagged with _pendingRespawn in applyKO.
   The first KO on a team also schedules a release frame in
   m._respawnWaves[teamId] = current_frame + 160 (8 seconds).

   When the release frame is reached, the ENTIRE pending team-wave
   revives in one batch:
     1. All pending knights spawn at their team's spawn line, in
        formation (vertically scattered)
     2. The slowest knight gets a temporary speed boost matching
        the second-slowest's speed (so the team can travel to center
        together — slowest no longer trails the rest)
     3. The boost duration is calculated so all knights arrive at
        the center at the same time, rounded to the nearest second

   Without this, continuous-mode matches eventually reach a state
   where one team has nobody alive and the score freezes — the
   user-reported "bots just idle around" state.
   Deathmatch is untouched: rounds reset everyone via layoutTeam.
   ============================================================ */
function tickRespawns(m) {
  if (!m || !m.gameMode || m.gameMode === "deathmatch") return;
  if (!m._respawnWaves) return;
  const f = m.roundFrame || 0;

  for (const teamId of Object.keys(m._respawnWaves)) {
    const releaseFrame = m._respawnWaves[teamId];
    if (releaseFrame == null) continue;
    if (f < releaseFrame) continue;

    // Wave releases now — gather every pending knight on this team
    const list = (teamId === m.teamAId) ? m.teamAplayers : m.teamBplayers;
    if (!list) { delete m._respawnWaves[teamId]; continue; }
    const wave = list.filter(p => p._pendingRespawn && !p.deceased);
    if (wave.length === 0) { delete m._respawnWaves[teamId]; continue; }

    // Spawn-line geometry — same as layoutTeam: left team near x=80,
    // right team near x=arenaW-80.
    const isLeftTeam = (teamId === m.teamAId);
    const baseX = isLeftTeam ? 80 : (COMBAT.arenaW - 80);
    const cy = COMBAT.arenaH / 2;

    // Sort wave by speed ASCENDING so we know which is slowest. The
    // baseline speed for boost calculation comes from p.stats.spd
    // (the live combat speed — boostMods can stack on top).
    const sortedBySpd = [...wave].sort((a, b) => (a.stats.spd || 0) - (b.stats.spd || 0));
    // Determine the target speed for boosting the slowest. With ≥2
    // knights in the wave, target = second-slowest's speed. With 1
    // knight, no boost is needed (team of one).
    let targetSpeed = null;
    if (sortedBySpd.length >= 2) {
      targetSpeed = sortedBySpd[1].stats.spd || 0;
    }

    // Distance to center (from spawn line)
    const distToCenter = Math.abs((COMBAT.arenaW / 2) - baseX);

    // Calculate the travel time at the FASTEST common speed (the
    // second-slowest's speed, post-boost). This is how long the wave
    // will take to reach center — ROUNDED TO NEAREST WHOLE SECOND.
    // We use this to set boost duration so the boost fades exactly
    // as they arrive.
    let boostFrames = 0;
    if (targetSpeed && targetSpeed > 0) {
      // sim runs at frameMs (50ms = 20fps); knight pixel-speed per
      // frame is approximately stats.spd directly. Travel-time-to-
      // center in frames = distToCenter / targetSpeed.
      const rawFrames = distToCenter / targetSpeed;
      const seconds = Math.round(rawFrames / 20);  // round to nearest second
      boostFrames = Math.max(20, seconds * 20);    // floor of 1 second
    }

    // Vertical scatter — give each waved knight a y-slot offset
    // based on position so they don't stack on the same point.
    const positionOrder = ["tank", "brawl", "striker", "speed", "sniper", "healer", "grenadier"];
    for (let i = 0; i < wave.length; i++) {
      const p = wave[i];
      const slotIdx = positionOrder.indexOf(p.position);
      const yOffset = ((slotIdx >= 0 ? slotIdx : i) - 3) * 60;  // -180..+180

      // Reset combat state, place at spawn
      p.x = baseX + ((Math.random() * 12) - 6);
      p.y = cy + yOffset + ((Math.random() * 8) - 4);
      p.x = Math.max(40, Math.min(COMBAT.arenaW - 40, p.x));
      p.y = Math.max(40, Math.min(COMBAT.arenaH - 40, p.y));
      p.hp = p.stats.hp;
      p.alive = true;
      p.balloonsPopped = 0;
      p.vx = 0; p.vy = 0;
      p.target = null;
      p.attackCooldown = 0;
      p.facing = isLeftTeam ? 1 : -1;
      p.stunned = 0;
      p.aiState = "IDLE";
      p.aiStateFrames = 0;
      p.aiNextRetargetFrame = 0;
      p.attackedBy = null;
      p.attackedByExpires = 0;
      p._pendingRespawn = false;
      // Legacy field — clear in case any old saves had it set
      p._respawnAtFrame = null;

      // === Speed-boost the slowest knight in the wave ===
      // If this is the SLOWEST knight (sortedBySpd[0]) AND there are
      // multiple knights in the wave AND the wave needs travel time,
      // give them a temporary boost so their effective speed matches
      // the second-slowest. The boost expires at boostFrames so it
      // fades exactly when they arrive at center.
      if (boostFrames > 0 && p === sortedBySpd[0] && targetSpeed) {
        const speedDelta = targetSpeed - (p.stats.spd || 0);
        if (speedDelta > 0) {
          // Stack on top of any existing boostMods (e.g. from items)
          const prev = p.boostMods || {};
          p.boostMods = {
            spd: (prev.spd || 0) + speedDelta,
            dmgMult: prev.dmgMult || 1,
            life: boostFrames,
            // Mark as a wave boost so we don't accidentally double-apply
            _isWaveBoost: true,
          };
          feed("spawn", `🔁 ${p.name} (${TEAM_BY_ID[p.teamId].short}) joins the wave with a sprint boost.`);
        }
      }
      m.floats.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y - 18, text: "RESPAWN", life: 28, color: "#7ce0ff" });
    }

    feed("spawn", `🌊 ${TEAM_BY_ID[teamId].short} respawn wave: ${wave.length} knight${wave.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} return to the field.`);
    delete m._respawnWaves[teamId];
  }
}

/* Detect mode-specific win condition — set m.modeWinner. */
function checkModeWinCondition(m) {
  if (m.modeWinner) return;
  const mode = m.gameMode;
  const cfg = (LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig || {})[mode] || {};
  if (mode === "koth") {
    if (m.modeScoreA >= cfg.pointsToWin) m.modeWinner = m.teamAId;
    else if (m.modeScoreB >= cfg.pointsToWin) m.modeWinner = m.teamBId;
  } else if (mode === "ctf") {
    if (m.modeScoreA >= cfg.capsToWin) m.modeWinner = m.teamAId;
    else if (m.modeScoreB >= cfg.capsToWin) m.modeWinner = m.teamBId;
  } else if (mode === "tag") {
    // Last-bot-standing wins (or last team standing in team-tag)
    const aliveA = m.teamAplayers.filter(p => p.alive).length;
    const aliveB = m.teamBplayers.filter(p => p.alive).length;
    const total = aliveA + aliveB;
    if (total <= 1) {
      // Whichever team has the survivor wins
      if (aliveA > 0) m.modeWinner = m.teamAId;
      else if (aliveB > 0) m.modeWinner = m.teamBId;
      else m.modeWinner = "draw";
    }
  }
  // === v28.18: deadlock-detection fallback ===
  // If both teams have no living knights AND no pending respawn waves,
  // declare a winner by current score immediately rather than waiting
  // 10 minutes for the time-cap. This is the user-reported "bots just
  // idle around" state in continuous modes.
  if (!m.modeWinner && (mode === "koth" || mode === "ctf")) {
    const liveA = m.teamAplayers.filter(p => p.alive || p._pendingRespawn).length;
    const liveB = m.teamBplayers.filter(p => p.alive || p._pendingRespawn).length;
    if (liveA === 0 && liveB === 0) {
      const sA = m.modeScoreA || 0, sB = m.modeScoreB || 0;
      if (sA > sB)      m.modeWinner = m.teamAId;
      else if (sB > sA) m.modeWinner = m.teamBId;
      else              m.modeWinner = "draw";
      feed("match", `⚠ Field empty — match resolved by score (${sA}-${sB}).`);
    }
  }
  if (m.modeWinner && m.modeWinner !== "draw") {
    feed("match", `🏆 MATCH OVER — ${TEAM_BY_ID[m.modeWinner].short} wins ${mode.toUpperCase()}!`);
  }
}

/* Spawn neutral items at match start. Mix:
   - Health Packs (instant +30 HP on pickup, NOT a gear slot)
   - Armor pieces (random armor — instant equip if upgrade)
   - General loot (random weapon/armor/item)
   This gives the AI reasons to scout the map besides chasing each other. */
function spawnNeutralItems(m, n) {
  const margin = 60;
  const safeSpawn = () => {
    let x, y, attempts = 0;
    do {
      x = R(margin, COMBAT.arenaW - margin);
      y = R(margin, COMBAT.arenaH - margin);
      attempts++;
    } while (m.terrain && collidesTerrain(x, y, m.terrain) && attempts < 12);
    return { x, y };
  };

  // Always spawn 4 Health Packs (was 3) — bigger HP pool needs more healing
  const healthCount = Math.min(n, 4);
  for (let i = 0; i < healthCount; i++) {
    const { x, y } = safeSpawn();
    m.drops.push({
      x, y,
      slot: "health",
      gear: { id: "healthpack", ico: "❤", name: "Health Pack", heal: 60 },
      fromName: null, neutral: true,
    });
  }

  // Always spawn 3 Armor pieces (was 2) — armor is now strategically vital
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const { x, y } = safeSpawn();
    m.drops.push({
      x, y,
      slot: "armor",
      gear: { ...pick(ARMORS) },
      fromName: null, neutral: true,
    });
  }

  // Fill the rest with general loot (random slot)
  const rest = Math.max(0, n - healthCount - 3);
  for (let i = 0; i < rest; i++) {
    const { x, y } = safeSpawn();
    const slot = pick(["weapon", "armor", "item"]);
    const catalog = slot === "weapon" ? WEAPONS : slot === "armor" ? ARMORS : ITEMS;
    m.drops.push({
      x, y, slot,
      gear: { ...pick(catalog) },
      fromName: null, neutral: true,
    });
  }
}

/* Periodic mid-round resupply: every 25 sec of round time, spawn one
   fresh Health Pack at a safe position. Keeps long matches sustainable. */
function maybeResupplyHealth(m) {
  if (!m.lastResupplyFrame) m.lastResupplyFrame = 0;
  if (m.roundFrame - m.lastResupplyFrame < 500) return; // 25s at 50ms ticks
  // Don't over-saturate the field
  const healthOnField = m.drops.filter(d => d.slot === "health").length;
  if (healthOnField >= 3) return;
  m.lastResupplyFrame = m.roundFrame;
  const margin = 60;
  let x, y, attempts = 0;
  do {
    x = R(margin, COMBAT.arenaW - margin);
    y = R(margin, COMBAT.arenaH - margin);
    attempts++;
  } while (m.terrain && collidesTerrain(x, y, m.terrain) && attempts < 12);
  m.drops.push({
    x, y, slot: "health",
    gear: { id: "healthpack", ico: "❤", name: "Health Pack", heal: 60 },
    fromName: null, neutral: true,
  });
  feed("item", `❤ Resupply: a Health Pack drops onto the field.`);
}

/* ============================================================
   TERRAIN GENERATION
   3-7 square obstacle blocks clustered near the center vertical
   line of the arena. Each block is randomly nudged left/right so
   no two matches feel identical. Blocks are ~36×36px (roughly 2×
   a player's footprint) and AI must path around them.
   ============================================================ */
function generateTerrain() {
  const blocks = [];
  const count = RI(3, 7);
  const SIZE = 36;
  const cx = COMBAT.arenaW / 2;
  const cy = COMBAT.arenaH / 2;
  const usable = COMBAT.arenaH - 80;
  // Power Core spawns at exact arena center with a ~14px radius. Reserve
  // a 70px clear zone around the center so terrain can never overlap it.
  // If a placed block would land in this exclusion zone, push it outward
  // along the y-axis (away from center) until it's clear.
  const CORE_KEEPOUT = 70;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const yFrac = (i + 1) / (count + 1);
    let y = Math.round(40 + usable * yFrac - SIZE / 2);
    let x = Math.round(cx - SIZE / 2 + R(-90, 90));
    // Distance from block CENTER to arena center
    const blockCx = x + SIZE / 2, blockCy = y + SIZE / 2;
    const dx = blockCx - cx, dy = blockCy - cy;
    const d = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if (d < CORE_KEEPOUT + SIZE / 2) {
      // Push the block along its current vector from center until it clears.
      // If it's exactly on top of center (rare), pick a default down-direction.
      const ux = d > 0.5 ? dx / d : 0;
      const uy = d > 0.5 ? dy / d : 1;
      const need = (CORE_KEEPOUT + SIZE / 2) - d + 4; // 4px breathing room
      x = Math.round(x + ux * need);
      y = Math.round(y + uy * need);
      // Clamp inside arena bounds
      x = clamp(x, 8, COMBAT.arenaW - SIZE - 8);
      y = clamp(y, 8, COMBAT.arenaH - SIZE - 8);
    }
    blocks.push({ x, y, size: SIZE });
  }

  // === v37.23.6: scattered field obstacle blocks ===
  // The original centerline-only generation gave fights one row of cover
  // and otherwise an open field. Per the design reference (red-marked
  // zones in the wings), additional obstacles spawn in the field interior
  // — between team spawn zones and the centerline scrim — so snipers and
  // grenadiers have meaningful cover during approach and brawlers have
  // corner-work to use.
  //
  // Constraints:
  //   - Avoid team spawn zones: x < 200 left, x > 1080 right
  //     (spawnRadius = 580 puts left team at x≈60, right at x≈1220; we
  //     keep ~140px of clear approach lane on either side)
  //   - Avoid the Power Core 70px keepout at center
  //   - Don't collide with centerline blocks already placed
  //   - Don't sit on top of the corner pillar SCENERY (50,50) (1230,50)
  //     (50,670) (1230,670) — give those a 50px keepout
  //   - Min 60px spacing between scattered blocks (so cover patches
  //     stay distinct rather than forming inadvertent walls)
  const SCATTER_COUNT = RI(4, 8);   // 4-8 additional blocks per match
  const X_MIN = 200;                // outside left spawn zone
  const X_MAX = COMBAT.arenaW - 200; // outside right spawn zone (1080)
  const Y_MIN = 60;                 // off the top edge
  const Y_MAX = COMBAT.arenaH - 60 - SIZE; // off the bottom edge
  const SCATTER_SPACING_SQ = 60 * 60;
  // Corner pillars from SCENERY — same coords as the const so we don't
  // need to import it. If SCENERY ever moves them, this should follow.
  const PILLAR_KEEPOUT = 50;
  const pillars = [
    { x:  50, y:  50 }, { x: 1230, y:  50 },
    { x:  50, y: 670 }, { x: 1230, y: 670 },
  ];

  let placed = 0;
  let attempts = 0;
  while (placed < SCATTER_COUNT && attempts < 80) {
    attempts++;
    const x = Math.round(X_MIN + Math.random() * (X_MAX - X_MIN));
    const y = Math.round(Y_MIN + Math.random() * (Y_MAX - Y_MIN));
    const blockCx = x + SIZE / 2, blockCy = y + SIZE / 2;

    // Power-core keepout
    const dCenter = Math.hypot(blockCx - cx, blockCy - cy);
    if (dCenter < CORE_KEEPOUT + SIZE / 2) continue;

    // Pillar keepout
    let nearPillar = false;
    for (const p of pillars) {
      if (Math.hypot(blockCx - p.x, blockCy - p.y) < PILLAR_KEEPOUT + SIZE / 2) {
        nearPillar = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (nearPillar) continue;

    // Existing-block spacing
    let tooClose = false;
    for (const b of blocks) {
      const otherCx = b.x + b.size / 2, otherCy = b.y + b.size / 2;
      const ddx = blockCx - otherCx, ddy = blockCy - otherCy;
      if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy < SCATTER_SPACING_SQ) {
        tooClose = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (tooClose) continue;

    blocks.push({ x, y, size: SIZE });
    placed++;
  }

  return blocks;
}

/* ============================================================
   BIOMES — visual variation across the play field.

   Each match is assigned a biome deterministically (via SIM_RNG so
   the same match seed always produces the same look). Biomes provide:
   - base + secondary floor colors for the gradient
   - mowing-stripe hue (subtle striped pattern, like a sports pitch)
   - scatter palette (decorative tufts/pebbles/petals scattered on floor)
   - accent palette (cracks, lines, wear marks)
   - sky tint (affects vignette mood)
   - ambient particle type ("petal", "ember", "snow", null)

   Biomes are drawn UNDER players, terrain, and projectiles. They are
   drawn EVERY frame (decorations are stored in match state, not
   re-randomized) — this is cheap because there are typically <200
   decoration sprites.
   ============================================================ */
const BIOMES = [];  // populated by the factory below — see CITY_PALETTES × SPORT_TYPES × EFFECT_TYPES

/* ============================================================
   GENERATIVE STADIUM SYSTEM — v28.9
   ----------------------------------------------------------------
   12 cities × 8 sports = 96 generated stadiums, plus the legacy
   environmental & seasonal venues defined above.

   Each city has a signature visual palette (floor colors, scatter
   set, ambient effect, sky tint, accent line color, lore name
   fragments). Each sport has a court-marking type and a set of
   venue-name terms. _buildBiome(cityKey, sportKey) merges them
   into a runtime biome object compatible with the existing
   render pipeline.

   The factory runs at module init time, populating BIOMES with
   all 96 city/sport combinations. Legacy environmental biomes
   (grass, desert, ice, volcanic, etc.) and seasonal venues
   (jungle, autumn, neon, halloween, etc.) remain in the array
   as-is, representing "barnstorming" or special-event venues.
   ============================================================ */

/* === v28.10: EFFECT_TYPES — third axis of stadium variation ===
   Each effect optionally overrides the city's ambient particle type
   and adds a thematic scatter overlay that re-skins the venue. The
   'default' effect leaves the city palette untouched; other effects
   produce themed venues like "Foundry", "Underdig", "Hallowtide", etc.
   Inspired by the original legacy biomes which are now subsumed by
   the factory.

   Effect overrides apply via merging — the city's base scatter is
   PRESERVED but augmented with the effect's added scatter layer.
   So a "Phoenix Sandstone Foundry Court" still has Phoenix's pebbles
   and cacti AND the Foundry's lava cracks and embers. The compounding
   gives each city/effect pair a distinct character.

   12 cities × 8 sports × 9 effects = 864 stadium configurations. The
   stadium is picked per-match via SIM_RNG; the lore page shows only
   the 'default' effect grid (96 entries) by default, with a picker
   that lets users browse other effect overlays (see Lore tab UI). */
