  // Was a flat 0.78 per render frame, which gave faster decay at 60fps
  // than at 30fps. Now we compute an FPS-independent decay using elapsed
  // time since the last frame. Reference: 0.78 at 60fps (16.67ms ref).
  // At any other dt, decay = 0.78 ^ (dt / refDt).
  const lastTs = applyShake._lastTs || t;
  let dt = t - lastTs;
  if (dt > 100) dt = 100;
  if (dt < 1)   dt = 1;
  applyShake._lastTs = t;
  const REF_DT = 1000 / 60;
  _shakeAmp *= Math.pow(0.78, dt / REF_DT);
}
/* `ctx` is the global drawing context — bound to the main arena canvas
   by default. It's declared with `let` (not `const`) so the biome-preview
   helper can temporarily redirect drawing to a thumbnail canvas, run the
   existing scatter+court rendering routines (which all reference this
   global), and then restore it. The redirect happens synchronously
   within drawBiomePreview() so no other render call can interleave. */
let ctx = arenaCanvas.getContext("2d");
ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;

/* ============================================================
   CAMERA — broadcast tracking shot.

   The arena is a fixed logical 960x540 box; the canvas is the
   render surface. When TV mode is on, we apply a virtual camera
   that frames the action like an NFL/NBA tracking shot — pans
   and zooms so the active players and objectives stay in view
   while padding is dropped from empty parts of the field.

   Each frame:
     1. Compute the AABB of all alive players + objectives
        (drops, power-core, crown, flag, bases) with margin
     2. Translate that AABB into a desired camera (cx, cy, zoom)
     3. Smoothly lerp the live camera toward the target
     4. drawArena applies translate+scale before drawing world
        contents, then restores

   World-space drawing happens *inside* the camera transform.
   HUD/overlays (TV scoreboard, kill feed, vignette) draw
   *outside* it so they stay viewport-locked.
   ============================================================ */
const CAMERA = {
  x: 640,        // current center X in world coords (arenaW=1280 / 2)
  y: 360,        // current center Y in world coords (arenaH=720 / 2)
  zoom: 1.0,     // current zoom (1 = fit field exactly)
  targetX: 640,
  targetY: 360,
  targetZoom: 1.0,
  enabled: false,  // toggled by TV mode + opt-in setting
  // Tunables — v28.13: re-tuned for less aggressive zoom + smoother motion
  // per user feedback ("zoom too aggressive, user never sees the stadium;
  // camera snap too jerky"). The dynamic camera is now cinematic, not
  // nauseating: it tracks the action subtly and prefers wide framing.
  PAD_TV: 90,     // padding around tracked AABB in TV mode
  PAD_NORMAL: 200, // (was 80) much more padding so small alive-player
                   // clusters don't make the AABB tiny → camera no longer
                   // tightens on a 2-player engagement
  MIN_ZOOM: 0.55, // v37.15: was 0.78 — pulled back further so the camera
                  // shows more of the stadium framing around the field. The
                  // CROWD_DEPTH was simultaneously increased to fill the
                  // newly-visible perimeter so it doesn't read as black void.
  MAX_ZOOM: 1.10, // (was 1.6) — barely zoom in past fit-the-field. The
                  // stadium stays visible at all times. Cinematic, not
                  // claustrophobic.
  LERP: 0.04,     // (was 0.07) per-frame movement toward target — slower
                  // glide eliminates the "snap" feel
  ZOOM_LERP: 0.025, // (was 0.05) zoom changes are now barely perceptible
                    // frame-to-frame; total zoom transitions still complete
                    // in well under a second of real time
};

/* Compute the desired camera target from the current match state.
   Considers: alive players + projectiles' targets + drops + objectives. */
function _computeCameraTarget(m) {
  const W = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280, H = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  if (!m) return { cx: W/2, cy: H/2, zoom: 1.0 };

  // === v37.22: pull camera back to wide stadium view between rounds ===
  // Whenever the live action is paused (betweenRounds, post, preRound for
  // rounds 2+), frame the entire field plus the surrounding crowd. Users
  // explicitly asked to see the stadium during intermissions; the previous
  // behavior left the camera tight on the last engagement and slow-glided
  // back, so the crowd was rarely visible.
  // The MIN_ZOOM here matches the "empty match" wide-shot below so the
  // pulled-back composition is identical whether players are alive but
  // paused (this case) or no players are present (count===0 case).
  if (m.phase && m.phase !== "round") {
    return { cx: W/2, cy: H/2, zoom: CAMERA.MIN_ZOOM };
  }

  const pad = CAMERA.PAD_NORMAL;

  let minX = Infinity, minY = Infinity, maxX = -Infinity, maxY = -Infinity;
  let count = 0;

  // Alive players
  const all = [...(m.teamAplayers || []), ...(m.teamBplayers || [])];
  for (const p of all) {
    if (!p.alive) continue;
    if (p.x < minX) minX = p.x;
    if (p.y < minY) minY = p.y;
    if (p.x > maxX) maxX = p.x;
    if (p.y > maxY) maxY = p.y;
    count++;
  }

  // Mode objectives — crown, flag, bases — when present
  if (m.crown) {
    if (m.crown.x < minX) minX = m.crown.x;
    if (m.crown.y < minY) minY = m.crown.y;
    if (m.crown.x > maxX) maxX = m.crown.x;
    if (m.crown.y > maxY) maxY = m.crown.y;
    count++;
  }
  if (m.flag) {
    if (m.flag.x < minX) minX = m.flag.x;
    if (m.flag.y < minY) minY = m.flag.y;
    if (m.flag.x > maxX) maxX = m.flag.x;
    if (m.flag.y > maxY) maxY = m.flag.y;
    count++;
  }

  // Power core (deathmatch focal point)
  if (m.powerCore && m.powerCore.state === "active") {
    if (m.powerCore.x < minX) minX = m.powerCore.x;
    if (m.powerCore.y < minY) minY = m.powerCore.y;
    if (m.powerCore.x > maxX) maxX = m.powerCore.x;
    if (m.powerCore.y > maxY) maxY = m.powerCore.y;
    count++;
  }

  // Dropped items — only consider drops within reach of any alive player
  // so the camera doesn't over-fit on stale far-corner drops
  if (m.drops && count > 0) {
    for (const d of m.drops) {
      // Is any alive player within 200px of this drop?
      let near = false;
      for (const p of all) {
        if (!p.alive) continue;
        const dx = p.x - d.x, dy = p.y - d.y;
        if (dx*dx + dy*dy < 200*200) { near = true; break; }
      }
      if (near) {
        if (d.x < minX) minX = d.x;
        if (d.y < minY) minY = d.y;
        if (d.x > maxX) maxX = d.x;
        if (d.y > maxY) maxY = d.y;
      }
    }
  }

  // Empty match (between rounds) — frame the whole field PLUS the
  // surrounding crowd band so the inter-round shot shows the stadium,
  // not just the empty pitch. zoom 0.92 × canvasFillScale (1.5 in
  // fullscreen) = finalScale 1.38, which makes the visible world
  // ~1391×783 — wider than the 1280×720 world by exactly the
  // CROWD_DEPTH (32) on each side. center-clamp logic below detects
  // halfW_world > W/2 and snaps cx to W/2, so the world stays
  // perfectly centered with crowd visible on all four edges.
  if (count === 0) {
    return { cx: W/2, cy: H/2, zoom: 0.92 };
  }

  // Pad the AABB
  minX = Math.max(0, minX - pad);
  minY = Math.max(0, minY - pad);
  maxX = Math.min(W, maxX + pad);
  maxY = Math.min(H, maxY + pad);

  const bw = maxX - minX;
  const bh = maxY - minY;
  let cx = (minX + maxX) / 2;
  let cy = (minY + maxY) / 2;

  // Zoom = how much we'd need to scale to fill the canvas with this AABB.
  // Take the smaller axis to ensure the entire AABB fits.
  const zx = W / Math.max(1, bw);
  const zy = H / Math.max(1, bh);
  let zoom = Math.min(zx, zy);
  zoom = clamp(zoom, CAMERA.MIN_ZOOM, CAMERA.MAX_ZOOM);

  // === v28.4 fix #1: enforce minimum zoom such that the world fills
  // the canvas in TV mode. The render path multiplies CAMERA.zoom by
  // canvasFillScale = max(canvasW/worldW, canvasH/worldH). For the
  // world to actually FILL the canvas (no black bars from undershoot),
  // we need finalScale = CAMERA.zoom * canvasFillScale ≥ 1.0 in canvas
  // pixel terms — i.e. CAMERA.zoom must be ≥ 1.0 / canvasFillScale.
  //
  // Read canvas dims through arenaCanvas (lives at module scope). In
  // non-TV mode the canvas matches the world, canvasFillScale = 1.0,
  // and this floor evaluates to 1.0 — equal to the world-fits-canvas
  // baseline, so behavior is unchanged. ===
  if (typeof arenaCanvas !== "undefined" && arenaCanvas) {
    const cW = arenaCanvas.width || W;
    const cH = arenaCanvas.height || H;
    // Match the FILL/FIT logic used in _applyCameraTransform so the
    // floor matches what's actually used at draw time. (See v28.7
    // portrait-mismatch comment in _applyCameraTransform.)
    const canvasAspect = cW / cH;
    const worldAspect = W / H;
    const isPortraitMismatch = canvasAspect < worldAspect * 0.85;
    const canvasFillScale = isPortraitMismatch
      ? Math.min(cW / W, cH / H)
      : Math.max(cW / W, cH / H);
    if (canvasFillScale > 0) {
      const minZoomForFill = 1.0 / canvasFillScale;
      if (zoom < minZoomForFill) zoom = minZoomForFill;
    }
  }

  // === v28.4 fix #2: clamp camera center so the visible viewport
  // doesn't extend past the world bounds. Otherwise when a bot is near
  // a field edge, the camera centers on them and the off-field side of
  // the canvas shows black void.
  //
  // Visible viewport in world coords (after canvas-fill scaling):
  //   halfW_world = (canvasW / 2) / (zoom * canvasFillScale)
  //   halfH_world = (canvasH / 2) / (zoom * canvasFillScale)
  // For the camera not to show outside the world:
  //   halfW_world ≤ cx ≤ W - halfW_world
  //   halfH_world ≤ cy ≤ H - halfH_world
  //
  // If the visible half-extent exceeds half the world (which can happen
  // if MIN_ZOOM forces zoom small enough that the world is smaller than
  // the canvas in world units), we just center on the world midpoint. ===
  if (typeof arenaCanvas !== "undefined" && arenaCanvas) {
    const cW = arenaCanvas.width || W;
    const cH = arenaCanvas.height || H;
    const canvasAspect = cW / cH;
    const worldAspect = W / H;
    const isPortraitMismatch = canvasAspect < worldAspect * 0.85;
    const canvasFillScale = isPortraitMismatch
      ? Math.min(cW / W, cH / H)
      : Math.max(cW / W, cH / H);
    const finalScale = zoom * canvasFillScale;
    const halfW_world = (cW / 2) / finalScale;
    const halfH_world = (cH / 2) / finalScale;
    if (halfW_world * 2 >= W) {
      cx = W / 2;
    } else {
      cx = clamp(cx, halfW_world, W - halfW_world);
    }
    if (halfH_world * 2 >= H) {
      cy = H / 2;
    } else {
      cy = clamp(cy, halfH_world, H - halfH_world);
    }
  }

  return { cx, cy, zoom };
}

/* Update camera target + lerp current toward it. Called once per
   frame from drawArena before any world-space drawing. */
function _updateCamera(m) {
  // Camera is always enabled (subtle pan even in standard mode), but uses
  // tighter framing in TV mode for a more cinematic broadcast feel.
  CAMERA.enabled = true;

  const tgt = _computeCameraTarget(m);
  CAMERA.targetX = tgt.cx;
  CAMERA.targetY = tgt.cy;
  CAMERA.targetZoom = tgt.zoom;

  // === v37.22: snappier glide during non-round phases ===
  // The default LERP/ZOOM_LERP are tuned for live action (smooth, slow
  // tracking that doesn't jerk during fights). Between rounds the camera
  // needs to reset to wide stadium view in maybe one second of real time,
  // not eight. Use 4× the normal lerp coefficient when the match is paused.
  const isPaused = m && m.phase && m.phase !== "round";
  const basePosLerp  = isPaused ? Math.min(0.20, CAMERA.LERP * 4)      : CAMERA.LERP;
  const baseZoomLerp = isPaused ? Math.min(0.15, CAMERA.ZOOM_LERP * 4) : CAMERA.ZOOM_LERP;

  // === v37.23.5: wall-clock-based lerp ===
  // Previously, lerp was applied once per render frame. At 30fps render
  // (default), that's 30 lerps/sec — half as much convergence per real
  // second as 60fps mode. The camera felt sluggish at 30fps and snappy
  // at 60fps. Now we scale the lerp by frameDt / refDt where refDt is a
  // 60fps reference. This makes camera convergence rate independent of
  // the user's FPS setting.
  const now = (typeof performance !== "undefined" && performance.now)
    ? performance.now()
    : Date.now();
  const lastTs = _updateCamera._lastTs || now;
  let dt = now - lastTs;
  // Clamp dt to avoid catastrophic catch-up on backgrounded tabs (where
  // dt could be 30s+) — the camera would teleport. Cap at 100ms so even
  // a paused tab resumes with a smooth 6× glide instead of a hard cut.
  if (dt > 100) dt = 100;
  if (dt < 1)   dt = 1;
  _updateCamera._lastTs = now;
  // Reference: 60fps == 16.67ms. At dt = 16.67ms, scale = 1 (preserves
  // the original lerp behavior). At dt = 33.3ms (30fps), scale = 2,
  // so the per-frame lerp doubles to keep the wall-clock convergence
  // identical.
  const REF_DT = 1000 / 60;
  const scale  = dt / REF_DT;
  // Cap scale at 4 to avoid overshoot if a frame stalled for any reason
  const scaleSafe = Math.min(scale, 4);
  // Apply scaled lerps — we cap each at 0.95 to ensure the algorithm
  // never overshoots (lerp > 1 would push past the target).
  const posLerp  = Math.min(0.95, basePosLerp  * scaleSafe);
  const zoomLerp = Math.min(0.95, baseZoomLerp * scaleSafe);

  // Smooth lerp — separate factors for position and zoom so zoom
  // changes don't cause motion sickness.
  CAMERA.x = CAMERA.x + (CAMERA.targetX - CAMERA.x) * posLerp;
  CAMERA.y = CAMERA.y + (CAMERA.targetY - CAMERA.y) * posLerp;
  CAMERA.zoom = CAMERA.zoom + (CAMERA.targetZoom - CAMERA.zoom) * zoomLerp;
}

/* Apply the current camera transform to ctx. Caller must save+restore
   around their world-space drawing block.

   v28.3.3 fullscreen-fill fix: in TV mode, _resizeCanvasForTVMode sets
   the canvas internal resolution to the viewport (e.g. 1920×1080), but
   the world is fixed at COMBAT.arenaW × arenaH (1280×720). With only
   `ctx.scale(CAMERA.zoom, CAMERA.zoom)`, world coordinates map 1:1 to
   canvas pixels — so a 1280-wide world drawn into a 1920-wide canvas
   leaves 320px of black on each side. The world is letterboxed inside
   the canvas.

   Fix: compute a `canvasFillScale` = max(canvasW/worldW, canvasH/worldH)
   and apply it on top of CAMERA.zoom. With matching aspect ratios
   (16:9 fullscreen on 16:9 world), canvasFillScale = 1.5 and the world
   fills the canvas. With mismatched aspect (e.g. 16:10 monitor), the
   larger axis fills and the smaller axis crops slightly — preferable
   to black bars for a "fullscreen broadcast" feel.

   In non-TV mode, the canvas internal resolution matches the world
   (1280×720), so canvasFillScale = 1.0 and behavior is unchanged. */
function _applyCameraTransform() {
  const W = arenaCanvas.width, H = arenaCanvas.height;
  const worldW = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280;
  const worldH = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  // === v28.7 mobile portrait support ===
  // The world is 16:9 horizontal (1280×720, ratio 1.78). Most desktop
  // and landscape mobile viewports are similar — ~16:9 to ~16:10 — and
  // benefit from the original FILL behavior (max(scaleX, scaleY)) which
  // crops slightly to eliminate letterbox bars.
  //
  // Phone portrait (~9:19, ratio 0.47) is the opposite — far taller
  // than wide. FILL on portrait gives canvasFillScale = scaleY, which
  // makes the world ~1.1× viewport tall but ~3× viewport wide. Most
  // of the field falls offscreen — the user only sees a narrow vertical
  // slice of action.
  //
  // Detect severe portrait mismatch and switch to FIT (min) instead.
  // FIT lets the entire 16:9 world fit inside the portrait viewport
  // with black bars top/bottom. The user sees ALL the action.
  // The threshold is canvas-aspect < 0.85 × world-aspect, which
  // catches phone portrait while preserving landscape FILL.
  const canvasAspect = W / H;
  const worldAspect = worldW / worldH;
  const isPortraitMismatch = canvasAspect < worldAspect * 0.85;
  const canvasFillScale = isPortraitMismatch
    ? Math.min(W / worldW, H / worldH)   // FIT: world fits inside, black bars
    : Math.max(W / worldW, H / worldH);  // FILL: world covers canvas, slight crop
  const finalScale = CAMERA.zoom * canvasFillScale;
  // Translate canvas center to world camera position, scaled by zoom.
  // World point (x, y) → screen point
  //   ((x - CAMERA.x) * finalScale + W/2, (y - CAMERA.y) * finalScale + H/2)
  ctx.translate(W/2, H/2);
  ctx.scale(finalScale, finalScale);
  ctx.translate(-CAMERA.x, -CAMERA.y);
}


/* Decorative scenery — fixed positions for 16:9 arena (960×540) */
// v37.15: Scenery placement reworked. Previously pillars floated near
// the playing area (e.g. (200,130), (760,130)) and banners hung at
// off-center positions, which read as "objects randomly placed on the
// field" rather than "venue dressing at the perimeter." The new layout
// places pillars at the four corners of the field (just inset from the
// edge), banners at the top-center and bottom-center edges (above/below
// the playing area), and keeps the rubble piles as in-field obstacles
// at their existing positions. Field is 1280×720.
const SCENERY = [
  // Corner pillars — ~50px inset from each corner so they sit at the
  // perimeter, between the field markings and the seating chip.
  { type: "pillar", x:  50, y:  50 },   // top-left
  { type: "pillar", x: 1230, y:  50 },  // top-right
  { type: "pillar", x:  50, y: 670 },   // bottom-left
  { type: "pillar", x: 1230, y: 670 },  // bottom-right
  // Edge banners — top-center and bottom-center, hanging from the chip.
  { type: "banner", x: 640, y:  20 },   // top-center
  { type: "banner", x: 640, y: 700 },   // bottom-center
  // In-field rubble — these are intentionally on the playing surface as
  // gameplay obstacles (cover for snipers, line breakers for tanks),
  // unchanged from before.
  { type: "rubble", x: 340, y: 280 },
  { type: "rubble", x: 620, y: 280 },
  { type: "rubble", x: 480, y: 200 },
  { type: "rubble", x: 480, y: 340 },
];

// Convert "#RRGGBB" to "rgba(r,g,b,a)" for compositing
function _hexA(hex, a) {
  const c = (hex || "#888").replace("#", "");
  const r = parseInt(c.substring(0,2), 16);
  const g = parseInt(c.substring(2,4), 16);
  const b = parseInt(c.substring(4,6), 16);
  return `rgba(${r},${g},${b},${a})`;
}

/* Blend two "#RRGGBB" colors at the given ratio (0=a, 1=b). Used to
   produce a smooth midpoint for the floor gradient. */
function _blend(hexA, hexB, t) {
  const ca = (hexA || "#888").replace("#", "");
  const cb = (hexB || "#888").replace("#", "");
  const ar = parseInt(ca.substring(0,2), 16), ag = parseInt(ca.substring(2,4), 16), ab = parseInt(ca.substring(4,6), 16);
  const br = parseInt(cb.substring(0,2), 16), bg = parseInt(cb.substring(2,4), 16), bb = parseInt(cb.substring(4,6), 16);
  const r = Math.round(ar + (br - ar) * t);
  const g = Math.round(ag + (bg - ag) * t);
  const b = Math.round(ab + (bb - ab) * t);
  return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
}

/* ============================================================
   BIOME SCATTER RENDER — draws the per-match decorative sprites
   (grass tufts, dandelions, pebbles, ice cracks, embers, petals)
   directly to the floor canvas. No filtering or culling — the count
   is bounded (<300 sprites typically) so blasting through is fast.
   ============================================================ */
function drawBiomeScatter(scatter) {
  for (const s of scatter) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case "grassTuft": {
        // Three little vertical blades fanning out
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 4 - s.r);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 2, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 3, s.y - 2 - s.r);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x + 2, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 3, s.y - 2 - s.r);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Highlight on the center blade
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 3 - s.r);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "dandelion": {
        // Tiny puff: a yellow-ish circle + small white dots around it
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const a = i * Math.PI / 2 + s.rot;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(s.x + Math.cos(a) * 2.2, s.y + Math.sin(a) * 2.2, 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        break;
      }
      case "pebble": {
        // Small dark ellipse with highlight
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 1.5 + s.r * 0.5, 1 + s.r * 0.4, s.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y - 0.5, 1, 0.5);
        break;
      }
      case "cactus": {
        // Vertical green oval w/ ridge
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 2 + s.r, 5 + s.r * 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 5 - s.r);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 5 + s.r);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "sandTuft": {
        // Tiny windswept marks
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 2, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 1);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "iceCrack": {
        // Jagged crack lines
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 6, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 1, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 3, s.y - 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 7, s.y + 1);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 1, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 1, s.y + 5);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "snowTuft": {
        // Tiny white dot
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 0.8 + s.r * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "ember": {
        // Glowing dot with halo
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(s.c1.replace(/^#/, "#") || "#ff8030", 0.18);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "crack": {
        // Glowing volcanic crack
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
        ctx.lineCap = "round";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 8, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 6, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 10, s.y - 1);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 8, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 6, s.y + 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.lineCap = "butt";
        break;
      }
      case "petal": {
        // Soft pink ellipse
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.rotate(s.rot);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 2.8, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-0.4, -0.4, 1.4, 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        break;
      }
      case "crystal": {
        // Diamond / triangle gem shape — pointy with bright highlight
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.rotate(s.rot);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -3 - s.r);
        ctx.lineTo(2.5, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(0, 3 + s.r * 0.6);
        ctx.lineTo(-2.5, 0);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -3 - s.r);
        ctx.lineTo(1, 0);
        ctx.lineTo(0, 0);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
        break;
      }
      case "stalagmite": {
        // Pointy upward cone
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y + 4);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 6 - s.r);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y + 4);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y - 5 - s.r, 1, 4);
        break;
      }
      case "seaweed": {
        // Wavy vertical strand
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 6);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(s.x - 3, s.y + 2, s.x + 3, s.y - 2, s.x, s.y - 8 - s.r * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 4);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(s.x - 2, s.y + 1, s.x + 2, s.y - 1, s.x, s.y - 6 - s.r * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "coral": {
        // Tree-branch shape with multiple prongs
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 3 + s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let a = -Math.PI / 2; a < Math.PI / 2; a += Math.PI / 5) {
          ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x + Math.cos(a) * 5, s.y + Math.sin(a) * 5);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "manhole": {
        // Round dark circle with cross pattern
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 7.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 6, s.y); ctx.lineTo(s.x + 6, s.y);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 6); ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 6);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "oilStain": {
        // Irregular dark blob
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 5 + s.r, 3 + s.r * 0.6, s.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x - 1, s.y - 0.5, 2, 1.2, s.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "gum": {
        // Tiny squashed circle
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 1.8, 1.2, s.rot, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "leaf": {
        // Pointed oval, rotated
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.rotate(s.rot);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 3.5 + s.r * 0.4, 1.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-3, 0); ctx.lineTo(3, 0);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
        break;
      }
      case "vine": {
        // Curving thin line
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 8, s.y);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(s.x - 2, s.y - 4, s.x + 2, s.y + 4, s.x + 8, s.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 3, s.y - 4);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "gridDot": {
        // Bright glowing dot — neon biomes
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(s.c1.startsWith("#") ? s.c1 : "#ff40c8", 0.20);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = "#fff";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "neonStripe": {
        // Short bright horizontal line with glow
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(s.x, s.y);
        ctx.rotate(s.rot);
        ctx.strokeStyle = _hexA(s.c1.startsWith("#") ? s.c1 : "#ff40c8", 0.30);
        ctx.lineWidth = 4;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-10, 0); ctx.lineTo(10, 0);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-10, 0); ctx.lineTo(10, 0);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
        break;
      }
      case "glowMushroom": {
        // Small mushroom with bright cap
        ctx.fillStyle = "#3a3028";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.7, s.y - 1, 1.4, 4);
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(s.c1.startsWith("#") ? s.c1 : "#88e0c8", 0.4);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y - 1, 4, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y - 1, 2.5, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y - 1.5, 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "evergreen": {
        // Triangular pine tree silhouette
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.30)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x + 2, s.y + 8, 8, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 6, s.y + 6);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 12);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 6, s.y + 6);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 8);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y + 2);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = "#3d2515";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y + 6, 2, 2);
        break;
      }
      case "flowerPink":
      case "flowerYellow": {
        // 5-petal flower with center
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          const a = i * (Math.PI * 2 / 5) + s.rot;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(s.x + Math.cos(a) * 1.8, s.y + Math.sin(a) * 1.8, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "gift": {
        // Wrapped gift box — small square with a ribbon
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 4, s.y - 4, 8, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 4, s.y - 0.5, 8, 1);
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.5, s.y - 4, 1, 8);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
      case "ornament": {
        // Christmas ornament — gold/silver bauble with a tiny cap
        ctx.fillStyle = _hexA(s.c1.startsWith("#") ? s.c1 : "#ffc848", 0.35);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x - 0.8, s.y - 0.8, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = "#5a4830";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.5, s.y - 4, 1, 1.5);
        break;
      }
      case "pumpkin": {
        // Orange ridged pumpkin
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.30)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x + 1, s.y + 4, 5, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 5, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 2, s.y - 3); ctx.lineTo(s.x - 2, s.y + 3);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 4);     ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 4);
        ctx.moveTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 3); ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y + 3);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Stem
        ctx.fillStyle = "#3a4818";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.5, s.y - 5, 1, 2);
        break;
      }
      case "gravestone": {
        // Rounded-top tombstone
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.40)";
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x + 1, s.y + 7, 6, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y + 6);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 4, s.y - 3);
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y - 3, 4, Math.PI, 0, false);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y + 6);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 2.5, s.y - 1, 5, 0.6);
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 2,   s.y + 1, 4, 0.6);
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 2.5, s.y + 3, 5, 0.6);
        break;
      }
      // === v28.10/v28.11: scatter handlers for new effect overlays ===
      case "lavaCrack": {
        // Glowing zigzag in the floor — bright orange under thin dark crust
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 5, s.y - 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 1, s.y + 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 5, s.y + 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.7;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y + 1);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "ash": {
        // Small grey smudge — soft puff
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 2 + s.r * 0.6, 1, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 0.5, s.y - 0.5, 1, 1);
        break;
      }
      case "mushroom": {
        // Cap + stem — cap colored, stem off-white
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;  // stem
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y, 2, 3);
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;  // cap
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, 2.5 + s.r * 0.4, Math.PI, 0, false);
        ctx.fill();
        // Spots
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)";
        ctx.fillRect(s.x - 1, s.y - 1, 0.7, 0.7);
        ctx.fillRect(s.x + 0.5, s.y - 1.4, 0.6, 0.6);
        break;
      }
      case "pinecone": {
        // Brown teardrop with hatched scales
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 2, 3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(s.x - 1.5, s.y - 1.5 + i * 1.2);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x + 1.5, s.y - 1.5 + i * 1.2);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        break;
      }
      case "cherryLeaf": {
        // Pointed oval leaf, slight stem
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(s.x, s.y, 1.8, 3, Math.PI / 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 1.5, s.y + 1.5);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 1.5, s.y - 1.5);
        ctx.stroke();
        break;
      }
      case "wheatStalk": {
        // Vertical stem with bristled head
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y + 4);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x, s.y - 4);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Bristles
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.6;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 2 - i);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x - 2, s.y - 3 - i);
          ctx.moveTo(s.x, s.y - 2 - i);
          ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 3 - i);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        break;
      }
      case "auroraWisp": {
        // Soft glowing curve — blurred trail
        const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(s.x - 6, s.y, s.x + 6, s.y);
        grad.addColorStop(0,    "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
        grad.addColorStop(0.4,  s.c1);
        grad.addColorStop(0.6,  s.c2);
        grad.addColorStop(1,    "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
        ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 6, s.y);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(s.x, s.y - 4, s.x + 6, s.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        break;
      }
      case "circuitArc": {
        // Tiny zig-zag in bright neon — like a printed-circuit trace
        ctx.strokeStyle = s.c1;
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(s.x - 4, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 2, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x - 2, s.y - 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y - 2);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 2, s.y);
        ctx.lineTo(s.x + 4, s.y);
        ctx.stroke();
        // Glow dot at one end
        ctx.fillStyle = s.c2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(s.x + 4, s.y, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   COURT-SPECIFIC FIELD MARKINGS — for tennis/badminton/basketball/
   volleyball biomes. Drawn in place of the generic grid + center
   circle when biome.courtType is set.

   The court runs the full arena, scaled to the available space.
   Lines color comes from biome.accents.lineColor (typically white).
   ============================================================ */
function drawCourtMarkings(W, H, courtType, lineColor) {
  // === v28.16: proportional court markings ===
  // The court markings were originally sized for a 960×540 field; the
  // field is now 1280×720, so the absolute pixel sizes (penalty boxes,
  // free-throw circles, face-off rings, etc.) read as too small relative
  // to the field. We compute a scale factor from H/540 and apply it to
  // every hardcoded dimension that should grow with the field.
  // The 40px broadcast margin around the outer boundary stays absolute —
  // it's a uniform UI-style inset, not part of the sport's geometry.
  const S = H / 540;             // scale factor (1.0 at original dims, ≈1.33 at 1280×720)
  const s = (n) => n * S;        // inline scaler for one-off uses

  ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  // Outer boundary — common to all courts. 40px broadcast margin.
  ctx.strokeRect(40, 40, W - 80, H - 80);
  // Center net line (vertical)
  ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 30); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 30);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;

  if (courtType === "tennis") {
    // Service boxes — half-court width × half-court height
    const sx = W / 2 - s(200), ex = W / 2 + s(200);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx, 40);   ctx.lineTo(sx, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(ex, 40);   ctx.lineTo(ex, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, H / 2 - 0); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H / 2 - 0);
    ctx.moveTo(sx, H / 2);  ctx.lineTo(ex, H / 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Singles sidelines
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s(80), 40);    ctx.lineTo(s(80), H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W - s(80), 40); ctx.lineTo(W - s(80), H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (courtType === "basketball") {
    // Three-point arc on each side + key (free-throw rectangle)
    const arcR = Math.min(W, H) * 0.32;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(40, H / 2, arcR, -Math.PI / 2.6, Math.PI / 2.6);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 40, H / 2, arcR, Math.PI - Math.PI / 2.6, Math.PI + Math.PI / 2.6);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Key boxes
    const keyW = s(200), keyH = s(160);
    ctx.strokeRect(40, H / 2 - keyH/2, keyW, keyH);
    ctx.strokeRect(W - 40 - keyW, H / 2 - keyH/2, keyW, keyH);
    // Free throw circles
    const ftR = s(60);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(40 + keyW, H / 2, ftR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 40 - keyW, H / 2, ftR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Center circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, s(60), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (courtType === "volleyball") {
    // Attack lines 3m from net
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - s(180), 40);   ctx.lineTo(W / 2 - s(180), H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + s(180), 40);   ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + s(180), H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Net dotted line down center
    ctx.setLineDash([10, 6]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 30); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 30);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
  } else if (courtType === "badminton") {
    // Singles sidelines + service lines
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(s(70), 40);    ctx.lineTo(s(70), H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W - s(70), 40); ctx.lineTo(W - s(70), H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Short service lines (close to net)
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - s(100), 40);   ctx.lineTo(W / 2 - s(100), H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + s(100), 40);   ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + s(100), H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Center service line
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - s(100), H / 2); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + s(100), H / 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (courtType === "football") {
    // === v28.8: American football gridiron ===
    const yardSpacing = s(80);
    const endZoneW = s(120);
    // End zones — slight tint to differentiate
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.04)";
    ctx.fillRect(40, 40, endZoneW, H - 80);
    ctx.fillRect(W - 40 - endZoneW, 40, endZoneW, H - 80);
    // Goal lines (boundary of end zones)
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(40 + endZoneW, 40); ctx.lineTo(40 + endZoneW, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W - 40 - endZoneW, 40); ctx.lineTo(W - 40 - endZoneW, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    // Yard lines across the playing field
    for (let x = 40 + endZoneW + yardSpacing; x < W - 40 - endZoneW; x += yardSpacing) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, 40); ctx.lineTo(x, H - 40);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Hash marks at top/bottom thirds (NFL style)
      const hashY1 = 40 + (H - 80) / 3;
      const hashY2 = 40 + 2 * (H - 80) / 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - 10, hashY1); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, hashY1);
      ctx.moveTo(x - 10, hashY2); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, hashY2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  } else if (courtType === "soccer") {
    // === v28.8: Soccer pitch ===
    const pBoxW = s(180), pBoxH = s(380);
    const gBoxW = s(60),  gBoxH = s(200);
    const pBoxYTop = (H - pBoxH) / 2;
    const gBoxYTop = (H - gBoxH) / 2;
    // Penalty boxes
    ctx.strokeRect(40, pBoxYTop, pBoxW, pBoxH);
    ctx.strokeRect(W - 40 - pBoxW, pBoxYTop, pBoxW, pBoxH);
    // Goal boxes
    ctx.strokeRect(40, gBoxYTop, gBoxW, gBoxH);
    ctx.strokeRect(W - 40 - gBoxW, gBoxYTop, gBoxW, gBoxH);
    // Penalty arcs — partial circle on the field-side of each penalty box
    const arcR = s(50);
    const penSpotOffset = s(130);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(40 + penSpotOffset, H / 2, arcR, -Math.PI / 3, Math.PI / 3);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - 40 - penSpotOffset, H / 2, arcR, Math.PI - Math.PI / 3, Math.PI + Math.PI / 3);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Center circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, s(80), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, s(4), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    // Corner arcs
    [[40, 40], [W - 40, 40], [40, H - 40], [W - 40, H - 40]].forEach(([cx, cy]) => {
      const dx = cx === 40 ? 1 : -1;
      const dy = cy === 40 ? 1 : -1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, s(14), dx > 0 ? (dy > 0 ? 0 : 1.5 * Math.PI) : (dy > 0 ? 0.5 * Math.PI : Math.PI), dx > 0 ? (dy > 0 ? 0.5 * Math.PI : 0) : (dy > 0 ? Math.PI : 1.5 * Math.PI));
      ctx.stroke();
    });
  } else if (courtType === "hockey") {
    // === v28.8: Ice hockey rink ===
    // Center red line with dotted pattern
    ctx.setLineDash([10, 6]);
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(220, 70, 70, 0.85)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
    // Blue lines (1/3 from each end) — already proportional
    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(80, 130, 220, 0.75)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 3, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 3, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(2 * W / 3, 40); ctx.lineTo(2 * W / 3, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = lineColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    // Center face-off circle
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W / 2, H / 2, s(50), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Four end-zone face-off circles
    const faceoffOffset = s(180);
    [[faceoffOffset, H * 0.3], [faceoffOffset, H * 0.7], [W - faceoffOffset, H * 0.3], [W - faceoffOffset, H * 0.7]].forEach(([cx, cy]) => {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, s(50), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, s(4), 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    // Goalie creases — half-circles at each end
    const creaseR = s(40);
    const creaseOffset = s(70);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(80, 130, 220, 0.20)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(creaseOffset, H / 2, creaseR, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(W - creaseOffset, H / 2, creaseR, Math.PI / 2, 1.5 * Math.PI);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();
  } else if (courtType === "curling") {
    // === v28.8: Curling sheet ===
    // Center line
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 2, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
    // House at each end — 4 concentric rings
    const houseRadii = [s(60), s(45), s(28), s(12)];
    const houseColors = ["rgba(220, 70, 70, 0.40)", "rgba(255,255,255,0.10)", "rgba(80, 130, 220, 0.40)", "rgba(255,255,255,0.20)"];
    const houseOffset = s(180);
    [houseOffset, W - houseOffset].forEach((hx) => {
      for (let i = 0; i < houseRadii.length; i++) {
        ctx.fillStyle = houseColors[i];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(hx, H / 2, houseRadii[i], 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      // Tee line through center of each house
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(hx, 40); ctx.lineTo(hx, H - 40);
      ctx.stroke();
    });
    // Hog lines (where stones must cross)
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    const hogOffset = s(280);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 - hogOffset, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 - hogOffset, H - 40);
    ctx.moveTo(W / 2 + hogOffset, 40); ctx.lineTo(W / 2 + hogOffset, H - 40);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   CLOUD SHADOWS — soft semi-transparent dark patches that drift
   diagonally across the field. Drawn beneath the vignette so they
   read as actual cloud cover rather than a UI element.
   ============================================================ */
function drawCloudShadows(clouds) {
  for (const c of clouds) {
    const grd = ctx.createRadialGradient(
      c.x + c.w / 2, c.y + c.h / 2, 0,
      c.x + c.w / 2, c.y + c.h / 2, Math.max(c.w, c.h) / 2
    );
    grd.addColorStop(0, `rgba(0,0,0,${c.alpha})`);
    grd.addColorStop(0.7, `rgba(0,0,0,${c.alpha * 0.5})`);
    grd.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = grd;
    ctx.fillRect(c.x, c.y, c.w, c.h);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   STADIUM PITCH LIGHTS — soft warm flares in the four corners.
   Sells the broadcast-stadium fiction. Drawn AFTER the vignette
   so the lights cut through the dark corners. Each flare is a
   radial gradient from warm white at the corner edge to fully
   transparent at ~25% of the diagonal. Subtle but present.
   ============================================================ */
function drawPitchLights(W, H) {
  const flareR = Math.min(W, H) * 0.42;
  const corners = [
    [0,     0    ],   // top-left
    [W,     0    ],   // top-right
    [0,     H    ],   // bottom-left
    [W,     H    ],   // bottom-right
  ];
  for (const [cx, cy] of corners) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, 0, cx, cy, flareR);
    g.addColorStop(0,   "rgba(255,240,210,0.18)");
    g.addColorStop(0.4, "rgba(255,235,200,0.06)");
    g.addColorStop(1,   "rgba(255,235,200,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }
  // Tiny "lamp" pips in each corner so the lights have a visible source
  for (const [cx, cy] of corners) {
    const px = cx === 0 ? 8 : W - 8;
    const py = cy === 0 ? 8 : H - 8;
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,250,230,0.6)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,1)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(px, py, 1.0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   AMBIENT PARTICLES — biome-driven atmospheric layer drawn
   between cloud shadows and the vignette so they read as airborne
   particles in front of the field but behind the broadcast lighting.

   - snow: tiny white dot with soft halo
   - ember: glowing orange pip with halo + life-fade
   - petal: rotated soft pink ellipse (with highlight)
   - shimmer: vertical wobble line, very faint (heat distortion)
   ============================================================ */
function drawAmbientParticles(particles) {
  for (const p of particles) {
    if (p.type === "snow") {
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.18)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * 1.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.95)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "ember") {
      // Life-fade — particle dims as it rises
      const a = clamp(p.life / 80, 0.05, 0.85);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,140,40,${a * 0.30})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r * 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,200,80,${a})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "petal") {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,176,200,0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, p.r * 1.6, p.r * 0.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,210,225,0.95)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-p.r * 0.3, -p.r * 0.2, p.r * 0.7, p.r * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (p.type === "shimmer") {
      // Heat shimmer — short vertical wobble line, very faint
      const sway = Math.sin(p.phase) * 1.5;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,220,180,0.10)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x + sway, p.y);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x - sway, p.y + 5);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.type === "bubble") {
      // Underwater bubble — circle outline with a highlight pip
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(220,240,255,0.55)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.65)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x - p.r * 0.4, p.y - p.r * 0.4, p.r * 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "leaf") {
      // Larger drifting leaf — different from the static scatter leaves
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.rotate(p.rot);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(216,96,40,0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 0, p.r * 1.8, p.r * 0.9, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,52,18,0.6)";
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-p.r * 1.8, 0); ctx.lineTo(p.r * 1.8, 0);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    } else if (p.type === "firefly") {
      // Pulsing yellow-green dot with halo
      const pulse = 0.5 + Math.sin(p.phase) * 0.5;
      const a = clamp(p.life / 200, 0.3, 1);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(180,255,120,${pulse * 0.30 * a})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220,255,140,${pulse * 0.95 * a})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "spark") {
      // Bright neon trail — short streak with glow
      const a = clamp(p.life / 30, 0, 1);
      const isMagenta = p.hue === "magenta";
      const c1 = isMagenta ? "255,80,200" : "80,224,255";
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(${c1},${0.30 * a})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x - p.vx * 3, p.y - p.vy * 3);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.95 * a})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x - p.vx * 2, p.y - p.vy * 2);
      ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.stroke();
    } else if (p.type === "bat") {
      // Bat silhouette — wing flap via phase
      const wingY = Math.sin(p.phase) * 2;
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(20,15,25,0.85)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      // Body
      ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y, 2, 1.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      // Wings — left + right with flap
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x - 4, p.y + wingY, p.x - 7, p.y + wingY * 0.5);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x - 5, p.y + 1, p.x, p.y);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x + 4, p.y + wingY, p.x + 7, p.y + wingY * 0.5);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(p.x + 5, p.y + 1, p.x, p.y);
      ctx.fill();
    } else if (p.type === "drip") {
      // Cave water drip — small teardrop, brightens as it falls
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(120,200,255,0.35)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(p.x, p.y, 0.8, 1.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y - 0.3, 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
}

/* === v28.4: Stadium spectators ===
   Decorative crowd border drawn JUST OUTSIDE the playable field
   (negative coordinates for top, beyond arenaW for right, etc.) so
   the camera-fill scaling brings them into view as part of the scene.

   Each fan is a 3-color dot (head + body + occasional accent) at a
   fixed position with a small per-fan phase offset so the bobbing
   isn't synchronized. When m._crowdCheer is active (set on a kill),
   fans within crowdCheer.radius of crowdCheer.x bounce more vigorously.

   Honors LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableCrowd (settings toggle in v28.4). */
/* ============================================================
   JANITOR CLEANUP CREW — v37.22
   Between rounds and after matches, a small crew of janitorial
   sprites sweeps the field clean: clears corpses, picks up dropped
   items, removes blood spatter. Capped at ~7 seconds of animation.
   The crew runs off real-time animation (drawArena), not the sim
   tick — so they animate during paused phases when tickMatch is
   not running.

   Lifecycle:
     spawnJanitors(m)  — called from finalizeRound + finalizeMatch
                         and from showSeasonEnd. Adds 4 janitor
                         sprites at field edges, each with a target
                         priority list of debris to clean.
     tickJanitors(m)   — called from drawArena every frame. Walks
                         each janitor toward their next target,
                         "sweeps" when in range (debris removed),
                         walks them off when their list is empty
                         or the global timeout fires.
     drawJanitors(m)   — called from drawArena before player render
                         so they layer above corpses/blood and
                         below mascots+projectiles (which won't
                         exist mid-cleanup anyway).
   ============================================================ */
const JANITOR = {
  // === v37.23.4: wall-clock duration model ===
  // Previously the cleanup ran on a frame counter (140 frames), which gave
  // 4.7s at 30fps and 2.3s at 60fps — both too short for the design intent
  // of an 8-second cleanup show. Now driven by performance.now() deltas so
  // the duration is constant regardless of the user's FPS setting.
  // The "minimum round/match duration" follows from this: the autoplay
  // round cooldown is 60s by default, of which the first 8s belong to
  // the crew. (If a user manually skips the cooldown, we still let the
  // cleanup finish before the next round's terrain spawns.)
  WALK_SPEED:    3.6,        // px per real-time frame (~108px/s @ 30fps,
                             // ~216px/s @ 60fps — fast enough that a 4-crew
                             // can cover a 1280×720 field's debris in ~6-7s
                             // even with 8-10 targets per janitor).
  SWEEP_FRAMES:  10,         // ~0.33s @ 30fps. Visible "sweeping" pause.
  DURATION_MS:   8000,       // === Hard cap on the cleanup show ===
                             // 8 seconds wall-clock. Whatever the crew
                             // hasn't reached by this point gets cleaned
                             // up programmatically (scroll the field's
                             // debris arrays clean) so the next round
                             // opens on a tidy stadium.
  CREW_SIZE:     4,          // four janitors — four field edges
  COLOR_BODY:    "#3a4350",
  COLOR_BODY_ALT:"#4d5666",
  COLOR_HAT:     "#f7c948",  // yellow safety hat — they're staff
  COLOR_VEST:    "#ef9d3a",  // hi-vis orange vest
  COLOR_BROOM_H: "#7d4f3d",  // broom handle
  COLOR_BROOM_B: "#dccc8d",  // broom bristles
};

/* Spawn the cleanup crew. Builds a target queue per janitor by
   round-robin assigning all current debris (corpses, drops, blood
   pools) to the four crew members.

   Idempotent in spirit: calling twice in the same paused window
   simply REPLACES the crew (rare; only if user manually re-triggers
   intermission UI). */
function spawnJanitors(m) {
  if (!m) return;
  const W = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280;
  const H = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  m.janitors = [];
  // === v37.23.4: wall-clock spawn timestamp ===
  // performance.now() is monotonic and works during pause phases when
  // the sim isn't ticking. We use it for both the duration check and
  // the optional thank-you-banner timing.
  m._janitorSpawnTs = (typeof performance !== "undefined" && performance.now)
    ? performance.now()
    : Date.now();
  // Per-cleanup-cycle tallies (reset every spawn; accumulate into the
  // league cleanup log when the crew finishes).
  m._janitorSwept = { corpses: 0, drops: 0, drops_legacy: 0, blood: 0 };

  // Build target list — one entry per debris piece. Each target carries
  // a reference back to the source array so we can splice on sweep.
  const targets = [];
  if (m.corpses && m.corpses.length) {
    for (const c of m.corpses) targets.push({ x: c.x, y: c.y, ref: c, kind: "corpse" });
  }
  // === v37.22: drop-sweep policy ===
  // Between ROUNDS (m.phase === "betweenRounds"): only sweep neutral
  // spawn drops (health packs, armor pickups, etc.) — those have no
  // `fromName`. Scavenged legacy gear (Bristlebeard's Riot Shield, etc.)
  // has `fromName` set by dropGear and MUST persist across rounds so
  // surviving knights can still scavenge it. After a perma-death's
  // legacy weapon hits the field, the rest of the match should still
  // see it on the field.
  // Between MATCHES (m.phase === "post"): sweep everything. The next
  // match starts on a different field (new `m` object) anyway, so
  // there's nothing to preserve.
  const sweepAllDrops = m.phase === "post";
  if (m.drops && m.drops.length) {
    for (const d of m.drops) {
      const isLegacy = d && d.fromName;
      if (sweepAllDrops || !isLegacy) {
        targets.push({ x: d.x, y: d.y, ref: d, kind: "drop" });
      }
    }
  }
  // Blood pools — sample sparsely so we don't queue 200 targets.
  // We just sweep every 8th blood splatter; the rest fade naturally.
  if (m.blood && m.blood.length) {
    for (let i = 0; i < m.blood.length; i += 8) {
      targets.push({ x: m.blood[i].x, y: m.blood[i].y, ref: m.blood[i], kind: "blood" });
    }
  }

  // Spawn one janitor per field edge: top, right, bottom, left.
  // Each gets every Nth target in round-robin order so the field
  // is cleared evenly rather than one corner first.
  const edges = [
    { x: W * 0.25, y: -10,      // entry from top
      walkOffX: W * 0.25, walkOffY: -10 },
    { x: W + 10, y: H * 0.25,   // from right
      walkOffX: W + 10, walkOffY: H * 0.25 },
    { x: W * 0.75, y: H + 10,   // from bottom
      walkOffX: W * 0.75, walkOffY: H + 10 },
    { x: -10, y: H * 0.75,      // from left
      walkOffX: -10, walkOffY: H * 0.75 },
  ];
  // === v37.23.6: procedural crew sizing ===
  // Right-size the crew to the actual debris pile so the cleanup
  // finishes in the 8-second window. Each janitor comfortably handles
  // ~5 items in 8s (walk + sweep + walk to next + sweep). Tip tier
  // adds +1 for celebrity flair at 50+ lifetime tips.
  const tipTier = LEAGUE.janitorTips || 0;
  const itemCount = targets.length;
  // Throughput target: 5 items per janitor in the 8s window.
  // At minimum, the original 4-crew. At maximum, 12 (visual chaos cap).
  // Tips add +1 to the upper bound at 50+ tips.
  const throughputCrew = Math.ceil(itemCount / 5);
  const tipBonus = tipTier >= 50 ? 1 : 0;
  const crewSize = Math.max(JANITOR.CREW_SIZE, Math.min(12, throughputCrew + tipBonus));

  // === Spawn-edge expansion ===
  // Original 4 edges = top-25%, right-25%, bottom-75%, left-75%.
  // For a larger crew we add additional perimeter entries:
  //   5th: bottom-50% (center-bottom)
  //   6th: top-50%    (center-top)
  //   7th: top-75%    (top-right approach)
  //   8th: bottom-25% (bottom-left approach)
  //   9th: left-25%   (left-mid-upper)
  //  10th: right-75%  (right-mid-lower)
  //  11th: top-12%    (top-left approach, very near corner)
  //  12th: bottom-88% (bottom-right approach, very near corner)
  // The existing 4 are pushed in spawnJanitors above; we extend in-place.
  const extraEdges = [
    { x: W * 0.50, y: H + 10,    walkOffX: W * 0.50, walkOffY: H + 10    },  // 5
    { x: W * 0.50, y: -10,       walkOffX: W * 0.50, walkOffY: -10       },  // 6
    { x: W * 0.75, y: -10,       walkOffX: W * 0.75, walkOffY: -10       },  // 7
    { x: W * 0.25, y: H + 10,    walkOffX: W * 0.25, walkOffY: H + 10    },  // 8
    { x: -10,      y: H * 0.25,  walkOffX: -10,      walkOffY: H * 0.25  },  // 9
    { x: W + 10,   y: H * 0.75,  walkOffX: W + 10,   walkOffY: H * 0.75  },  // 10
    { x: W * 0.12, y: -10,       walkOffX: W * 0.12, walkOffY: -10       },  // 11
    { x: W * 0.88, y: H + 10,    walkOffX: W * 0.88, walkOffY: H + 10    },  // 12
  ];
  while (edges.length < crewSize && extraEdges.length > 0) {
    edges.push(extraEdges.shift());
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < crewSize; i++) {
    const myTargets = [];
    for (let t = i; t < targets.length; t += JANITOR.CREW_SIZE) {
      myTargets.push(targets[t]);
    }
    m.janitors.push({
      x: edges[i].x,
      y: edges[i].y,
      walkOffX: edges[i].walkOffX,
      walkOffY: edges[i].walkOffY,
      targets: myTargets,
      currentTarget: null,
      state: "walking",
      sweepLeft: 0,
      bobPhase: i * 1.7,
      // Slight species variety — color tweak per crew member
      bodyColor: i % 2 === 0 ? JANITOR.COLOR_BODY : JANITOR.COLOR_BODY_ALT,
    });
  }
  // === v37.23.3: thank-you banner at 50+ tips ===
  // Fires once per cleanup spawn — a small floating "THANK YOU" text
  // hovers over the crew's first member during their first sweep.
  if (tipTier >= 50 && m.floats) {
    m.floats.push({
      x: m.janitors[0].x,
      y: m.janitors[0].y - 24,
      text: "THANK YOU",
      life: 80,
      color: "#8cc86e",
    });
  }
}
window.spawnJanitors = spawnJanitors;

/* Advance the cleanup crew by one render frame. Cheap when no crew
   is active (returns immediately). */
function tickJanitors(m) {
  if (!m || !m.janitors || m.janitors.length === 0) return;

  // === v37.23.4: wall-clock duration check ===
  // performance.now() is monotonic across pause phases, frame-rate
  // independent, and accurate to ~ms. The cleanup runs for exactly
  // JANITOR.DURATION_MS regardless of whether the user has set 30fps
  // or 60fps render mode.
  const now = (typeof performance !== "undefined" && performance.now)
    ? performance.now()
    : Date.now();
  const spawnTs = m._janitorSpawnTs || now;
  const elapsedMs = now - spawnTs;
  const timedOut = elapsedMs > JANITOR.DURATION_MS;

  let allDone = true;
  for (const j of m.janitors) {
    j.bobPhase += 0.2;

    if (j.state === "walking") {
      // If we don't have a current target, pick one (next in queue).
      if (!j.currentTarget) {
        if (timedOut || j.targets.length === 0) {
          j.state = "leaving";
          continue;
        }
        j.currentTarget = j.targets.shift();
      }
      // Walk toward currentTarget
      const tx = j.currentTarget.x, ty = j.currentTarget.y;
      const dx = tx - j.x, dy = ty - j.y;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (dist < 6) {
        // Arrived — start sweeping
        j.state = "sweeping";
        j.sweepLeft = JANITOR.SWEEP_FRAMES;
        allDone = false;
      } else {
        const sp = JANITOR.WALK_SPEED;
        j.x += (dx / dist) * sp;
        j.y += (dy / dist) * sp;
        allDone = false;
      }
    } else if (j.state === "sweeping") {
      j.sweepLeft--;
      if (j.sweepLeft <= 0) {
        // Sweep done — remove the debris and tally it for the records
        const t = j.currentTarget;
        const tally = m._janitorSwept || (m._janitorSwept = { corpses: 0, drops: 0, drops_legacy: 0, blood: 0 });
        if (t && t.kind === "corpse" && m.corpses) {
          const i = m.corpses.indexOf(t.ref);
          if (i >= 0) {
            m.corpses.splice(i, 1);
            tally.corpses++;
          }
        } else if (t && t.kind === "drop" && m.drops) {
          const i = m.drops.indexOf(t.ref);
          if (i >= 0) {
            // === v37.23.4: legacy gear gets logged separately ===
            // Items with a fromName were carried by a knight before being
            // dropped on the field. When the crew sweeps these (only
            // happens between matches; between rounds we preserve them),
            // they enter the lost-items record like any other lost piece.
            const drop = m.drops[i];
            if (drop && drop.fromName) {
              tally.drops_legacy++;
              if (typeof LEAGUE !== "undefined" && drop.gear) {
                if (!LEAGUE.lostItems) LEAGUE.lostItems = [];
                LEAGUE.lostItems.push({
                  season: LEAGUE.season,
                  slot: m.slot || "?",
                  slotType: drop.slot,
                  name: drop.gear.displayName || drop.gear.name,
                  baseName: drop.gear.name,
                  scavengedCount: drop.gear.scavengedCount || 0,
                  ico: drop.gear.ico,
                  lostBy: drop.fromName,
                  // Marks this entry as cleanup-recorded vs naturally lost
                  cleanupSwept: true,
                });
              }
            } else {
              tally.drops++;
            }
            m.drops.splice(i, 1);
          }
        } else if (t && t.kind === "blood" && m.blood) {
          // Sweep a small radius of blood near the target
          let bloodSwept = 0;
          for (let i = m.blood.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const b = m.blood[i];
            const ddx = b.x - t.x, ddy = b.y - t.y;
            if (ddx * ddx + ddy * ddy < 14 * 14) {
              m.blood.splice(i, 1);
              bloodSwept++;
            }
          }
          tally.blood += bloodSwept;
        }
        j.currentTarget = null;
        j.state = "walking";
      }
      allDone = false;
    } else if (j.state === "leaving") {
      // Walk back to off-field exit point
      const dx = j.walkOffX - j.x, dy = j.walkOffY - j.y;
      const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      if (dist < 4) {
        j.state = "gone";
      } else {
        const sp = JANITOR.WALK_SPEED * 1.3; // exit a bit faster
        j.x += (dx / dist) * sp;
        j.y += (dy / dist) * sp;
        allDone = false;
      }
    }
    // "gone" state — no action; janitor is invisible
  }

  if (timedOut) {
    // Force any still-walking/sweeping janitors to exit
    for (const j of m.janitors) {
      if (j.state !== "gone" && j.state !== "leaving") {
        j.state = "leaving";
      }
    }
  }

  // If everyone's gone, drop the array entirely so we stop ticking
  if (m.janitors.every(j => j.state === "gone")) {
    m.janitors = [];
    // === v37.23.4: enter the cleanup into the records ===
    // Per-cycle tally accumulates into LEAGUE.cleanupLog (lifetime
    // totals), and a summary feed line fires once.
    const tally = m._janitorSwept || { corpses: 0, drops: 0, drops_legacy: 0, blood: 0 };
    const totalSwept = tally.corpses + tally.drops + tally.drops_legacy + tally.blood;
    if (typeof LEAGUE !== "undefined") {
      if (!LEAGUE.cleanupLog) {
        LEAGUE.cleanupLog = { lifetimeCorpses: 0, lifetimeDrops: 0, lifetimeLegacyDrops: 0, lifetimeBlood: 0, totalCleanups: 0 };
      }
      LEAGUE.cleanupLog.lifetimeCorpses += tally.corpses;
      LEAGUE.cleanupLog.lifetimeDrops += tally.drops;
      LEAGUE.cleanupLog.lifetimeLegacyDrops += tally.drops_legacy;
      LEAGUE.cleanupLog.lifetimeBlood += tally.blood;
      LEAGUE.cleanupLog.totalCleanups++;
    }
    // Summary feed line — only when the crew actually swept something
    if (totalSwept > 0 && typeof feed === "function") {
      const parts = [];
      if (tally.corpses > 0) parts.push(`${tally.corpses} corpse${tally.corpses === 1 ? "" : "s"}`);
      if (tally.drops > 0) parts.push(`${tally.drops} loose item${tally.drops === 1 ? "" : "s"}`);
      if (tally.drops_legacy > 0) parts.push(`${tally.drops_legacy} legacy weapon${tally.drops_legacy === 1 ? "" : "s"}`);
      if (tally.blood > 0) parts.push(`${tally.blood} blood spatter${tally.blood === 1 ? "" : "s"}`);
      feed("season", `🧹 Cleanup complete — the crew has, on the matter, processed ${parts.join(", ")} into the records.`);
    }
    m._janitorSwept = null;

    // Final cleanup: at this point we want any remaining corpses /
    // drops / blood the crew didn't get to ALSO removed, so the
    // next round opens on a clean field. (Without this, a long
    // debris list would survive the timeout.)
    // === v37.22: preserve legacy drops between rounds ===
    // Same policy as spawnJanitors: legacy gear (with fromName) must
    // persist across rounds so the scavenge lineage chain continues.
    // Only between matches (phase==="post") does everything go.
    m.corpses = [];
    m.blood = [];
    if (m.phase === "post") {
      m.drops = [];
    } else {
      m.drops = (m.drops || []).filter(d => d && d.fromName);
    }
  }
}
window.tickJanitors = tickJanitors;

/* Render the cleanup crew. Tiny pixel-art figures with a yellow
   safety hat, hi-vis orange vest, and a broom held angled toward
   their sweep direction. */
function drawJanitors(m) {
  if (!m || !m.janitors || m.janitors.length === 0) return;
  for (const j of m.janitors) {
    if (j.state === "gone") continue;
    const x = Math.floor(j.x);
    const y = Math.floor(j.y);
    const bob = Math.floor(Math.sin(j.bobPhase) * 1.2);

    // Shadow
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(x, y + 6, 6, 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    // Body (rectangle torso)
    ctx.fillStyle = j.bodyColor;
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y - 3 + bob, 6, 6);

    // === v37.23.3: tip-tier vest color (20+ tips switches to hi-vis green) ===
    const _vestColor = (LEAGUE.janitorTips || 0) >= 20
      ? "#8cc86e"               // LMG-sponsored hi-vis green
      : JANITOR.COLOR_VEST;     // standard orange
    ctx.fillStyle = _vestColor;
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y - 1 + bob, 6, 3);

    // Head
    ctx.fillStyle = "#dba373";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y - 8 + bob, 4, 4);

    // Hat (yellow safety hard-hat)
    ctx.fillStyle = JANITOR.COLOR_HAT;
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, y - 9 + bob, 6, 2);
    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y - 10 + bob, 4, 1);
    // === v37.23.3: tip-tier hat pin (5+ tips) ===
    // A single-pixel gold sparkle on the front of the hat. Subtle, but
    // noticeable when you know to look.
    const _tips = LEAGUE.janitorTips || 0;
    if (_tips >= 5) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fff4a8";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - 10 + bob, 1, 1);
    }

    // Legs (small, black)
    ctx.fillStyle = "#1a1d22";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 2, y + 3 + bob, 2, 3);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 0, y + 3 + bob, 2, 3);

    // Broom — angled differently in each state
    ctx.strokeStyle = JANITOR.COLOR_BROOM_H;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    if (j.state === "sweeping") {
      // Animated sweep — the broom oscillates while sweeping
      const sweepAng = Math.sin(j.bobPhase * 1.5) * 0.4 + 0.5;
      const bx1 = x + 4, by1 = y - 4 + bob;
      const bx2 = x + 4 + Math.cos(sweepAng) * 8;
      const by2 = y - 4 + bob + Math.sin(sweepAng) * 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(bx1, by1);
      ctx.lineTo(bx2, by2);
      ctx.stroke();
      // Bristles
      ctx.fillStyle = JANITOR.COLOR_BROOM_B;
      ctx.fillRect(Math.floor(bx2 - 2), Math.floor(by2 - 1), 4, 3);
      // Sparkle puff to show sweeping is doing something
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(220,210,180,0.55)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(bx2, by2 + 2, 3 + Math.sin(j.bobPhase * 2) * 1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      // Walking pose — broom slung diagonally
      const bx1 = x + 3, by1 = y - 4 + bob;
      const bx2 = x + 8, by2 = y + 2 + bob;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(bx1, by1);
      ctx.lineTo(bx2, by2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = JANITOR.COLOR_BROOM_B;
      ctx.fillRect(bx2 - 1, by2 - 1, 3, 3);
    }
  }
}
window.drawJanitors = drawJanitors;

const CROWD_DEPTH = 180;       // v37.15: was 32 — extended deep enough that
                                // at MIN_ZOOM=0.55 the seating fills the
                                // perimeter the camera now reveals. Seating
                                // tiers stretch back from the field edge to
                                // the dark concrete back wall, with crowd
                                // density highest near the field and thinning
                                // out toward the rear (mimicking real stadiums
                                // where front-row seats are most populated).
const CROWD_STRIDE = 11;       // spacing between fans
const CROWD_ROWS = 12;         // v37.15: was 3 — twelve rows of seating, with
                                // density falling off in the back rows so the
                                // camera reveal feels fuller without doubling
                                // the per-frame fan-draw cost (back rows have
                                // wider stride). See _buildCrowdCache.
const CROWD_PALETTE = [
  // Pre-baked muted fan colors. Random pick per fan, deterministic via index.
  ["#7d4f3d", "#4a3625", "#a86d4d"],
  ["#4d5a8a", "#34406b", "#6f7eb5"],
  ["#6a8c5a", "#48663d", "#8baf78"],
  ["#8c5a6a", "#664050", "#b07c8c"],
  ["#5a7a8c", "#3d5b6a", "#7ca0b5"],
  ["#8c8a5a", "#666340", "#b0ad7c"],
  ["#6a4d8c", "#4d3866", "#8b6db0"],
];
let _crowdCache = null;  // cache of fan positions, recomputed if arena dims change

function _buildCrowdCache() {
  const W = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280;
  const H = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  const fans = [];
  // v37.15: row spacing computed from CROWD_DEPTH so the rows fill the
  // entire perimeter band cleanly. Back rows have a wider stride so they
  // appear more sparsely populated (matches how real stadiums look from
  // a wide camera — front rows always full, back rows scattered).
  const rowSpacing = (CROWD_DEPTH - 8) / CROWD_ROWS;
  // Top edge — fans facing down toward field
  for (let row = 0; row < CROWD_ROWS; row++) {
    const y = -CROWD_DEPTH + 4 + row * rowSpacing;
    const offset = (row % 2) * (CROWD_STRIDE / 2);
    // Back rows get wider stride (sparser)
    const stride = CROWD_STRIDE * (1 + row * 0.15);
    for (let x = -16 + offset; x < W + 16; x += stride) {
      fans.push({ x, y, palette: CROWD_PALETTE[(x + row * 7) | 0 & 7 % CROWD_PALETTE.length || 0], side: "top" });
    }
  }
  // Bottom edge
  for (let row = 0; row < CROWD_ROWS; row++) {
    const y = H + 4 + (CROWD_ROWS - 1 - row) * rowSpacing;
    const offset = (row % 2) * (CROWD_STRIDE / 2);
    const stride = CROWD_STRIDE * (1 + row * 0.15);
    for (let x = -16 + offset; x < W + 16; x += stride) {
      fans.push({ x, y, palette: CROWD_PALETTE[((x * 3 + row * 11) | 0) & 7 % CROWD_PALETTE.length || 0], side: "bottom" });
    }
  }
  // Left edge — narrower because the canvas extends only a bit past the field
  for (let row = 0; row < CROWD_ROWS; row++) {
    const x = -CROWD_DEPTH + 4 + row * rowSpacing;
    const offset = (row % 2) * (CROWD_STRIDE / 2);
    const stride = CROWD_STRIDE * (1 + row * 0.15);
    for (let y = -16 + offset; y < H + 16; y += stride) {
      fans.push({ x, y, palette: CROWD_PALETTE[((y + row * 5) | 0) & 7 % CROWD_PALETTE.length || 0], side: "left" });
    }
  }
  // Right edge
  for (let row = 0; row < CROWD_ROWS; row++) {
    const x = W + 4 + (CROWD_ROWS - 1 - row) * rowSpacing;
    const offset = (row % 2) * (CROWD_STRIDE / 2);
    const stride = CROWD_STRIDE * (1 + row * 0.15);
    for (let y = -16 + offset; y < H + 16; y += stride) {
      fans.push({ x, y, palette: CROWD_PALETTE[((y * 3 + row * 13) | 0) & 7 % CROWD_PALETTE.length || 0], side: "right" });
    }
  }
  // Add stable per-fan random phase for bobbing
  for (let i = 0; i < fans.length; i++) {
    fans[i].phase = (i * 0.731) % (Math.PI * 2);
  }
  // Pre-resolve palette lookups (the % calc above can produce 0/undefined
  // due to JS bitwise edge cases — fall back to first palette).
  for (const f of fans) {
    if (!f.palette || !Array.isArray(f.palette)) f.palette = CROWD_PALETTE[0];
  }
  _crowdCache = { W, H, fans };
}

function drawCrowd(m) {
  if (LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableCrowd) return;
  // Build cache lazily / on resize
  const W = COMBAT.arenaW || 1280;
  const H = COMBAT.arenaH || 720;
  if (!_crowdCache || _crowdCache.W !== W || _crowdCache.H !== H) {
    _buildCrowdCache();
  }
  const fans = _crowdCache.fans;
  const t = (m && m.frame !== undefined) ? m.frame : 0;
  const cheer = m && m._crowdCheer;
  const cheerActive = cheer && (t - cheer.frame) < 30;

  // === v37.15: Stadium back wall + colored field-edge chip ===
  // Three-layer stadium framing, drawn from outside in:
  //  1. Outer concrete back wall (extends well past the field so even at
  //     the new MIN_ZOOM=0.55 the camera reveal doesn't expose canvas bg)
  //  2. Mid stadium-tier band (slightly lighter, suggests seating riser)
  //  3. Themed color chip — a thin bright accent band at the field edge,
