/* v37.11: Render the FORMATION_PRESETS data as the sidebar HTML.
   Groups are header-separated so the long list scans cleanly. Each
   preset shows its name, a one-line lore description, and a small
   inline pill-row preview of the role icons in the lineup. */
function _renderFormationPresetsHtml() {
  const groups = {};
  for (const p of FORMATION_PRESETS) {
    const g = p.group || "Other";
    if (!groups[g]) groups[g] = [];
    groups[g].push(p);
  }
  const order = ["Defaults", "Team Styles", "Specialty", "Other"];
  const html = [];
  for (const g of order) {
    if (!groups[g]) continue;
    html.push(`<div class="formation-preset-group-h">${_escHtml(g)}</div>`);
    for (let i = 0; i < groups[g].length; i++) {
      const p = groups[g][i];
      // Find global index in FORMATION_PRESETS so the click handler
      // can look the preset back up by index.
      const globalIdx = FORMATION_PRESETS.indexOf(p);
      const iconRow = (p.lines || []).map(line => {
        const idLower = String(line).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, "");
        const id = FORMATION_SHORTHAND[idLower];
        const pos = (typeof POSITIONS !== "undefined" && id) ? POSITIONS.find(pp => pp.id === id) : null;
        return pos ? `<span class="formation-preset-icon" title="${_escHtml(pos.label)}">${_escHtml(pos.icon || "")}</span>` : "";
      }).join("");
      html.push(`
        <button class="formation-preset-item" data-preset-idx="${globalIdx}" type="button">
          <div class="formation-preset-item-head">
            <span class="formation-preset-name">${_escHtml(p.name)}</span>
            <span class="formation-preset-count">${(p.lines || []).length}</span>
          </div>
          <div class="formation-preset-icons">${iconRow}</div>
          <div class="formation-preset-lore">${_escHtml(p.lore || "")}</div>
        </button>
      `);
    }
  }
  return html.join("");
}

/* v37.8: Render an array of position-ids into a row of icon-pills,
   each colored by the matching POSITIONS[] css class. Used in the
   Edit Formation modal to give the user a visual at-a-glance read
   of the formation alongside the textarea. */
function _renderFormationPreview(containerId, ids) {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!el) return;
  if (!ids || !ids.length) {
    el.innerHTML = `<div class="formation-pill formation-pill-empty">empty</div>`;
    return;
  }
  const pills = ids.map(id => {
    const pos = (typeof POSITIONS !== "undefined") ? POSITIONS.find(p => p.id === id) : null;
    if (!pos) return `<div class="formation-pill formation-pill-unknown" title="Unknown role: ${_escHtml(id)}">?</div>`;
    return `<div class="formation-pill ${_escHtml(pos.cls || "")}" title="${_escHtml(pos.label)}"><span class="formation-pill-icon">${_escHtml(pos.icon || "")}</span><span class="formation-pill-label">${_escHtml(pos.label)}</span></div>`;
  }).join("");
  el.innerHTML = pills;
}

function openFormationEditor() {
  if (typeof openModal !== "function") return;
  const initial = _formationListFromConfig();

  const body = `
    <div class="formation-editor formation-editor-with-presets">
      <!-- v37.11: Mobile hamburger to toggle the preset sidebar.
           Hidden on desktop where the sidebar is always visible. -->
      <button class="formation-presets-hamburger" id="formationPresetsHamburger" type="button" aria-label="Toggle preset list">☰ Presets</button>

      <!-- Preset sidebar — desktop: side panel; mobile: floating drawer -->
      <aside class="formation-presets-aside" id="formationPresetsAside">
        <div class="formation-presets-header">
          <span>Lineup Presets</span>
          <button class="formation-presets-close" id="formationPresetsClose" type="button" aria-label="Close preset list">×</button>
        </div>
        <div class="formation-presets-list" id="formationPresetsList">${_renderFormationPresetsHtml()}</div>
      </aside>

      <div class="formation-editor-main">
        <div class="formation-shorthand-help">
          <b>Shorthand</b> — one bot per line (or comma-separated). Recognized:
          <code>Tank</code> <code>Striker</code> <code>Speedster</code>
          <code>Brawler</code> <code>Sniper</code> <code>Healer</code>
          <code>Grenadier</code>. Short forms (T, Str, Sp, B, Sn, H, G) also work.
          Max ${FORMATION_MAX} per team. Need at least 3, with at least 2
          different archetypes. Healer-only teams are invalid.
        </div>

        <div class="formation-mirror-row">
          <label class="toggle-label" style="flex:0 0 auto;">
            <input type="checkbox" id="formationMirror" ${initial.mirror ? "checked" : ""} />
            <span class="toggle-slider"></span>
            <span class="toggle-text">Mirror both teams</span>
          </label>
          <span style="color:var(--mute);font-size:11px;">Off = edit each team separately</span>
        </div>

        <!-- v37.9: Quick-add buttons. Click any role to append it as a
             new line on the focused textarea (or the left textarea if
             neither is focused). Friendlier than typing for novices,
             and faster than typing for everyone else. -->
        <div class="formation-quickadd-row">
          <span class="formation-quickadd-label">Quick add:</span>
          <button class="formation-quickadd-btn pos-tank"      data-role="Tank">🛡️ Tank</button>
          <button class="formation-quickadd-btn pos-striker"   data-role="Striker">⚔️ Striker</button>
          <button class="formation-quickadd-btn pos-speed"     data-role="Speedster">💨 Speedster</button>
          <button class="formation-quickadd-btn pos-brawl"     data-role="Brawler">👊 Brawler</button>
          <button class="formation-quickadd-btn pos-sniper"    data-role="Sniper">🎯 Sniper</button>
          <button class="formation-quickadd-btn pos-healer"    data-role="Healer">✚ Healer</button>
          <button class="formation-quickadd-btn pos-grenadier" data-role="Grenadier">💣 Grenadier</button>
        </div>

        <div class="formation-textareas">
          <div class="formation-side">
            <label for="formationLeft">${initial.mirror ? "Both teams" : "Left team"}</label>
            <textarea id="formationLeft" class="formation-textarea" spellcheck="false">${_escHtml((initial.left || []).join("\n"))}</textarea>
          </div>
          <div class="formation-side">
            <label for="formationRight">Right team</label>
            <textarea id="formationRight" class="formation-textarea" spellcheck="false" ${initial.mirror ? "disabled" : ""}>${_escHtml((initial.right || []).join("\n"))}</textarea>
          </div>
        </div>

        <!-- v37.8: Visual lineup preview — translates the shorthand
             into role icon-pills so the user can see at a glance what
             the formation looks like beyond the text.  -->
        <div class="formation-preview-row">
          <div class="formation-preview-side">
            <div class="formation-preview-label">${initial.mirror ? "Both teams" : "Left lineup"}</div>
            <div class="formation-preview-pills" id="formationPreviewLeft"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="formation-preview-side" id="formationPreviewSideRight" style="display:${initial.mirror ? "none" : "block"};">
            <div class="formation-preview-label">Right lineup</div>
            <div class="formation-preview-pills" id="formationPreviewRight"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="formation-validation" id="formationValidationLeft">—</div>
        <div class="formation-validation" id="formationValidationRight" style="display:${initial.mirror ? "none" : "block"};">—</div>

        <div class="formation-actions">
          <button id="formationReset" class="danger">Reset to default</button>
          <button id="formationCancel">Cancel</button>
          <button id="formationSave" class="primary">Save</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  openModal("⚔️ Edit Formation", body, "", null, { width: "wide" });

  // --- wire up live validation + mirror toggle ---
  const leftTA  = document.getElementById("formationLeft");
  const rightTA = document.getElementById("formationRight");
  const mirror  = document.getElementById("formationMirror");
  const valL    = document.getElementById("formationValidationLeft");
  const valR    = document.getElementById("formationValidationRight");
  const labelLeft = leftTA.parentElement.querySelector("label");

  function _runValidation() {
    const lp = _parseFormationLines(leftTA.value);
    const lv = _validateFormation(lp.ids, lp.unknowns);
    valL.textContent = "Left: " + lv.msg;
    valL.className = "formation-validation " + lv.kind;

    // === v37.8: Update the visual lineup preview alongside validation ===
    _renderFormationPreview("formationPreviewLeft", lp.ids);

    if (mirror.checked) {
      valR.style.display = "none";
      const sideRight = document.getElementById("formationPreviewSideRight");
      if (sideRight) sideRight.style.display = "none";
      return { leftIds: lp.ids, rightIds: lp.ids, leftOk: lv.ok, rightOk: lv.ok };
    } else {
      valR.style.display = "block";
      const sideRight = document.getElementById("formationPreviewSideRight");
      if (sideRight) sideRight.style.display = "block";
      const rp = _parseFormationLines(rightTA.value);
      const rv = _validateFormation(rp.ids, rp.unknowns);
      valR.textContent = "Right: " + rv.msg;
      valR.className = "formation-validation " + rv.kind;
      _renderFormationPreview("formationPreviewRight", rp.ids);
      return { leftIds: lp.ids, rightIds: rp.ids, leftOk: lv.ok, rightOk: rv.ok };
    }
  }

  function _applyMirrorToggle() {
    if (mirror.checked) {
      rightTA.disabled = true;
      labelLeft.textContent = "Both teams";
    } else {
      rightTA.disabled = false;
      labelLeft.textContent = "Left team";
    }
    _runValidation();
  }

  leftTA.addEventListener("input", _runValidation);
  rightTA.addEventListener("input", _runValidation);
  mirror.addEventListener("change", _applyMirrorToggle);
  _runValidation();

  // === v37.9: Quick-add button wiring ===
  // Track the most-recently-focused textarea so quick-add knows which
  // side the user wants to extend. Default to leftTA when nothing is
  // focused (which is the common opening case).
  let _formationLastFocused = leftTA;
  leftTA.addEventListener("focus",  () => { _formationLastFocused = leftTA;  });
  rightTA.addEventListener("focus", () => { _formationLastFocused = rightTA; });
  document.querySelectorAll(".formation-quickadd-btn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const role = btn.dataset.role;
      if (!role) return;
      // If mirror-mode is on the right textarea is disabled; we only
      // ever want to append to the left in that case.
      const target = (mirror.checked || _formationLastFocused === rightTA && rightTA.disabled)
        ? leftTA
        : (_formationLastFocused || leftTA);
      // Append on a new line, but only add the leading newline if the
      // box already has content — keeps the "first add to empty box"
      // case clean.
      const cur = target.value.replace(/\s+$/, "");
      target.value = cur ? cur + "\n" + role : role;
      target.focus();
      // Move cursor to end so the next quick-add appends below
      target.selectionStart = target.selectionEnd = target.value.length;
      _runValidation();
    });
  });

  // === v37.11: Preset picker wiring ===
  // Click on any preset row to load its lines into the active textarea
  // (or both, if mirror-mode is on). The presets are validated by the
  // standard rules; if a preset somehow fails (shouldn't, by design),
  // we still load it so the user can see the validation message.
  document.querySelectorAll(".formation-preset-item").forEach(item => {
    item.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const idx = parseInt(item.dataset.presetIdx, 10);
      const preset = FORMATION_PRESETS[idx];
      if (!preset || !Array.isArray(preset.lines)) return;
      const lineText = preset.lines.join("\n");
      // In mirror mode, only the left textarea is editable, but we
      // still write to both so the underlying state is coherent.
      leftTA.value = lineText;
      if (!mirror.checked) {
        // Non-mirror: prefer the last-focused textarea so users can
        // load a left preset and a different right preset if they want.
        if (_formationLastFocused === rightTA && !rightTA.disabled) {
          rightTA.value = lineText;
        } else {
          // Default to writing to both — the user can manually re-pick
          // the right side if they want it different.
          rightTA.value = lineText;
        }
      } else {
        rightTA.value = lineText;
      }
      _runValidation();
      if (typeof toast === "function") toast(`Loaded preset: ${preset.name}`, "info");
      // On mobile, close the preset drawer after a selection — saves
      // a tap and gets the user back to the editor faster.
      const aside = document.getElementById("formationPresetsAside");
      if (aside && aside.classList.contains("formation-presets-open-mobile")) {
        aside.classList.remove("formation-presets-open-mobile");
      }
    });
  });

  // Mobile hamburger toggle — opens the preset drawer as a slide-in
  // panel. On desktop the hamburger button is hidden via CSS and
  // the drawer is always visible alongside the editor.
  const presetsHamburger = document.getElementById("formationPresetsHamburger");
  const presetsClose     = document.getElementById("formationPresetsClose");
  const presetsAside     = document.getElementById("formationPresetsAside");
  if (presetsHamburger && presetsAside) {
    presetsHamburger.addEventListener("click", () => {
      presetsAside.classList.toggle("formation-presets-open-mobile");
    });
  }
  if (presetsClose && presetsAside) {
    presetsClose.addEventListener("click", () => {
      presetsAside.classList.remove("formation-presets-open-mobile");
    });
  }

  // --- Reset / Cancel / Save ---
  document.getElementById("formationReset").addEventListener("click", () => {
    leftTA.value = FORMATION_DEFAULT_LINES.join("\n");
    rightTA.value = FORMATION_DEFAULT_LINES.join("\n");
    mirror.checked = true;
    _applyMirrorToggle();
  });
  document.getElementById("formationCancel").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (typeof closeModal === "function") closeModal();
  });
  document.getElementById("formationSave").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const v = _runValidation();
    if (!v.leftOk || (!mirror.checked && !v.rightOk)) {
      if (typeof toast === "function") toast("Cannot save — fix the errors above.", "warn");
      return;
    }
    // "Are you sure?" confirmation
    _confirmDialog(
      "Save formation changes?",
      `<p>This replaces the default seven-archetype lineup for new rosters.<br>The change takes effect at the next league reset.</p>`,
      { confirmLabel: "I'm sure", cancelLabel: "Go back" },
      () => {
        // Save: convert shorthand resolution back to the canonical labels
        // for storage (so the editor can reload them human-readable next
        // time), and store the parsed archetype-id list separately for
        // the simulation to consume.
        const formatStored = (ids) => ids.map(id => {
          // Canonical label from POSITIONS where possible
          const pos = (typeof POSITIONS !== "undefined") ? POSITIONS.find(p => p.id === id) : null;
          return pos ? pos.label : id;
        });
        const cfg = {
          left:  formatStored(v.leftIds),
          right: formatStored(v.rightIds),
          mirror: !!mirror.checked,
          // keep the resolved archetype-id list for the simulation:
          leftIds:  v.leftIds,
          rightIds: v.rightIds,
        };
        if (typeof LEAGUE_CONFIG !== "undefined") LEAGUE_CONFIG.customFormation = cfg;
        if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
        if (typeof closeModal === "function") closeModal();
        if (typeof toast === "function") toast("Formation saved. Effective at next league reset.", "info");
      }
    );
  });
}
window.openFormationEditor = openFormationEditor;

/* ============================================================
   v37.3: CONFIRMATION DIALOG HELPER
   ============================================================
   Stacked over the current modal — re-uses #modalBack with a
   replacement body. After the user picks, the original modal is
   restored if onConfirm/onCancel didn't already close it.
   ============================================================ */
function _confirmDialog(title, htmlMessage, opts, onConfirm, onCancel) {
  if (typeof openModal !== "function") return;
  opts = opts || {};
  const confirmLabel = opts.confirmLabel || "Confirm";
  const cancelLabel  = opts.cancelLabel  || "Cancel";

  // Snapshot the current modal so we can restore it after a "go back"
  const prevTitle  = document.getElementById("modalTitle")?.textContent || "";
  const prevBody   = document.getElementById("modalBody")?.innerHTML || "";
  const prevFooter = document.getElementById("modalFooter")?.innerHTML || "";

  const body = `
    <div class="confirm-dialog">
      ${htmlMessage}
      <div class="confirm-actions">
        <button id="confirmDialogCancel">${_escHtml(cancelLabel)}</button>
        <button id="confirmDialogOk" class="primary">${_escHtml(confirmLabel)}</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `;
  openModal(title, body, "");

  document.getElementById("confirmDialogCancel").addEventListener("click", () => {
    // Restore the previous modal contents
    document.getElementById("modalTitle").textContent = prevTitle;
    document.getElementById("modalBody").innerHTML = prevBody;
    document.getElementById("modalFooter").innerHTML = prevFooter;
    if (typeof onCancel === "function") onCancel();
    // Note: re-rendering the body wipes prior listeners — callers that
    // need persistent listeners should attach them inside an opener
    // function that they re-call here. For the formation editor's
    // "Go back" path, openFormationEditor is idempotent against
    // LEAGUE_CONFIG.customFormation, so we re-open it cleanly.
    if (opts.onGoBackReopen && typeof opts.onGoBackReopen === "function") {
      opts.onGoBackReopen();
    }
  });
  document.getElementById("confirmDialogOk").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (typeof onConfirm === "function") onConfirm();
  });
}
window._confirmDialog = _confirmDialog;

/* ============================================================

        <textarea id="customTeamJson" spellcheck="false" style="background:var(--bg-2);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;min-height:140px;">${_escHtml(sample)}</textarea>

        <button id="customTeamSave" class="setting-action-btn" style="background:var(--gold);color:var(--bg-0);">Save Team</button>
      </div>
      <div id="customTeamStatus" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);min-height:14px;"></div>
      <div id="customTeamShareUrl" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);word-break:break-all;display:none;background:var(--bg-2);padding:8px 10px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);"></div>
    </div>
  `;
  openModal("🎽 Custom Teams", body, "", null, { width: "wide" });

  // --- listeners ---
  document.getElementById("customTeamCancel").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (typeof closeModal === "function") closeModal();
  });

  // === v37.7: Form-mode wiring ===
  // Sync the color picker and the hex text input both ways, so the
  // user can either type a hex value or click the color chip and the
  // other follows.
  const colorPicker = document.getElementById("teamFormColor");
  const colorHex    = document.getElementById("teamFormColorHex");
  if (colorPicker && colorHex) {
    colorPicker.addEventListener("input", () => { colorHex.value = colorPicker.value; _refreshTeamFormPreview(); });
    colorHex.addEventListener("input", () => {
      const v = colorHex.value.trim();
      if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(v)) colorPicker.value = v;
      _refreshTeamFormPreview();
    });
  }

  // === v37.8: Live avatar preview ===
  // The preview canvas is rendered using the same _renderAvatarTo
  // function the live game uses, so what the user sees in the form
  // is exactly what the team's knights will look like on the field
  // when their league resets. We cycle the role through a small
  // button so users can preview each archetype's silhouette.
  const previewRoles = ["tank", "striker", "speed", "brawl", "sniper", "healer", "grenadier"];
  let previewRoleIdx = 0;
  function _refreshTeamFormPreview() {
    const can = document.getElementById("teamFormAvatarPreview");
    if (!can) return;
    const cx = can.getContext("2d");
    if (!cx) return;
    // The preview uses a synthetic teamId that isn't in TEAM_BY_ID,
    // forcing the renderer down the _derivePaletteFromColor / _headGeneric
    // path — which is exactly the path saved custom teams will use
    // in matches. This makes the preview a true preview, not a
    // canon-team approximation.
    const colorVal = (colorHex && colorHex.value) || (colorPicker && colorPicker.value) || "#7a4cff";
    const synthId = "__customTeamPreview__";
    // Stub TEAM_BY_ID lookup so the renderer reads our preview color
    // without polluting the real table.
    const prev = (typeof TEAM_BY_ID !== "undefined") ? TEAM_BY_ID[synthId] : undefined;
    if (typeof TEAM_BY_ID !== "undefined") {
      TEAM_BY_ID[synthId] = { id: synthId, color: colorVal };
    }
    try {
      _renderAvatarTo(cx, synthId, previewRoles[previewRoleIdx], "alive");
    } finally {
      if (typeof TEAM_BY_ID !== "undefined") {
        if (prev === undefined) delete TEAM_BY_ID[synthId];
        else TEAM_BY_ID[synthId] = prev;
      }
    }
  }
  // Cycle role on button click
  const roleCycleBtn = document.getElementById("teamFormRoleCycle");
  if (roleCycleBtn) {
    roleCycleBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      previewRoleIdx = (previewRoleIdx + 1) % previewRoles.length;
      const labels = { tank: "Tank", striker: "Striker", speed: "Speedster", brawl: "Brawler", sniper: "Sniper", healer: "Healer", grenadier: "Grenadier" };
      roleCycleBtn.textContent = labels[previewRoles[previewRoleIdx]];
      _refreshTeamFormPreview();
    });
  }
  // Initial render
  _refreshTeamFormPreview();
  // "Build JSON ↓" — read the form fields and overwrite the JSON
  // textarea below with the assembled spec. We don't auto-build on
  // every keystroke because the user might be editing the JSON
  // directly and we shouldn't surprise-clobber their work.
  const buildBtn = document.getElementById("teamFormToJson");
  if (buildBtn) {
    buildBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const built = {
        id:    (document.getElementById("teamFormId").value    || "").trim().toUpperCase(),
        name:  (document.getElementById("teamFormName").value  || "").trim(),
        short: (document.getElementById("teamFormShort").value || "").trim(),
        emoji: (document.getElementById("teamFormEmoji").value || "").trim(),
        color: (document.getElementById("teamFormColorHex").value || colorPicker.value || "").trim(),
        lore:  (document.getElementById("teamFormLore").value  || "").trim(),
      };
      // Strip empty fields so the JSON editor stays clean (the user
      // can fill them in there if they want).
      const json = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(built).filter(([_, v]) => v !== ""));
      document.getElementById("customTeamJson").value = JSON.stringify(json, null, 2);
      _setStatus(document.getElementById("customTeamStatus"), "✓ JSON built from form. Edit below if needed, then Save Team.", "info");
    });
  }

  // Load a saved team back into the JSON box for editing
  document.querySelectorAll(".customTeamLoadBtn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const idx = +btn.dataset.idx;
      const t = (LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams || [])[idx];
      if (!t) return;
      document.getElementById("customTeamJson").value = JSON.stringify(t, null, 2);
      // v37.7: also populate the form fields so Load → tweak → Save
      // works without the user having to manually re-type anything.
      const setVal = (id, v) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = v || ""; };
      setVal("teamFormId",       t.id || "");
      setVal("teamFormName",     t.name || "");
      setVal("teamFormShort",    t.short || "");
      setVal("teamFormEmoji",    t.emoji || "");
      setVal("teamFormColorHex", t.color || "");
      setVal("teamFormLore",     t.lore || "");
      if (colorPicker && /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(t.color || "")) colorPicker.value = t.color;
      _setStatus(document.getElementById("customTeamStatus"), `Loaded "${t.short || t.name}" into the editor.`, "info");
    });
  });

  // Delete a saved team (with confirmation)
  document.querySelectorAll(".customTeamDeleteBtn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const idx = +btn.dataset.idx;
      const t = (LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams || [])[idx];
      if (!t) return;
      _confirmDialog(
        "Delete custom team?",
        `<p>Delete "<b>${_escHtml(t.short || t.name || "?")}</b>"?<br>This removes it from saved teams and the next league reset.</p>`,
        { confirmLabel: "Delete", cancelLabel: "Go back" },
        () => {
          LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams.splice(idx, 1);
          _save();
          _toast(`Deleted custom team "${t.short || t.name}".`);
          _renderCustomTeamsManagerBody();
        }
      );
    });
  });

  // Save handler — refactored v37.12: uses _setStatus, _parseJsonOr, _toast, _save
  document.getElementById("customTeamSave").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const status = document.getElementById("customTeamStatus");
    const parsed = _parseJsonOr(document.getElementById("customTeamJson").value, status);
    if (!parsed) return;
    const required = ["id", "name", "short", "emoji", "color"];
    for (const k of required) {
      if (!parsed[k]) { _setStatus(status, `Missing required field: ${k}`, "err"); return; }
    }
    if (!/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(parsed.color)) {
      _setStatus(status, "Color must be 6-digit hex (e.g. #7a4cff).", "err");
      return;
    }
    if (typeof LEAGUE_CONFIG !== "undefined") {
      LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams = LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams || [];
      LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams = LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams.filter(t => t.id !== parsed.id);
      LEAGUE_CONFIG.customTeams.push(parsed);
      _save();
    }
    _toast(`Custom team "${parsed.short || parsed.name}" saved.`);
    _renderCustomTeamsManagerBody();
  });

  // Share-link generation — refactored v37.12: delegates to _shareLinkUpload
  document.getElementById("customTeamShare").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById("customTeamStatus");
    const parsed = _parseJsonOr(document.getElementById("customTeamJson").value, status, "Could not parse JSON for share-link");
    if (!parsed) return;
    await _shareLinkUpload({
      payload: { kind: "fk-custom-team", v: 1, team: parsed },
      statusEl: status,
      urlEl: document.getElementById("customTeamShareUrl"),
    });
  });

  // Import-from-URL — refactored v37.12: delegates to _shareLinkImport
  document.getElementById("customTeamImport").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById("customTeamStatus");
    const url = document.getElementById("customTeamImportUrl").value.trim();
    const payload = await _shareLinkImport({ url, expectedKind: "fk-custom-team", statusEl: status });
    if (!payload || !payload.team) return;
    document.getElementById("customTeamJson").value = JSON.stringify(payload.team, null, 2);
    _setStatus(status, `✓ Imported "${payload.team.short || payload.team.name || "?"}". Click Save Team to add it to your league.`, "ok");
  });
}

/* v37.6: shared share-link fetcher used by both Custom Teams and Custom Lore.
   Fetches the upload-plugin URL, expects a JSON payload with at minimum
   { kind, v }. Returns the parsed object or null on failure. */
async function _fetchSharePayload(url) {
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    signal: (typeof AbortSignal !== "undefined" && AbortSignal.timeout) ? AbortSignal.timeout(15000) : undefined,
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error("HTTP " + res.status);
  const text = await res.text();
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

/* ============================================================
   v37.12: REFACTOR HELPERS
   ============================================================
   A small set of utility functions extracted from repeated
   inline patterns across the Custom Teams manager, Custom Lore
   manager, and Formation editor. Each helper replaces ~5-15
   uses of the same pattern with a single named call, making the
   call sites read more clearly and consolidating the conventions
   (status colors, share-link payload shapes, JSON validation
   error messages) in one place.
   ============================================================ */

/* Set a status element's text and color in one call.
   Replaces ~30 inline `el.textContent = "..."; el.style.color = "..."`
   pairs sprinkled across the manager UIs. The kind controls the
   color via a small map; "info"/"loading"/"mute" all use the same
   muted color, "ok" is green, "err" is red. */
const _STATUS_COLORS = {
  ok:      "var(--green, #6ec46e)",
  err:     "var(--red, #ef4d4d)",
  info:    "var(--mute)",
  loading: "var(--mute)",
  mute:    "var(--mute)",
};
function _setStatus(el, msg, kind) {
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = msg || "";
  el.style.color = _STATUS_COLORS[kind || "info"] || _STATUS_COLORS.info;
}

/* Guarded toast() call. The toast function may not be defined in
   smoke-test environments or before the UI module finishes loading,
   so every site that wants to toast something has been wrapping the
   call in a typeof check. This helper does it once. */
function _toast(msg, level) {
  if (typeof toast === "function") toast(msg, level || "info");
}

/* Guarded saveLocal() call. Same rationale as _toast — saveLocal is
   only defined after the persistence module loads, so a sprinkling
   of typeof guards has accumulated. Centralized here. */
function _save() {
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();
}

/* Try to JSON.parse the user-typed string and return the parsed object,
   or null on failure (with the error message routed through a
   provided status element). Replaces 4+ near-identical try/catch
   blocks in the Custom Teams / Custom Lore managers. */
function _parseJsonOr(raw, statusEl, errPrefix) {
  try { return JSON.parse(raw); }
  catch (e) {
    _setStatus(statusEl, (errPrefix || "Could not parse JSON") + ": " + (e.message || e), "err");
    return null;
  }
}

/* Generic share-link upload. Wraps the uploadPlugin invocation +
   blob construction + URL surfacing pattern that's identical between
   the Teams and Lore managers. The caller passes the JSON payload
   (already structured as { kind, v, ... }), the status element to
   update with progress, and the URL element to populate with the
   resulting share URL on success. */
async function _shareLinkUpload({ payload, statusEl, urlEl }) {
  if (typeof window.uploadPlugin !== "function") {
    _setStatus(statusEl, "Share-link unavailable — uploadPlugin not loaded. Add `uploadPlugin = {import:upload-plugin}` to the top editor.", "err");
    return null;
  }
  _setStatus(statusEl, "⏳ Uploading to Perchance CDN…", "loading");
  try {
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload)], { type: "application/json" });
    const result = await window.uploadPlugin(blob);
    if (!result || result.error) {
      _setStatus(statusEl, "Upload failed: " + (result?.error || "no response"), "err");
      return null;
    }
    if (urlEl) {
      urlEl.style.display = "block";
      urlEl.textContent = result.url;
    }
    _setStatus(statusEl, "✓ Share link ready — copy the URL below.", "ok");
    return result.url;
  } catch (e) {
    _setStatus(statusEl, "Upload error: " + (e.message || e), "err");
    return null;
  }
}

/* Generic share-link import. Wraps the URL-validation + fetch +
   payload-kind-check pattern. Returns the validated payload or null,
   updating the status element on every error path. The expectedKind
   is checked against payload.kind; if it doesn't match, the user
   sees a clear "wrong kind" message instead of a generic parse error. */
async function _shareLinkImport({ url, expectedKind, statusEl }) {
  if (!url) {
    _setStatus(statusEl, "Paste a share-link URL above first.", "err");
    return null;
  }
  if (!/^https:\/\/[\w.-]+\/file\//.test(url)) {
    _setStatus(statusEl, "URL doesn't look like a Perchance share-link. Expected https://user.uploads.dev/file/…", "err");
    return null;
  }
  _setStatus(statusEl, "⏳ Fetching from share-link…", "loading");
  try {
    const payload = await _fetchSharePayload(url);
    if (!payload) {
      _setStatus(statusEl, "Fetch returned nothing.", "err");
      return null;
    }
    if (expectedKind && payload.kind !== expectedKind) {
      _setStatus(statusEl, `Share-link has the wrong kind ("${payload.kind || "unknown"}") — expected ${expectedKind}.`, "err");
      return null;
    }
    return payload;
  } catch (e) {
    _setStatus(statusEl, "Import error: " + (e.message || e), "err");
    return null;
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   v37.3: CUSTOM LORE MANAGER (stub — to be expanded)
   ============================================================
   Opens a modal where the user can add their own lore entries to
   any of the eight Codex tabs. Stored in
   LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore = { histories: [], bios: [], diaries: [],
   logs: [], musings: [], found: [], glossary: [], timeline: [] }.

   Custom entries render at the bottom of their respective sections
   with a small "USER" badge so they're distinct from canon. The
   render-side hook is staged for a follow-up turn — this stub
   provides storage + the JSON-paste UI.
   ============================================================ */
function openCustomLoreManager() {
  if (typeof openModal !== "function") return;
  _renderCustomLoreManagerBody();
}
window.openCustomLoreManager = openCustomLoreManager;

function _renderCustomLoreManagerBody() {
  const lore = (typeof LEAGUE_CONFIG !== "undefined" && LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore) || {};
  const sections = ["histories", "bios", "diaries", "logs", "musings", "found", "glossary", "timeline"];
  const totalCount = sections.reduce((n, k) => n + (lore[k] || []).length, 0);

  // Saved-list block — flat list of every entry across all sections,
  // each with section-tag, title, and delete. Keep it compact since
  // there could be many entries over time.
  let savedListHtml = "";
  if (totalCount) {
    const rows = [];
    for (const section of sections) {
      const entries = lore[section] || [];
      entries.forEach((e, i) => {
        rows.push(`
          <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 8px;background:var(--bg-1);border-left:3px solid var(--gold);">
            <span style="font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);font-weight:700;min-width:62px;">${_escHtml(section)}</span>
            <div style="flex:1;min-width:0;">
              <div style="font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);font-size:12px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;">${_escHtml(e.title || "(untitled)")}</div>
            </div>
            <button class="customLoreLoadBtn setting-action-btn" data-section="${_escHtml(section)}" data-idx="${i}" style="padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px;">Load</button>
            <button class="customLoreDeleteBtn setting-action-btn" data-section="${_escHtml(section)}" data-idx="${i}" style="padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px;border-color:var(--red,#ef4d4d);color:var(--red,#ef4d4d);">Delete</button>
          </div>
        `);
      });
    }
    savedListHtml = `
      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;">
        <label style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);font-weight:700;">Saved entries (${totalCount})</label>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;background:var(--bg-2);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:6px;max-height:180px;overflow-y:auto;">
          ${rows.join("")}
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  const sample = JSON.stringify({ title: "An entry's title", meta: "Optional metadata line", body: "<p>The entry's body, in HTML or plain text.</p>", signoff: "— Optional sign-off" }, null, 2);

  const body = `
    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;">
      <div style="font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.6;background:var(--bg-2);padding:10px 12px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);">
        Add your own entries to the Codex. Pick a section and paste a JSON
        object. Required: <b>title</b> and <b>body</b> (HTML or plain text).
        Optional: <b>meta</b>, <b>signoff</b>. Saved entries render at the
        bottom of their section with a USER badge.
      </div>

      ${savedListHtml}

      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;">
        <label style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);font-weight:700;">Import from share-link URL</label>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
          <input id="customLoreImportUrl" placeholder="https://user.uploads.dev/file/…" style="flex:1;min-width:220px;background:var(--bg-2);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 10px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:11px;border-radius:0;" />
          <button id="customLoreImport" class="setting-action-btn">Import</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;">
        <label style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);font-weight:700;">Section</label>
        <select id="customLoreSection" class="stadium-picker-select" style="max-width:240px;">
          <option value="histories">Histories</option>
          <option value="bios">Biographies</option>
          <option value="diaries">Diaries</option>
          <option value="logs">Match Logs</option>
          <option value="musings">Musings</option>
          <option value="found">Found Papers</option>
          <option value="glossary">Glossary</option>
          <option value="timeline">Timeline</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;">
        <label style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);font-weight:700;">Entry JSON</label>
        <textarea id="customLoreJson" spellcheck="false" style="background:var(--bg-2);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;min-height:160px;">${_escHtml(sample)}</textarea>
      </div>

      <div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <button id="customLoreCancel" class="setting-action-btn">Close</button>
        <button id="customLoreShare" class="setting-action-btn">Get Share Link</button>
        <button id="customLoreSave" class="setting-action-btn" style="background:var(--gold);color:var(--bg-0);">Save Entry</button>
      </div>
      <div id="customLoreStatus" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--mute);min-height:14px;"></div>
      <div id="customLoreShareUrl" style="font-size:11px;color:var(--gold);word-break:break-all;display:none;background:var(--bg-2);padding:8px 10px;border-left:3px solid var(--gold);"></div>
    </div>
  `;
  openModal("📜 Custom Lore", body, "", null, { width: "wide" });

  document.getElementById("customLoreCancel").addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (typeof closeModal === "function") closeModal();
  });

  // Load entry into editor
  document.querySelectorAll(".customLoreLoadBtn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const section = btn.dataset.section;
      const idx = +btn.dataset.idx;
      const e = (LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore?.[section] || [])[idx];
      if (!e) return;
      // Strip internal flags before showing in the editor
      const display = { ...e };
      delete display._userAdded;
      delete display._addedAt;
      document.getElementById("customLoreSection").value = section;
      document.getElementById("customLoreJson").value = JSON.stringify(display, null, 2);
      _setStatus(document.getElementById("customLoreStatus"), `Loaded "${display.title}" from ${section}.`, "info");
    });
  });

  // Delete entry
  document.querySelectorAll(".customLoreDeleteBtn").forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const section = btn.dataset.section;
      const idx = +btn.dataset.idx;
      const e = (LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore?.[section] || [])[idx];
      if (!e) return;
      _confirmDialog(
        "Delete custom lore entry?",
        `<p>Delete "<b>${_escHtml(e.title || "?")}</b>" from <b>${_escHtml(section)}</b>?<br>This cannot be undone (without re-importing).</p>`,
        { confirmLabel: "Delete", cancelLabel: "Go back" },
        () => {
          LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore[section].splice(idx, 1);
          _save();
          if (typeof renderCustomLoreSection === "function") renderCustomLoreSection(section);
          _toast(`Deleted lore entry "${e.title}".`);
          _renderCustomLoreManagerBody();
        }
      );
    });
  });

  // Save handler — refactored v37.12: uses helpers
  document.getElementById("customLoreSave").addEventListener("click", () => {
    const status = document.getElementById("customLoreStatus");
    const section = document.getElementById("customLoreSection").value;
    const parsed = _parseJsonOr(document.getElementById("customLoreJson").value, status);
    if (!parsed) return;
    if (!parsed.title || !parsed.body) {
      _setStatus(status, "Missing required field(s): title and body are required.", "err");
      return;
    }
    if (typeof LEAGUE_CONFIG !== "undefined") {
      LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore = LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore || {};
      LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore[section] = LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore[section] || [];
      LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore[section].push({ ...parsed, _userAdded: true, _addedAt: Date.now() });
      _save();
    }
    if (typeof renderCustomLoreSection === "function") renderCustomLoreSection(section);
    _toast(`Custom lore entry saved in ${section}.`);
    _renderCustomLoreManagerBody();
  });

  // Share-link generation — refactored v37.12: delegates to _shareLinkUpload
  document.getElementById("customLoreShare").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById("customLoreStatus");
    const section = document.getElementById("customLoreSection").value;
    const parsed = _parseJsonOr(document.getElementById("customLoreJson").value, status, "Could not parse JSON for share-link");
    if (!parsed) return;
    await _shareLinkUpload({
      payload: { kind: "fk-custom-lore", v: 1, section, entry: parsed },
      statusEl: status,
      urlEl: document.getElementById("customLoreShareUrl"),
    });
  });

  // Import-from-URL — refactored v37.12: delegates to _shareLinkImport
  document.getElementById("customLoreImport").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    const status = document.getElementById("customLoreStatus");
    const url = document.getElementById("customLoreImportUrl").value.trim();
    const payload = await _shareLinkImport({ url, expectedKind: "fk-custom-lore", statusEl: status });
    if (!payload || !payload.entry) return;
    const display = { ...payload.entry };
    delete display._userAdded;
    delete display._addedAt;
    if (payload.section) document.getElementById("customLoreSection").value = payload.section;
    document.getElementById("customLoreJson").value = JSON.stringify(display, null, 2);
    _setStatus(status, `✓ Imported "${display.title || "?"}" into ${payload.section || "the editor"}. Click Save Entry to add it to your Codex.`, "ok");
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   TOAST NOTIFICATION SYSTEM
   Bottom-right stack. Kinds: "win" (green), "lose" (red),
   "warn" / "info" (yellow / blue). Auto-dismisses after 6s.
   ============================================================ */
function toast(msg, kind, opts) {
  // v28.27: skip toasts entirely during fast-forward catchup. Returning
  // users were getting drowned in waves of per-match toasts (kill streaks,
  // power core captures, gear losses, permadeaths, match-end alerts, bet
  // resolutions). The catchup summary toast at the end of boot covers the
  // important info; per-match noise is dropped silently.
  if (window._suppressToasts) return;
  kind = kind || "info";
  opts = opts || {};
  const stack = $("#toastStack");
  if (!stack) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.className = "toast " + kind;
  const icoMap = { win: "💸", lose: "💔", warn: "⚠️", info: "ℹ️" };
  el.innerHTML = `
    <span class="ico">${opts.ico || icoMap[kind] || "ℹ️"}</span>
    <div class="body">${msg}</div>
    <button class="close-x" aria-label="dismiss">×</button>
  `;
  const dismiss = () => {
    el.classList.add("fade-out");
    setTimeout(() => { if (el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el); }, 380);
  };
  el.querySelector(".close-x").addEventListener("click", dismiss);
  stack.appendChild(el);
  const ttl = opts.ttl || 6000;
  setTimeout(dismiss, ttl);
}
// Make available to the simulation layer
window.toast = toast;

/* ============================================================
   AUTO-PLAY — countdown between rounds/matches/seasons
   ============================================================ */
const AUTOPLAY = {
  enabled: true,
  cooldownRoundMs: 60000,   // 1 minute between rounds
  cooldownMatchMs: 60000,   // 1 minute between matches
  cooldownSeasonMs: 60000,  // 1 minute between seasons
};
// Pending auto-action: {kind: "round"|"match"|"season", remainingMs, action}
let AUTOPLAY_PENDING = null;

function scheduleAutoAdvance(kind, action) {
  const cd = kind === "round"  ? AUTOPLAY.cooldownRoundMs  :
             kind === "match"  ? AUTOPLAY.cooldownMatchMs  :
                                 AUTOPLAY.cooldownSeasonMs;
  AUTOPLAY_PENDING = { kind, remainingMs: cd, totalMs: cd, action };
  renderArenaHeader();
}
function skipCountdown() {
  if (!AUTOPLAY_PENDING) return;
  const a = AUTOPLAY_PENDING.action;
  AUTOPLAY_PENDING = null;
  try { a(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  renderAll();
}
function tickAutoplay(dt) {
  if (!AUTOPLAY_PENDING) return;
  if (!AUTOPLAY.enabled) return; // user turned it off — wait for click
  AUTOPLAY_PENDING.remainingMs -= dt;
  if (AUTOPLAY_PENDING.remainingMs <= 0) skipCountdown();
}

/* ============================================================
   v28.28: refreshSettingsUI — re-sync all settings UI from
   loaded LEAGUE_CONFIG / CAMERA / MATCH / AUTOPLAY values.

   Called from boot() AFTER loadLocal() restores saved state.
   bindSettings() runs before loadLocal (because it lives in
   bindEvents) so it initializes the UI with default values; the
   user's actual saved settings only take effect on the UI after
   this function runs.

   Only updates VALUES — does not re-bind any event listeners
   (those are bound once by bindSettings and stay attached).
   ============================================================ */
function refreshSettingsUI() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  // === Range sliders (cooldowns, best-of, lives) ===
  const rangeUpdates = [
    { id: "setRoundCooldown",  get: () => Math.round(AUTOPLAY.cooldownRoundMs  / 1000), label: v => v + "s" },
    { id: "setMatchCooldown",  get: () => Math.round(AUTOPLAY.cooldownMatchMs  / 1000), label: v => v + "s" },
    { id: "setSeasonCooldown", get: () => Math.round(AUTOPLAY.cooldownSeasonMs / 1000), label: v => v + "s" },
    { id: "setBestOf", get: () => MATCH.bestOf,        label: v => v + " (first to " + Math.ceil(v / 2) + ")" },
    { id: "setLives",  get: () => MATCH.startingLives, label: v => v + (v === 1 ? " life" : " lives") },
  ];
  for (const r of rangeUpdates) {
    const el = $("#" + r.id);
    if (!el) continue;
    el.value = r.get();
    const valEl = $("#" + r.id + "Val");
    if (valEl) valEl.textContent = r.label(+el.value);
  }

  // === Bracket size ===
  const bracketSel = $("#setBracketFmt");
  if (bracketSel) {
    bracketSel.value = String((LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.bracketSize) || 4);
  }

  // === Game mode + sub-options ===
  const modeSel = $("#setGameMode");
  if (modeSel) {
    modeSel.value = (LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.gameMode) || "deathmatch";
    // Show/hide sub-rows based on selected mode
    const v = modeSel.value;
    const kothRow = $("#kothPointsRow");
    const ctfRow  = $("#ctfCapsRow");
    if (kothRow) kothRow.style.display = (v === "koth") ? "" : "none";
    if (ctfRow)  ctfRow.style.display  = (v === "ctf")  ? "" : "none";
  }
  const kothPointsSel = $("#setKothPoints");
  if (kothPointsSel && LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig) {
    kothPointsSel.value = String(LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig.koth.pointsToWin || 50);
  }
  const ctfCapsSel = $("#setCtfCaps");
  if (ctfCapsSel && LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig) {
    ctfCapsSel.value = String(LEAGUE_CONFIG.modeConfig.ctf.capsToWin || 5);
  }

  // === Camera tuning sliders ===
  const camSliders = [
    { id: "setCamMaxZoom", valId: "setCamMaxZoomVal", cameraKey: "MAX_ZOOM",   configKey: "cameraMaxZoom", fixed: 2, suffix: "×" },
    { id: "setCamMinZoom", valId: "setCamMinZoomVal", cameraKey: "MIN_ZOOM",   configKey: "cameraMinZoom", fixed: 2, suffix: "×" },
    { id: "setCamLerp",    valId: "setCamLerpVal",    cameraKey: "LERP",       configKey: "cameraLerp",    fixed: 2, suffix: "" },
    { id: "setCamPad",     valId: "setCamPadVal",     cameraKey: "PAD_NORMAL", configKey: "cameraPad",     fixed: 0, suffix: " px" },
  ];
  for (const sl of camSliders) {
    const el = $("#" + sl.id);
    if (!el) continue;
    const stored = LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG[sl.configKey];
    if (typeof stored === "number" && typeof CAMERA !== "undefined") {
      // The saved value is the source of truth — push to both UI and CAMERA module
      CAMERA[sl.cameraKey] = stored;
      el.value = String(stored);
    } else if (typeof CAMERA !== "undefined") {
      // No saved override — show the CAMERA module's current value
      el.value = String(CAMERA[sl.cameraKey]);
    }
    const valEl = $("#" + sl.valId);
    if (valEl) valEl.textContent = (+el.value).toFixed(sl.fixed) + sl.suffix;
  }

  // === Disable-dynamic-camera toggle ===
  const disableCamEl = $("#setDisableCam");
  if (disableCamEl) {
    disableCamEl.checked = !!(LEAGUE_CONFIG && LEAGUE_CONFIG.disableDynamicCamera);
  }

  // === Effect toggles + hitbox debug ===
  // These are simple checkboxes whose state lives in LEAGUE_CONFIG. Refresh
  // each by id pattern.
  const fxToggles = [
    "setDisableShake", "setDisableSlowmo", "setDisableMuzzleFlash",
    "setDisableHitFlash", "setDisableImpact", "setDisableExplosion",
    "setDisableTrail", "setDisableScreenFlash", "setShowHitboxes",
  ];
  for (const id of fxToggles) {
    const el = $("#" + id);
    if (!el) continue;
    // The config key is the id with "set" prefix dropped + first char lowercase
    const stripped = id.replace(/^set/, "");
    const configKey = stripped.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + stripped.slice(1);
    if (LEAGUE_CONFIG && typeof LEAGUE_CONFIG[configKey] === "boolean") {
      el.checked = LEAGUE_CONFIG[configKey];
    }
  }
}
window.refreshSettingsUI = refreshSettingsUI;

/* ============================================================
   FAST-FORWARD — catch up the sim by N ms of wall-clock time.
   Used when the user comes back to a tab they left running for a while:
   the league plays itself in the background, and on resume we replay
   what would have happened in deterministic lockstep.

   Hard-capped at 1 hour of wall-clock catch-up to prevent runaway
   replays after extended absences. Also bounded by a 5-second
   wall-clock budget (so a slow device doesn't freeze on resume).
   ============================================================ */
function fastForwardSim(ms) {
  if (ms <= 0) return { matchesPlayed: 0, simulatedMs: 0, capped: false };
  const cap = 60 * 60 * 1000; // 1 hour
  const capped = ms > cap;
  let remaining = Math.min(ms, cap);

  const wallStart = (typeof performance !== "undefined" && performance.now)
    ? performance.now() : Date.now();
  const wallBudget = 5000; // give up after 5s wall time so the page doesn't hang

  const startMatchCount = (LEAGUE.matchHistory || []).length;
  const startSeason = LEAGUE.season;
  // v28.27: capture aggregate state at start so the summary toast can
  // report the net effect of catchup, replacing per-match toasts.
  const startBits = LEAGUE.bits || 0;
  const startCasualties = (LEAGUE.graveyard || []).length;
  const startChampionships = (LEAGUE.history || []).length;

  // v28.27: silence per-match toasts (kill streaks, power-core captures,
  // gear losses, permadeaths, match-end alerts, bet resolutions) during
  // fast-forward catchup. Returning users were getting drowned in waves
  // of toasts that filled the right side of the screen and dismissed
  // slowly. The single summary toast at boot covers the important info.
  const prevSuppress = window._suppressToasts;
  window._suppressToasts = true;

  try {
    let safety = 0;
    while (remaining > 0 && safety++ < 1000000) {
      // Wall-clock safety check
      const wallNow = (typeof performance !== "undefined" && performance.now)
        ? performance.now() : Date.now();
      if (wallNow - wallStart > wallBudget) {
        console.warn(`fastForwardSim: hit ${wallBudget}ms wall budget, stopping early (${remaining}ms unsimulated)`);
        break;
      }

      if (LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.match.phase === "round") {
        // Active round — tick the sim
        tickMatch();
        remaining -= COMBAT.frameMs;
      } else if (AUTOPLAY_PENDING && AUTOPLAY.enabled) {
        // We're in a cooldown countdown — burn through it
        const stepMs = Math.min(remaining, AUTOPLAY_PENDING.remainingMs);
        AUTOPLAY_PENDING.remainingMs -= stepMs;
        remaining -= stepMs;
        if (AUTOPLAY_PENDING.remainingMs <= 0) {
          const action = AUTOPLAY_PENDING.action;
          AUTOPLAY_PENDING = null;
          try { action(); } catch (e) { console.error("autoplay action failed", e); break; }
        }
      } else {
        // No match, no cooldown — sim is idle (e.g., post-final, awaiting season)
        // Try to bootstrap
        if (!LEAGUE.match && LEAGUE.currentSlot && typeof startMatch === "function") {
          startMatch();
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }
    }
  } finally {
    // Always restore — even if the loop bailed via exception. Otherwise
    // ALL toasts would be silenced for the rest of the session.
    window._suppressToasts = prevSuppress;
  }

  // Build a list of championships earned during catchup, for the summary
  const newChampionshipEntries = (LEAGUE.history || []).slice(startChampionships);

  return {
    matchesPlayed: ((LEAGUE.matchHistory || []).length - startMatchCount),
    seasonsPlayed: LEAGUE.season - startSeason,
    simulatedMs: Math.min(ms, cap) - Math.max(0, remaining),
    capped,
    unsimulated: Math.max(0, remaining),
    bitsDelta: (LEAGUE.bits || 0) - startBits,
    casualtiesDelta: ((LEAGUE.graveyard || []).length) - startCasualties,
    championshipsEarned: newChampionshipEntries.length,
    championshipDetails: newChampionshipEntries,
  };
}
window.fastForwardSim = fastForwardSim;

/* ============================================================
   TAB SWITCHING — Game / Bet / Store / About
   ============================================================ */
function switchTab(tabId) {
  $$(".tab-content").forEach(el => el.classList.toggle("active", el.dataset.tab === tabId));
  $$(".nav-tabs button").forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.dataset.tab === tabId));
  if (tabId === "bet" && typeof renderBetTab === "function") renderBetTab();
  if (tabId === "store" && typeof renderStore === "function") renderStore();
  if (tabId === "league" && typeof renderLeagueTab === "function") renderLeagueTab();
  if (tabId === "game" && typeof renderAll === "function") renderAll();
  if (tabId === "lore" && typeof bindLoreSubtabs === "function") bindLoreSubtabs();
  // v28.29: render the Teams sub-section facts grid on Lore tab activation.
  if (tabId === "lore" && typeof renderLoreTeamFactsGrid === "function") renderLoreTeamFactsGrid();
}

/* Lore sub-tab navigation — switch between Histories / Bios / Diaries /
   etc. by toggling the .active class on the right .lore-section. The
   lore-tab buttons are inside the Lore tab content; we bind once on first
   visit (idempotent guard via a flag). */
let _loreSubtabsBound = false;
function bindLoreSubtabs() {
  if (_loreSubtabsBound) return;
  _loreSubtabsBound = true;
  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".lore-tab");
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const target = btn.dataset.loretab;
      document.querySelectorAll(".lore-tab").forEach(b =>
        b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.loretab === target));
      document.querySelectorAll(".lore-section").forEach(s =>
        s.classList.toggle("active", s.dataset.loresection === target));
      // Lazy-render biome previews on Stadiums tab activation. Each canvas
      // stores its own rendered flag so we don't redraw on every tab switch.
      if (target === "stadiums") {
        if (typeof renderStadiumLore === "function") renderStadiumLore();
        if (typeof renderStadiumPreviews === "function") renderStadiumPreviews();
      }
      // v28.29: render Team facts grid when Teams sub-tab is selected
      if (target === "teams" && typeof renderLoreTeamFactsGrid === "function") {
        renderLoreTeamFactsGrid();
      }
      // v37.4: render user-added custom lore entries for this tab.
      // Also called once at boot via renderCustomLoreAll() so entries
      // are visible on the default-active tab without a click.
      if (typeof renderCustomLoreSection === "function") {
        renderCustomLoreSection(target);
      }
      // === v37.17: render the Bookmarks tab on demand ===
      if (target === "bookmarks" && typeof renderBookmarksLore === "function") {
        renderBookmarksLore();
      }
      // Re-bootstrap navigation in case custom lore added new articles
      // since the last visit. The bootstrap is idempotent — articles
      // already wrapped get their data-loreid preserved.
      if (typeof bootstrapLoreNav === "function") {
        try { bootstrapLoreNav(); } catch (e) { console.warn("bootstrapLoreNav:", e); }
      }
    });
  });
  // First-time render so the active tab shows custom entries on load
  if (typeof renderCustomLoreAll === "function") renderCustomLoreAll();
  // === v37.17: bootstrap lore navigation (collapsible articles, TOC,
  // bookmark buttons) on first lore-tab open ===
  if (typeof bootstrapLoreNav === "function") {
    try { bootstrapLoreNav(); } catch (e) { console.warn("bootstrapLoreNav initial:", e); }
  }
  // Sync the bookmark count badge in the subnav
  if (typeof updateLoreBookmarkBadge === "function") updateLoreBookmarkBadge();
}

/* ============================================================
   v37.17: LORE NAVIGATION SYSTEM
   ============================================================
   Three integrated features sharing infrastructure:

     1. COLLAPSIBLE ARTICLES — each article body collapses to just
        its h3 header. Clicking the header toggles. Solves the
        "lore tabs are too long" problem without per-article markup.
     2. AUTO-GENERATED TOC — top of each lore-section gets a list of
        every article title in that section as clickable jump links.
        Clicking jumps to + expands the article.
     3. BOOKMARKS — 🔖 button per article. Click toggles persistent
        bookmark. A "🔖 Bookmarks" sub-tab lists all saved articles
        with snippets and a jump-to-original action.

   bootstrapLoreNav walks every <article> in every .lore-section and
   applies the three patterns. Idempotent — re-running on a tab switch
   is cheap (skips already-bootstrapped articles via a marker class).

   Stable article IDs are derived from `${section}::${slug-of-h3}` so
   bookmarks survive page refreshes and don't depend on DOM order.
   ============================================================ */

/* Slugify an h3 title for use as the trailing portion of an article ID.
   Lower-cases, strips non-alphanumerics to dashes, collapses multiple
   dashes, trims to 80 chars. Stable across renders for the same title. */
function _slugifyLoreTitle(s) {
  if (!s) return "untitled";
  return String(s)
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^\w\s-]/g, " ")  // strip punct including " " quotes
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-|-$/g, "")
    .slice(0, 80);
}

/* Walk every <article> in every .lore-section and:
   1. Tag it with data-loreid = `${section}::${slug}`
   2. Add a clickable .lore-article-header class to its h3
   3. Wrap its non-h3 children in a .lore-article-body container so we
      can hide them with a single CSS class toggle
   4. Append a 🔖 bookmark button to the h3
   5. Default-collapse the article (preserve any pre-bootstrap state)
   6. Build/refresh the .lore-toc at the top of each .lore-section.
   Idempotent via the article.dataset.loreNavReady flag. */
function bootstrapLoreNav() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;

  const sections = document.querySelectorAll(".lore-section");
  sections.forEach(section => {
    const sectionId = section.dataset.loresection || "unknown";
    // Skip the bookmarks meta-section — its only article is the live list
    if (sectionId === "bookmarks") return;

    const articles = section.querySelectorAll("article");
    articles.forEach(article => {
      // Idempotency check
      if (article.dataset.loreNavReady === "1") return;

      const h3 = article.querySelector("h3");
      if (!h3) return;

      // Generate stable ID
      // === v37.20: strip badge text before slugifying ===
      // User-lore articles include a "YOUR ENTRY" badge span inside
      // their h3. Without stripping, the slug becomes "my-history-your-entry"
      // which is ugly and unstable (re-rendering rebuilds the badge).
      // We extract just the heading text by cloning, removing badges,
      // and reading textContent.
      const titleClone = h3.cloneNode(true);
      titleClone.querySelectorAll(".user-badge, .lore-bookmark-btn").forEach(el => el.remove());
      const cleanTitle = (titleClone.textContent || "").trim();
      const slug = _slugifyLoreTitle(cleanTitle);
      const loreId = `${sectionId}::${slug}`;
      article.dataset.loreid = loreId;
      article.dataset.loreNavReady = "1";

      // Wrap non-h3 children in a .lore-article-body container so we
      // can collapse with a single CSS rule.
      const body = document.createElement("div");
      body.className = "lore-article-body";
      // Move all children (except the h3 itself) into body
      const kids = Array.from(article.children);
      for (const k of kids) {
        if (k === h3) continue;
        body.appendChild(k);
      }
      article.appendChild(body);

      // Add header click-to-collapse + bookmark button
      h3.classList.add("lore-article-header");

      // Build the bookmark button (separate from h3 text so it doesn't
      // get caught in the collapse-toggle click handler)
      const bmBtn = document.createElement("button");
      bmBtn.className = "lore-bookmark-btn";
      bmBtn.title = "Bookmark this article";
      bmBtn.textContent = "🔖";
      bmBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        toggleLoreBookmark(loreId, sectionId, h3.textContent.trim());
      });
      h3.appendChild(bmBtn);

      // Click on h3 (anywhere except button) toggles collapse
      h3.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target === bmBtn) return;
        article.classList.toggle("lore-collapsed");
      });

      // Default: collapsed (hides the meta + body, leaves the h3
      // visible). Keeps the page short and lets users opt in.
      article.classList.add("lore-collapsed");

      // Reflect existing bookmark state
      _syncBookmarkButtonState(article, bmBtn, loreId);
    });

    // Build/refresh TOC at the top of this section
    _buildLoreToc(section);
  });
}
window.bootstrapLoreNav = bootstrapLoreNav;

/* Reflect current bookmark state on the button + parent article. */
function _syncBookmarkButtonState(article, bmBtn, loreId) {
  const bookmarked = !!(LEAGUE && LEAGUE.loreBookmarks && LEAGUE.loreBookmarks[loreId]);
  bmBtn.classList.toggle("bookmarked", bookmarked);
  article.classList.toggle("lore-bookmarked", bookmarked);
}

/* Build the auto-TOC at the top of a lore-section. Injects (or refreshes)
   a .lore-toc element listing every <article>'s h3 as a jump link. */
function _buildLoreToc(section) {
  const articles = Array.from(section.querySelectorAll("article")).filter(a => a.dataset.loreid);
  if (articles.length === 0) return;

  // Find or create the TOC element
  let toc = section.querySelector(":scope > .lore-toc");
  if (!toc) {
    toc = document.createElement("div");
    toc.className = "lore-toc collapsed";  // start collapsed for compactness
    section.insertBefore(toc, section.firstChild);
  }

  const sectionId = section.dataset.loresection || "section";
  const sectionLabels = {
    histories: "Histories", teams: "Teams", stadiums: "Stadiums",
    bios: "Biographies", diaries: "Diaries", logs: "Match Logs",
    musings: "Musings", found: "Found Papers", timeline: "Timeline",
    glossary: "Glossary",
  };
  const label = sectionLabels[sectionId] || sectionId;

  const items = articles.map(a => {
    const id = a.dataset.loreid;
    const h3 = a.querySelector("h3");
    // === v37.20: strip badges (🔖, YOUR ENTRY) for clean TOC display ===
    let text = "";
    if (h3) {
      const clone = h3.cloneNode(true);
      clone.querySelectorAll(".user-badge, .lore-bookmark-btn").forEach(el => el.remove());
      text = (clone.textContent || "").replace(/🔖/g, "").trim();
    }
    const isUserEntry = a.dataset.userEntry === "1";
    const userMark = isUserEntry ? '<span style="color:var(--gold);font-size:9px;">★</span> ' : "";
    const isBookmarked = !!(LEAGUE && LEAGUE.loreBookmarks && LEAGUE.loreBookmarks[id]);
    return `<a href="#" data-jumpid="${id}" class="${isBookmarked ? "bookmarked" : ""}">${userMark}${escapeHTML(text)}</a>`;
  }).join("");

  toc.innerHTML = `
    <div class="lore-toc-header" onclick="this.parentElement.classList.toggle('collapsed')">
      <span class="lore-toc-title">📋 ${escapeHTML(label)} — ${articles.length} article${articles.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}</span>
      <div class="lore-toc-actions">
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();_loreCollapseAll('${sectionId}', false);">Expand all</button>
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();_loreCollapseAll('${sectionId}', true);">Collapse all</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="lore-toc-list">${items}</div>
  `;

  // Wire jump-link clicks
  toc.querySelectorAll("a[data-jumpid]").forEach(a => {
    a.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      jumpToLoreArticle(a.dataset.jumpid);
    });
  });
}

/* Collapse or expand every article in the given section. */
function _loreCollapseAll(sectionId, collapse) {
  const section = document.querySelector(`.lore-section[data-loresection="${sectionId}"]`);
  if (!section) return;
  section.querySelectorAll("article").forEach(a => {
    if (a.dataset.loreid) {
      a.classList.toggle("lore-collapsed", collapse);
    }
  });
}
window._loreCollapseAll = _loreCollapseAll;

/* Jump to a specific lore article: switches to its sub-tab if needed,
   expands the article, scrolls it into view, and flashes a brief
   highlight. The data-loreid format is "section::slug". */
function jumpToLoreArticle(loreId) {
  if (!loreId) return;
  const sep = loreId.indexOf("::");
  if (sep === -1) return;
  const sectionId = loreId.slice(0, sep);

  // 1. Activate the sub-tab if it isn't already
  const targetBtn = document.querySelector(`.lore-tab[data-loretab="${sectionId}"]`);
  if (targetBtn && !targetBtn.classList.contains("active")) {
    targetBtn.click();
  }

  // 2. Find the article + expand it
  // Use a setTimeout so the tab-switch DOM update completes first
  setTimeout(() => {
    const article = document.querySelector(`article[data-loreid="${CSS.escape(loreId)}"]`);
    if (!article) return;
    article.classList.remove("lore-collapsed");
    // 3. Scroll into view + flash highlight
    article.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
    article.classList.remove("lore-jump-target");
    void article.offsetWidth; // restart animation
    article.classList.add("lore-jump-target");
  }, 60);
}
window.jumpToLoreArticle = jumpToLoreArticle;

/* Toggle bookmark state for a lore article. Stores section, title,
   savedAt, and a short snippet (first ~140 chars of the article body)
   so the Bookmarks list can preview without re-walking the DOM. */
function toggleLoreBookmark(loreId, sectionId, title) {
  if (!LEAGUE.loreBookmarks) LEAGUE.loreBookmarks = {};
  if (LEAGUE.loreBookmarks[loreId]) {
    delete LEAGUE.loreBookmarks[loreId];
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
      window.toast(`🔖 Removed bookmark`, "info", { ico: "🔖", ttl: 3000 });
    }
  } else {
    // Capture a snippet from the article body for the Bookmarks list
    const article = document.querySelector(`article[data-loreid="${CSS.escape(loreId)}"]`);
    let snippet = "";
    if (article) {
      const body = article.querySelector(".lore-article-body");
      if (body) {
        const text = (body.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim();
        snippet = text.slice(0, 140) + (text.length > 140 ? "…" : "");
      }
    }
    LEAGUE.loreBookmarks[loreId] = {
      section: sectionId,
      title: (title || "").trim(),
      savedAt: Date.now(),
      snippet,
    };
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.toast) {
      // === v37.23.8: keep the toast HTML simple ===
      // Pre-truncate the title so the toast body can never include a
      // partial-tag fragment that Perchance's MutationObserver might
      // re-parse as an inline event handler.
      const _safeTitle = escapeHTML((title || "article").slice(0, 80));
      window.toast(`🔖 Bookmarked: <b>${_safeTitle}</b>`, "info", { ico: "🔖", ttl: 3000 });
    }
  }
  if (typeof saveLocal === "function") saveLocal();

  // Refresh button state on this article
  const article = document.querySelector(`article[data-loreid="${CSS.escape(loreId)}"]`);
  if (article) {
    const bmBtn = article.querySelector(".lore-bookmark-btn");
    if (bmBtn) _syncBookmarkButtonState(article, bmBtn, loreId);
  }

  // Refresh TOC marker on the relevant section
  const section = document.querySelector(`.lore-section[data-loresection="${sectionId}"]`);
  if (section) _buildLoreToc(section);

  // Refresh the bookmarks list (if currently visible) + the count badge
  if (typeof renderBookmarksLore === "function") renderBookmarksLore();
  if (typeof updateLoreBookmarkBadge === "function") updateLoreBookmarkBadge();
}
window.toggleLoreBookmark = toggleLoreBookmark;

/* Render the Bookmarks sub-tab body — a list of cards, one per
   bookmarked article, sorted by savedAt descending (most recent first).
   Each card has a "Jump to article" action and a remove button. */
function renderBookmarksLore() {
  const list = document.getElementById("loreBookmarksList");
  if (!list) return;
  const bookmarks = (LEAGUE && LEAGUE.loreBookmarks) || {};
  const entries = Object.keys(bookmarks).map(id => ({ id, ...bookmarks[id] }));
  entries.sort((a, b) => (b.savedAt || 0) - (a.savedAt || 0));

  if (entries.length === 0) {
    list.innerHTML = `<div class="lore-bookmarks-empty">
      No bookmarks yet. Click the 🔖 button next to any article's title to save it here.
    </div>`;
    return;
  }

  const sectionLabels = {
    histories: "Histories", teams: "Teams", stadiums: "Stadiums",
    bios: "Biographies", diaries: "Diaries", logs: "Match Logs",
    musings: "Musings", found: "Found Papers", timeline: "Timeline",
    glossary: "Glossary",
  };

  list.innerHTML = entries.map(e => `
    <div class="lore-bookmark-card" onclick="jumpToLoreArticle('${e.id.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')">
      <div class="bm-section">${escapeHTML(sectionLabels[e.section] || e.section)}</div>
      <div class="bm-title">${escapeHTML(e.title || "Untitled")}</div>
      ${e.snippet ? `<div class="bm-snippet">${escapeHTML(e.snippet)}</div>` : ""}
      <div class="bm-actions">
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();jumpToLoreArticle('${e.id.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}');">Jump to article</button>
        <button onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleLoreBookmark('${e.id.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}', '${e.section}', ${JSON.stringify(e.title || "")});">Remove</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join("");
}
window.renderBookmarksLore = renderBookmarksLore;

/* Update the bookmark count badge in the lore subnav. Hidden when 0. */
function updateLoreBookmarkBadge() {
  const badge = document.getElementById("loreBookmarksCount");
  if (!badge) return;
  const count = Object.keys((LEAGUE && LEAGUE.loreBookmarks) || {}).length;
  if (count === 0) {
    badge.style.display = "none";
  } else {
    badge.style.display = "inline-block";
    badge.textContent = count;
  }
}
window.updateLoreBookmarkBadge = updateLoreBookmarkBadge;

/* ============================================================
   v37.4: CUSTOM LORE RENDERING
   ============================================================
   Walks LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore[section] and appends user-added
   entries to the matching .lore-section container. Each entry is
   wrapped in an <article> with the section's matching class
   (.history / .bio / .diary / .log / .musing / .found) plus a
   small "USER" badge so it's visually distinct from canon.

   The render is idempotent — it removes any previously-injected
   user entries (tagged data-user-entry="1") before re-appending,
   so calling it after openCustomLoreManager saves a new entry
   refreshes the section without dupes.
   ============================================================ */
const CUSTOM_LORE_SECTIONS = ["histories", "bios", "diaries", "logs", "musings", "found", "glossary", "timeline"];
const CUSTOM_LORE_CLASS_BY_SECTION = {
  histories: "history",
  bios: "bio",
  diaries: "diary",
  logs: "log",
  musings: "musing",
  found: "found",
};

function renderCustomLoreAll() {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  for (const section of CUSTOM_LORE_SECTIONS) {
    renderCustomLoreSection(section);
  }
}
window.renderCustomLoreAll = renderCustomLoreAll;

function renderCustomLoreSection(section) {
  if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
  if (!CUSTOM_LORE_SECTIONS.includes(section)) return;
  const container = document.querySelector(`.lore-section[data-loresection="${section}"]`);
  if (!container) return;

  // Remove previously-injected user entries AND the user-section divider
  container.querySelectorAll('[data-user-entry="1"]').forEach(el => el.remove());
  container.querySelectorAll('[data-user-divider="1"]').forEach(el => el.remove());

  const entries = (typeof LEAGUE_CONFIG !== "undefined" && LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore && Array.isArray(LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore[section]))
    ? LEAGUE_CONFIG.customLore[section] : [];
  if (!entries.length) return;

  // Glossary / timeline are special: they use <dl> / <ol> rather than
  // free-floating articles. For these we append to the existing list.
  if (section === "glossary") {
    const dl = container.querySelector("dl");
    if (!dl) return;
    // === v37.20: insert a visible divider <dt> before user entries ===
    // Within a definition list we can't add a heading that isn't a
    // <dt>/<dd> pair. The "Your Additions" divider is a special <dt>
    // styled to look like a section header.
    const dividerDt = document.createElement("dt");
    dividerDt.dataset.userDivider = "1";
    dividerDt.className = "user-section-divider";
    dividerDt.innerHTML = `<span class="user-divider-line">— Your additions —</span>`;
    const dividerDd = document.createElement("dd");
    dividerDd.dataset.userDivider = "1";
    dividerDd.className = "user-section-divider-spacer";
    dl.appendChild(dividerDt);
    dl.appendChild(dividerDd);
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const dt = document.createElement("dt");
      dt.dataset.userEntry = "1";
      dt.innerHTML = _escHtml(entry.title) + ' <span class="user-badge">YOUR ENTRY</span>';
      const dd = document.createElement("dd");
      dd.dataset.userEntry = "1";
      dd.innerHTML = entry.body;  // intentionally raw — user content is local-only
      dl.appendChild(dt);
      dl.appendChild(dd);
    }
    return;
  }
  if (section === "timeline") {
    const ol = container.querySelector("ol");
    if (!ol) return;
    // Divider for timeline lists
    const dividerLi = document.createElement("li");
    dividerLi.dataset.userDivider = "1";
    dividerLi.className = "user-section-divider";
    dividerLi.innerHTML = `<span class="user-divider-line">— Your additions —</span>`;
    ol.appendChild(dividerLi);
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const li = document.createElement("li");
      li.dataset.userEntry = "1";
      li.innerHTML = `<b>${_escHtml(entry.title)}</b> <span class="user-badge">YOUR ENTRY</span> — ${entry.body}`;
      ol.appendChild(li);
    }
    return;
  }

  // Histories / bios / diaries / logs / musings / found — articles
  // === v37.20: visible section divider before user entries ===
  // A full-width banner separating canon from your additions, so the
  // boundary between pre-seeded lore and player content is unambiguous.
  const divider = document.createElement("div");
  divider.dataset.userDivider = "1";
  divider.className = "user-section-divider-banner";
  divider.innerHTML = `
    <div class="user-divider-bar"></div>
    <div class="user-divider-label">⭐ Your Additions (${entries.length})</div>
    <div class="user-divider-bar"></div>
  `;
  container.appendChild(divider);

  const articleClass = CUSTOM_LORE_CLASS_BY_SECTION[section] || "history";
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const article = document.createElement("article");
    article.className = articleClass + " user-lore-article";
    article.dataset.userEntry = "1";
    let html = `<h3>${_escHtml(entry.title)} <span class="user-badge">YOUR ENTRY</span></h3>`;
    if (entry.meta)    html += `<div class="meta">${_escHtml(entry.meta)}</div>`;
    html += entry.body;  // user-supplied; rendered as-is
    if (entry.signoff) html += `<div class="signoff">${_escHtml(entry.signoff)}</div>`;
    article.innerHTML = html;
    container.appendChild(article);
  }
}
window.renderCustomLoreSection = renderCustomLoreSection;

/* ============================================================
   v28.29: renderLoreTeamFactsGrid — populates the Lore Teams
